title: 哈姆雷特
author: William Shakespeare 威廉·莎士比亞
description: 《Hamlet, Prince of Denmark》(約1600)。丹麥王子哈姆雷特遇見父王鬼魂,得知叔父克勞狄斯弒兄篡位,裝瘋復仇,卻在猶豫、愛情同死亡之間走向悲劇結局。全劇五幕二十場,每段對白標示說話者,英文原文對照廣東話/普通話翻譯。

chapters.title: Act I, Scene I — The Platform before the Castle 第一幕第一場:城堡前嘅平台

passages.original: Enter Francisco and Barnardo, two sentinels.
passages.vernacular: [弗蘭西斯科同巴納多上,兩名哨兵。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [弗蘭西斯科和巴納多上,兩名哨兵。]

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Who’s there?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: Nay, answer me. Stand and unfold yourself.
passages.vernacular: 唔係,你答我先。企住,報上名嚟。企住,報上名嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,你先答我。站住,報上名來。站住,報上名來。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Long live the King!
passages.vernacular: 吾王萬歲!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吾王萬歲!

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: Barnardo?
passages.vernacular: 巴納多?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 巴納多?

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: He.
passages.vernacular: 係我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是我。

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: You come most carefully upon your hour.
passages.vernacular: 你好準時嚟接更。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你來得很準時。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: ’Tis now struck twelve. Get thee to bed, Francisco.
passages.vernacular: 剛敲過十二點。去瞓啦,弗蘭西斯科。去瞓啦,弗蘭西斯科。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 剛敲過十二點。去睡吧,弗蘭西斯科。去睡吧,弗蘭西斯科。

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: For this relief much thanks. ’Tis bitter cold, And I am sick at heart.
passages.vernacular: 多謝你嚟換更。天氣凍到入骨,我心裡又難受。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 多謝你來換更。天氣冷得刺骨,我心裡又難受。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Have you had quiet guard?
passages.vernacular: 你呢更守得平靜嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這一更守得平靜嗎?

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: Not a mouse stirring.
passages.vernacular: 連隻老鼠都冇郁過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 連隻老鼠都沒動過。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Well, good night. If you do meet Horatio and Marcellus, The rivals of my watch, bid them make haste.
passages.vernacular: 好,晚安。如果你碰到同我一齊守夜嘅霍拉旭同馬賽勒斯,叫佢哋快啲嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,晚安。如果你碰到和我一起守夜的霍拉旭和馬賽勒斯,叫他們快點來。

passages.original: Enter Horatio and Marcellus.
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭同馬賽勒斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭和馬賽勒斯上。]

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: I think I hear them. Stand, ho! Who is there?
passages.vernacular: 我好似聽到佢哋嚟。企住!邊個?邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我好像聽到他們來了。站住!誰?誰?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Friends to this ground.
passages.vernacular: 係自己人,為呢片土地守夜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是自己人,為這片土地守夜。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: And liegemen to the Dane.
passages.vernacular: 同丹麥王嘅臣子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有丹麥王的臣子。

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: Give you good night.
passages.vernacular: 祝你晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 祝你晚安。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: O, farewell, honest soldier, who hath reliev’d you?
passages.vernacular: 哦,再見,忠實嘅士兵,邊個換你嘅更?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哦,再見,忠實的士兵,誰換你的更?

passages.title: Francisco 弗蘭西斯科
passages.original: Barnardo has my place. Give you good-night.
passages.vernacular: 巴納多接咗我嘅位。祝你晚安。祝你晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 巴納多接了我的位。祝你晚安。祝你晚安。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Holla, Barnardo!
passages.vernacular: 喂,巴納多!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂,巴納多!

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Say, what, is Horatio there?
passages.vernacular: 講嚟聽下,霍拉旭喺度嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說來聽聽,霍拉旭在這裡嗎?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: A piece of him.
passages.vernacular: 佢一部分喺度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的一部分在這裡。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Welcome, Horatio. Welcome, good Marcellus.
passages.vernacular: 歡迎,霍拉旭。歡迎,好心嘅馬賽勒斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 歡迎,霍拉旭。歡迎,好心的馬賽勒斯。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: What, has this thing appear’d again tonight?
passages.vernacular: 點,今晚嗰個嘢又出現過嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣,今晚那個東西又出現過嗎?

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: I have seen nothing.
passages.vernacular: 我冇見過任何嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我沒見過任何東西。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Horatio says ’tis but our fantasy, And will not let belief take hold of him Touching this dreaded sight, twice seen of us. Therefore I have entreated him along With us to watch the minutes of this night, That if again this apparition come He may approve our eyes and speak to it.
passages.vernacular: 霍拉旭話呢只不過係我哋嘅幻想,對於我哋見過兩次嘅可怕景象,佢唔肯相信。所以我請求佢同我哋一齊守今晚嘅每一分鐘,如果呢個幽靈再出現,佢可以證實我哋嘅眼睛,並同佢講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 霍拉旭說這只不過是我們的幻想,對於我們見過兩次的可怕景象,他不肯相信。所以我請求他和我們一起守今晚的每一分鐘,如果這個幽靈再出現,他可以證實我們的眼睛,並和它說話。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Tush, tush, ’twill not appear.
passages.vernacular: 得啦得啦,佢唔會出現嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了得了,它不會出現的。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Sit down awhile, And let us once again assail your ears, That are so fortified against our story, What we two nights have seen.
passages.vernacular: 坐低一陣,讓我哋再一次向你嘅耳朵進攻,你嘅耳朵對我哋嘅故事咁固若金湯,講講我哋兩晚所見嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 坐下一陣,讓我們再一次向你的耳朵進攻,你的耳朵對我們的故事這麼固若金湯,說說我們兩晚所見的。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Well, sit we down, And let us hear Barnardo speak of this.
passages.vernacular: 好,我哋坐低,聽巴納多講呢件事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我們坐下,聽巴納多說這件事。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Last night of all, When yond same star that’s westward from the pole, Had made his course t’illume that part of heaven Where now it burns, Marcellus and myself, The bell then beating one—
passages.vernacular: 就喺琴晚,當嗰粒喺北極西邊嘅星,走完佢嘅軌道,去照亮天上佢而家燃燒嘅嗰一片,我同馬賽勒斯,鐘剛剛敲一點——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就在昨晚,當那顆在北極西邊的星,走完它的軌道,去照亮天上它現在燃燒的那一片,我和馬賽勒斯,鐘剛剛敲一點——

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Peace, break thee off. Look where it comes again.
passages.vernacular: 噓,住口。睇,佢又嚟喇。睇,佢又嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 噓,住口。看,它又來了。看,它又來了。

passages.original: Enter Ghost.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂上。]

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: In the same figure, like the King that’s dead.
passages.vernacular: 同樣嘅形象,好似死咗嘅國王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同樣的形象,像死去的國王。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Thou art a scholar; speak to it, Horatio.
passages.vernacular: 你係讀書人;同佢講嘢,霍拉旭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是讀書人;和它說話,霍拉旭。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: Looks it not like the King? Mark it, Horatio.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔似國王嗎?留意佢,霍拉旭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它不像國王嗎?留意它,霍拉旭。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Most like. It harrows me with fear and wonder.
passages.vernacular: 太似喇。我又驚又奇,心都碎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 太像了。我又怕又奇,心都碎了。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: It would be spoke to.
passages.vernacular: 佢想人同佢講嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它想人跟它說話。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Question it, Horatio.
passages.vernacular: 問佢,霍拉旭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 問它,霍拉旭。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: What art thou that usurp’st this time of night, Together with that fair and warlike form In which the majesty of buried Denmark Did sometimes march? By heaven I charge thee speak.
passages.vernacular: 你係咩,喺呢個夜深時分篡奪,連同呢個俊美好戰嘅形體,已埋葬嘅丹麥王嘅威嚴,曾經就係穿住佢行軍?我憑天命令你,講!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是什麼,在這夜深時分篡奪,連同這個俊美好戰的形體,已埋葬的丹麥王的威嚴,曾經就是穿著它行軍?我憑天命令你,說!

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: It is offended.
passages.vernacular: 佢被冒犯咗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它被冒犯了。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: See, it stalks away.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢大步走開。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,它大步走開。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Stay! speak, speak! I charge thee speak!
passages.vernacular: 企住!講,講!我命令你講!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 站住!說,說!我命令你說!

passages.original: [Exit Ghost.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂下。]

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: ’Tis gone, and will not answer.
passages.vernacular: 佢走咗,唔答。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它走了,不答。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: How now, Horatio! You tremble and look pale. Is not this something more than fantasy? What think you on’t?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,霍拉旭!你發抖,面色蒼白。呢樣嘢唔止係幻想吧?你點睇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣,霍拉旭!你發抖,面色蒼白。這件事不止是幻想吧?你怎麼看?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Before my God, I might not this believe Without the sensible and true avouch Of mine own eyes.
passages.vernacular: 憑我嘅上帝,如果冇我自己雙眼可感知同真實嘅證明,我都唔會相信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑我的上帝,如果沒我自己雙眼可感知和真實的證明,我都不會相信。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Is it not like the King?
passages.vernacular: 佢唔似國王嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它不像國王嗎?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: As thou art to thyself: Such was the very armour he had on When he th’ambitious Norway combated; So frown’d he once, when in an angry parle He smote the sledded Polacks on the ice. ’Tis strange.
passages.vernacular: 似你自己咁似:佢當年同野心勃勃嘅挪威王交戰時,就穿住嗰副盔甲;佢一度咁皺眉,就係在憤怒嘅談判中,將乘雪橇嘅波蘭人打倒在冰上嗰陣。真奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 像你自己那樣像:他當年與野心勃勃的挪威王交戰時,就穿著那副盔甲;他一度這樣皺眉,就是在憤怒的談判中,將乘雪橇的波蘭人打倒在冰上那時。真奇怪。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Thus twice before, and jump at this dead hour, With martial stalk hath he gone by our watch.
passages.vernacular: 呢次係第三次,正正在呢個死寂嘅時辰,佢帶住軍人嘅步姿經過我哋嘅崗位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是第三次,正正在這個死寂的時辰,他帶著軍人的步姿經過我們的崗位。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: In what particular thought to work I know not; But in the gross and scope of my opinion, This bodes some strange eruption to our state.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道要用咩具體嘅想法去想;不過就我大致嘅睇法,呢個預示我哋國家會發生某種奇怪嘅爆發。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道要用什麼具體的想法去想;不過就我大致的看法,這預示我們國家會發生某種奇怪的爆發。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Good now, sit down, and tell me, he that knows, Why this same strict and most observant watch So nightly toils the subject of the land, And why such daily cast of brazen cannon And foreign mart for implements of war; Why such impress of shipwrights, whose sore task Does not divide the Sunday from the week. What might be toward, that this sweaty haste Doth make the night joint-labourer with the day: Who is’t that can inform me?
passages.vernacular: 好啦,坐低,講畀我知,知道嘅人,點解呢種嚴格又非常警惕嘅守夜,每晚咁折騰國內嘅臣民,點解每日鑄造咁多銅炮,又向外國購買戰爭用具;點解徵召咁多造船工人,佢哋辛苦嘅工作唔分星期日同平日。究竟有咩事要發生,令呢種汗流浹背嘅匆忙,令夜晚同白晝並肩勞動:邊個可以告訴我?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好了,坐下,告訴我,知道的人,為什麼這種嚴格又非常警惕的守夜,每晚這樣折騰國內的臣民,為什麼每天鑄造這麼多銅炮,又向外國購買戰爭用具;為什麼徵召這麼多造船工人,他們辛苦的工作不分星期日和平日。究竟有什麼事要發生,使這種汗流浹背的匆忙,使夜晚和白晝並肩勞動:誰可以告訴我?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: That can I; At least, the whisper goes so. Our last King, Whose image even but now appear’d to us, Was, as you know, by Fortinbras of Norway, Thereto prick’d on by a most emulate pride, Dar’d to the combat; in which our valiant Hamlet, For so this side of our known world esteem’d him, Did slay this Fortinbras; who by a seal’d compact, Well ratified by law and heraldry, Did forfeit, with his life, all those his lands Which he stood seiz’d of, to the conqueror; Against the which, a moiety competent Was gaged by our King; which had return’d To the inheritance of Fortinbras, Had he been vanquisher; as by the same cov’nant And carriage of the article design’d, His fell to Hamlet. Now, sir, young Fortinbras, Of unimproved mettle, hot and full, Hath in the skirts of Norway, here and there, Shark’d up a list of lawless resolutes, For food and diet, to some enterprise That hath a stomach in’t; which is no other, As it doth well appear unto our state, But to recover of us by strong hand And terms compulsatory, those foresaid lands So by his father lost. And this, I take it, Is the main motive of our preparations, The source of this our watch, and the chief head Of this post-haste and rummage in the land.
passages.vernacular: 我可以;至少,傳聞係咁講。我哋上一任國王,佢嘅形象剛剛先向我哋出現,正如你所知,被挪威嘅福丁布拉斯,受一種最爭勝嘅驕傲驅使,向佢挑戰決鬥;喺決鬥中,我哋英勇嘅哈姆雷特(因為我哋已知世界嘅呢一邊都咁尊敬佢)殺死咗呢位福丁布拉斯;憑一份經法律同紋章官妥善批准嘅封印契約,福丁布拉斯連同生命,喪失佢所佔有嘅全部土地,歸勝利者;為此,我哋國王抵押咗相當嘅一半土地;如果福丁布拉斯得勝,嗰份土地就會歸福丁布拉斯繼承;按同一契約同條款嘅安排,佢嘅土地歸哈姆雷特。而家,先生,年輕嘅福丁布拉斯,血氣未經磨練,熱血沸騰,喺挪威邊境四處,搜羅咗一批無法無天嘅亡命之徒,為咗食同住,去做某件有膽量嘅事;佢目的,正如我哋國家清楚見到,不過係憑強力同強制條款,從我哋手中奪回佢爸爸咁樣失去嘅上述土地。而我認為,呢個就係我哋備戰嘅主要動機,我哋呢次守夜嘅源頭,同全國呢場急促搜查嘅主因。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我可以;至少,傳聞是這樣說。我們上一任國王,他的形象剛剛才向我們出現,正如你所知,被挪威的福丁布拉斯,受一種最爭勝的驕傲驅使,向他挑戰決鬥;在決鬥中,我們英勇的哈姆雷特(因為我們已知世界的這一邊都這樣尊敬他)殺死了這位福丁布拉斯;憑一份經法律和紋章官妥善批准的封印契約,福丁布拉斯連同生命,喪失他所佔有的全部土地,歸勝利者;為此,我們國王抵押了相當的一半土地;如果福丁布拉斯得勝,那份土地就會歸福丁布拉斯繼承;按同一契約和條款的安排,他的土地歸哈姆雷特。現在,先生,年輕的福丁布拉斯,血氣未經磨練,熱血沸騰,在挪威邊境四處,搜羅了一批無法無天的亡命之徒,為了吃和住,去做某件有膽量的事;他的目的,正如我們國家清楚看到,不過是憑強力和強制條款,從我們手中奪回他父親這樣失去的上述土地。而我認為,這就是我們備戰的主要動機,我們這次守夜的源頭,和全國這場急促搜查的主因。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: I think it be no other but e’en so: Well may it sort that this portentous figure Comes armed through our watch so like the King That was and is the question of these wars.
passages.vernacular: 我認為不外乎如此:呢個預兆般嘅形象帶住武裝經過我哋嘅崗位,咁似國王,國王就係呢啲戰爭嘅起因,正正合理。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認為不外乎如此:這個預兆般的形象帶著武裝經過我們的崗位,這麼像國王,國王就是這些戰爭的起因,正正合理。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: A mote it is to trouble the mind’s eye. In the most high and palmy state of Rome, A little ere the mightiest Julius fell, The graves stood tenantless and the sheeted dead Did squeak and gibber in the Roman streets; As stars with trains of fire and dews of blood, Disasters in the sun; and the moist star, Upon whose influence Neptune’s empire stands, Was sick almost to doomsday with eclipse. And even the like precurse of fierce events, As harbingers preceding still the fates And prologue to the omen coming on, Have heaven and earth together demonstrated Unto our climatures and countrymen.
passages.vernacular: 佢係一粒塵,擾亂心靈之眼。喺羅馬最崇高昌盛嘅時候,最強大嘅尤利烏斯倒下之前不久,墳墓空無一人,裹屍布嘅死者喺羅馬街頭吱吱咯咯咁叫;星帶住火焰嘅尾巴,同血嘅露水,太陽上嘅災禍;而濕潤嘅星,海神嘅帝國就仰賴佢嘅影響,因蝕病到差不多末日。甚至同樣嘅激烈事件嘅預兆,好似總係走在命運前面嘅先驅,同即將來臨嘅預兆嘅序幕,天同地一齊向我哋嘅地區同同胞顯示。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它是一粒塵,擾亂心靈之眼。在羅馬最崇高昌盛的時候,最強大的尤利烏斯倒下之前不久,墳墓空無一人,裹屍布的死者在羅馬街頭吱吱咯咯地叫;星帶著火焰的尾巴,和血的露水,太陽上的災禍;而濕潤的星,海神的帝國就仰賴它的影響,因蝕病到差不多末日。甚至同樣的激烈事件的預兆,像總是走在命運前面的先驅,和即將來臨的預兆的序幕,天和地一起向我們的地區和同胞顯示。

passages.original: Re-enter Ghost.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂再上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂再上。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: But, soft, behold! Lo, where it comes again! I’ll cross it, though it blast me. Stay, illusion! If thou hast any sound, or use of voice, Speak to me. If there be any good thing to be done, That may to thee do ease, and grace to me, Speak to me. If thou art privy to thy country’s fate, Which, happily, foreknowing may avoid, O speak! Or if thou hast uphoarded in thy life Extorted treasure in the womb of earth, For which, they say, you spirits oft walk in death, Speak of it. Stay, and speak!
passages.vernacular: 不過,輕聲,睇!睇,佢又嚟喇!我要攔住佢,即使佢會擊倒我。企住,幻象!如果你有任何聲音,或者可以發聲,同我講。如果有任何好事可以做,可以令你安樂,令我得益,同我講。如果你知道你國家嘅命運,預知可以僥倖避開,哦,講!或者,如果你生前將搜刮嘅財寶儲藏喺大地嘅子宮裡,據講你哋鬼魂為此經常在死後遊蕩,講出嚟。企住,講!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過,輕聲,看!看,它又來了!我要攔住它,即使它會擊倒我。站住,幻象!如果你有任何聲音,或者可以發聲,和我說。如果有任何好事可以做,可以使你安樂,使我得益,和我說。如果你知道你國家的命運,預知可以僥倖避開,哦,說!或者,如果你生前將搜刮的財寶儲藏在大地的子宮裡,據說你們鬼魂為此經常在死後遊蕩,說出來。站住,說!

passages.original: [The cock crows.]
passages.vernacular: [雞啼。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雞啼。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Stop it, Marcellus!
passages.vernacular: 攔住佢,馬賽勒斯!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 攔住它,馬賽勒斯!

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Shall I strike at it with my partisan?
passages.vernacular: 我可唔可以用我嘅長戟打佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我可不可以用我的長戟打它?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Do, if it will not stand.
passages.vernacular: 打,如果佢唔企住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 打,如果它不站住。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: ’Tis here!
passages.vernacular: 佢喺呢度!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它在這裡!

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: ’Tis here!
passages.vernacular: 佢喺呢度!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它在這裡!

passages.original: [Exit Ghost.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂下。]

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: ’Tis gone! We do it wrong, being so majestical, To offer it the show of violence, For it is as the air, invulnerable, And our vain blows malicious mockery.
passages.vernacular: 佢走咗!佢咁威嚴,我哋對佢使用暴力,係錯嘅,因為佢似空氣,刀槍不入,我哋嘅打擊徒勞,只係惡意嘅嘲弄。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它走了!它這麼威嚴,我們對它使用暴力,是錯的,因為它像空氣,刀槍不入,我們的打擊徒勞,只是惡意的嘲弄。

passages.title: Barnardo 巴納多
passages.original: It was about to speak, when the cock crew.
passages.vernacular: 佢正要講,雞就啼喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它正要說,雞就啼了。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: And then it started, like a guilty thing Upon a fearful summons. I have heard The cock, that is the trumpet to the morn, Doth with his lofty and shrill-sounding throat Awake the god of day; and at his warning, Whether in sea or fire, in earth or air, Th’extravagant and erring spirit hies To his confine. And of the truth herein This present object made probation.
passages.vernacular: 然後佢嚇一跳,好似犯罪嘅東西聽到可怕嘅傳召。我聽講,雞,即係晨光嘅號角,用佢高亢尖銳嘅喉嚨喚醒白晝之神;聽到佢嘅警告,無論在海或火、地或空氣,四處遊蕩嘅幽靈都趕返佢嘅居所。而呢個景象為此中真相提供咗證明。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後它嚇一跳,好像犯罪的東西聽到可怕的傳召。我聽說,雞,就是晨光的號角,用它高亢尖銳的喉嚨喚醒白晝之神;聽到它的警告,無論在海或火、地或空氣,四處遊蕩的幽靈都趕回它的居所。而這個景象為此中真相提供了證明。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: It faded on the crowing of the cock. Some say that ever ’gainst that season comes Wherein our Saviour’s birth is celebrated, The bird of dawning singeth all night long; And then, they say, no spirit dare stir abroad, The nights are wholesome, then no planets strike, No fairy takes, nor witch hath power to charm; So hallow’d and so gracious is the time.
passages.vernacular: 佢喺雞啼時消失。有人講,每到慶祝我哋救主誕生嘅季節,黎明之鳥整夜歌唱;然後,佢哋講,冇鬼魂敢出外走動,夜晚有益健康,星辰唔會作祟,仙子唔會施法,女巫冇力量施魔法;呢個時候咁神聖咁有恩典。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它在雞啼時消失。有人說,每到慶祝我們救主誕生的季節,黎明之鳥整夜歌唱;然後,他們說,沒鬼魂敢出外走動,夜晚有益健康,星辰不會作祟,仙子不會施法,女巫沒力量施魔法;這個時候這樣神聖這樣有恩典。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: So have I heard, and do in part believe it. But look, the morn in russet mantle clad, Walks o’er the dew of yon high eastward hill. Break we our watch up, and by my advice, Let us impart what we have seen tonight Unto young Hamlet; for upon my life, This spirit, dumb to us, will speak to him. Do you consent we shall acquaint him with it, As needful in our loves, fitting our duty?
passages.vernacular: 我也咁聽講,並且部分相信。不過睇,披住赤褐色斗篷嘅早晨,行過東邊嗰座高山嘅露水。我哋散更啦,聽我嘅建議,將我哋今晚所見嘅,告訴年輕嘅哈姆雷特;因為憑我嘅命,呢個對我哋啞口嘅鬼魂,會同佢講話。你同唔同意我哋向佢通報,基於我哋嘅愛,係必要嘅,符合我哋嘅職責?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也這樣聽說,並且部分相信。不過看,披著赤褐色斗篷的早晨,走過東邊那座高山的露水。我們散更吧,聽我的建議,將我們今晚所見的,告訴年輕的哈姆雷特;因為憑我的命,這個對我們啞口的鬼魂,會跟他說話。你同不同意我們向他通報,基於我們的愛,是必要的,符合我們的職責?

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Let’s do’t, I pray, and I this morning know Where we shall find him most conveniently.
passages.vernacular: 我哋去做啦,請你,我今朝知道我哋可以喺邊度最方便咁找到佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們去做吧,請你,我今早知道我們可以在哪裡最方便地找到他。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act I, Scene II — A Room of State 第一幕第二場:朝堂

passages.original: Enter Claudius King of Denmark, Gertrude the Queen, Hamlet, Polonius, Laertes, Voltemand, Cornelius, Lords and Attendant.
passages.vernacular: [國王克勞狄斯、王后葛楚德、哈姆雷特、波洛涅斯、雷歐提斯、沃爾提曼德、科尼利厄斯、眾貴族同侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [國王克勞狄斯、王后葛楚德、哈姆雷特、波洛涅斯、雷歐提斯、沃爾提曼德、科尼利厄斯、眾貴族和侍從上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Though yet of Hamlet our dear brother’s death The memory be green, and that it us befitted To bear our hearts in grief, and our whole kingdom To be contracted in one brow of woe; Yet so far hath discretion fought with nature That we with wisest sorrow think on him, Together with remembrance of ourselves. Therefore our sometime sister, now our queen, Th’imperial jointress to this warlike state, Have we, as ’twere with a defeated joy, With one auspicious and one dropping eye, With mirth in funeral, and with dirge in marriage, In equal scale weighing delight and dole, Taken to wife; nor have we herein barr’d Your better wisdoms, which have freely gone With this affair along. For all, our thanks. Now follows, that you know young Fortinbras, Holding a weak supposal of our worth, Or thinking by our late dear brother’s death Our state to be disjoint and out of frame, Colleagued with this dream of his advantage, He hath not fail’d to pester us with message, Importing the surrender of those lands Lost by his father, with all bonds of law, To our most valiant brother. So much for him. Now for ourself and for this time of meeting: Thus much the business is: we have here writ To Norway, uncle of young Fortinbras, Who, impotent and bed-rid, scarcely hears Of this his nephew’s purpose, to suppress His further gait herein; in that the levies, The lists, and full proportions are all made Out of his subject: and we here dispatch You, good Cornelius, and you, Voltemand, For bearers of this greeting to old Norway, Giving to you no further personal power To business with the King, more than the scope Of these dilated articles allow. Farewell; and let your haste commend your duty.
passages.vernacular: 雖然我哋親愛嘅王兄哈姆雷特嘅死,記憶仍然鮮活,我哋本應心懷悲痛,整個王國本應同聚一個哀愁嘅眉頭;不過理智同天性搏鬥到咁上下,以致我哋帶住最明智嘅哀傷去思念佢,同時也記住我哋自己。所以我哋嘅前任姐妹,而家嘅王后,呢個好戰國家嘅共同繼承人,我哋已娶佢為妻,好似帶住被擊敗嘅喜悅,一隻眼帶吉兆,一隻眼滴淚,喪禮中有歡笑,婚禮中有輓歌,將歡樂同悲哀放喺均等嘅秤上;我哋喺此事上亦冇阻礙你哋更好嘅智慧,你哋已經自由咁同意呢件事。所有人,我哋多謝。接住要講嘅係:你哋知道年輕嘅福丁布拉斯,對我哋嘅價值抱薄弱嘅假設,或者以為憑我哋已故親愛王兄嘅死,我哋嘅國家會脫節、失序,同佢呢個對自己有利嘅夢想結盟,佢不斷用訊息煩擾我哋,要求將佢爸爸以全部法律契約所失去嘅土地,歸還畀我哋最英勇嘅王兄。對佢嘅事就講到呢度。而家講我自己同呢次會面:事情就係咁:我哋已寫信畀挪威,即年輕福丁布拉斯嘅叔父,佢無力又臥床,幾乎聽唔到佢姪仔嘅意圖,要壓制佢呢方面嘅進一步行動;因為徵兵、名冊同全部人數都來自佢嘅臣民:所以我哋喺此派遣你,好科尼利厄斯,同你,沃爾提曼德,作為向老挪威王傳達呢個問候嘅使者,除咗呢啲擴充條款所允許嘅範圍,畀你哋冇更多個人權力去同國王商議事務。再見;讓你哋嘅匆忙彰顯你哋嘅職責。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雖然我們親愛的王兄哈姆雷特的死,記憶仍然鮮活,我們本應心懷悲痛,整個王國本應共聚一個哀愁的眉頭;不過理智和天性搏鬥到這種程度,以致我們帶著最明智的哀傷去思念他,同時也記住我們自己。所以我們的前任姐妹,現在的王后,這個好戰國家的共同繼承人,我們已娶她為妻,好像帶著被擊敗的喜悅,一隻眼帶吉兆,一隻眼滴淚,喪禮中有歡笑,婚禮中有輓歌,將歡樂和悲哀放在均等的秤上;我們在此事上也沒阻礙你們更好的智慧,你們已經自由地同意這件事。所有人,我們多謝。接著要說的是:你們知道年輕的福丁布拉斯,對我們的價值抱薄弱的假設,或者以為憑我們已故親愛王兄的死,我們的國家會脫節、失序,與他這個對自己有利的夢想結盟,他不斷用訊息煩擾我們,要求將他父親以全部法律契約所失去的土地,歸還給我們最英勇的王兄。對他的事就說到這裡。現在說我自己和這次會面:事情就是這樣:我們已寫信給挪威,即年輕福丁布拉斯的叔父,他無力又臥床,幾乎聽不到他姪子的意圖,要壓制他這方面的進一步行動;因為徵兵、名冊和全部人數都來自他的臣民:所以我們在此派遣你,好科尼利厄斯,和你,沃爾提曼德,作為向老挪威王傳達這個問候的使者,除了這些擴充條款所允許的範圍,給你們沒更多個人權力去與國王商議事務。再見;讓你們的匆忙彰顯你們的職責。

passages.title: Cornelius And Voltemand 科尼利厄斯同沃爾提曼德
passages.original: In that, and all things, will we show our duty.
passages.vernacular: 在呢件同所有事上,我哋都會顯示我哋嘅職責。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這件和所有事上,我們都會顯示我們的職責。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: We doubt it nothing: heartily farewell.
passages.vernacular: 我哋毫不懷疑:衷心再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們毫不懷疑:衷心再見。

passages.original: [Exeunt Voltemand and Cornelius.]
passages.vernacular: [沃爾提曼德同科尼利厄斯下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [沃爾提曼德和科尼利厄斯下。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: And now, Laertes, what’s the news with you? You told us of some suit. What is’t, Laertes? You cannot speak of reason to the Dane, And lose your voice. What wouldst thou beg, Laertes, That shall not be my offer, not thy asking? The head is not more native to the heart, The hand more instrumental to the mouth, Than is the throne of Denmark to thy father. What wouldst thou have, Laertes?
passages.vernacular: 而家,雷歐提斯,你有咩消息?你同我哋講過有個請求。係咩,雷歐提斯?你同丹麥王講合理嘅事,唔會白費口舌。雷歐提斯,你想求咩,而唔係我主動提供、唔係你開口要求?頭對心唔會更天然,手對口唔會更有用,比丹麥嘅王位對你爸爸更加。你想要咩,雷歐提斯?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,雷歐提斯,你有什麼消息?你跟我們說過有個請求。是什麼,雷歐提斯?你對丹麥王說合理的事,不會白費口舌。雷歐提斯,你想求什麼,而不是我主動提供、不是你開口要求?頭對心不會更天然,手對口不會更有用,比丹麥的王位對你父親更加。你想要什麼,雷歐提斯?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Dread my lord, Your leave and favour to return to France, From whence though willingly I came to Denmark To show my duty in your coronation; Yet now I must confess, that duty done, My thoughts and wishes bend again toward France, And bow them to your gracious leave and pardon.
passages.vernacular: 令人敬畏嘅陛下,請你准許並賜恩,讓我返法國,雖然我從嗰度情願返丹麥,為咗喺你加冕時顯示我嘅職責;不過而家我必須承認,職責完成後,我嘅思想同願望再次轉向法國,並向你慈善嘅准許同寬恕低頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 令人敬畏的陛下,請你准許並賜恩,讓我回法國,雖然我從那裡情願回丹麥,為了在你加冕時顯示我的職責;不過現在我必須承認,職責完成後,我的思想和願望再次轉向法國,並向你慈善的准許和寬恕低頭。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Have you your father’s leave? What says Polonius?
passages.vernacular: 你有你爸爸嘅准許嗎?波洛涅斯點講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你有你父親的准許嗎?波洛涅斯怎麼說?

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: He hath, my lord, wrung from me my slow leave By laboursome petition; and at last Upon his will I seal’d my hard consent. I do beseech you give him leave to go.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,佢用辛苦嘅懇求從我手中擰出我緩慢嘅准許;最後我喺佢嘅意願上蓋咗我艱難嘅同意印章。我懇求你准許佢去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,他用辛苦的懇求從我手中擰出我緩慢的准許;最後我在他的意願上蓋了我艱難的同意印章。我懇求你准許他去。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Take thy fair hour, Laertes; time be thine, And thy best graces spend it at thy will! But now, my cousin Hamlet, and my son—
passages.vernacular: 把握你嘅好時光,雷歐提斯;時間屬於你,願你最好嘅優雅隨你意願去花費!不過而家,我嘅堂侄哈姆雷特,同我嘅兒子——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把握你的好時光,雷歐提斯;時間屬於你,願你最好的優雅隨你意願去花費!不過現在,我的堂侄哈姆雷特,和我的兒子——

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: [Aside.] A little more than kin, and less than kind.
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]比親戚多少少,卻唔係同類。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]比親戚多一點,卻不是同類。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: How is it that the clouds still hang on you?
passages.vernacular: 點解雲仲掛喺你身上?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼雲仍掛在你身上?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Not so, my lord, I am too much i’ the sun.
passages.vernacular: 唔係,陛下,我太多喺太陽裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是,陛下,我太多在太陽裡。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Good Hamlet, cast thy nighted colour off, And let thine eye look like a friend on Denmark. Do not for ever with thy vailed lids Seek for thy noble father in the dust. Thou know’st ’tis common, all that lives must die, Passing through nature to eternity.
passages.vernacular: 好哈姆雷特,拋開你嘅黑夜色彩,讓你嘅眼睛好似朋友般望住丹麥。唔好永遠用你垂下嘅眼皮喺塵土裡尋找你高貴嘅爸爸。你知道呢係平常事,所有活著嘅都必須死,穿過自然去到永恆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好哈姆雷特,拋開你的黑夜色彩,讓你的眼睛像朋友般望著丹麥。不要永遠用你垂下的眼皮在塵土裡尋找你高貴的父親。你知道這是平常事,所有活著的都必須死,穿過自然去到永恆。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Ay, madam, it is common.
passages.vernacular: 係,母后,係平常事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,母后,是平常事。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: If it be, Why seems it so particular with thee?
passages.vernacular: 如果係,點解對你似乎咁特別?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是,為什麼對你似乎這麼特別?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Seems, madam! Nay, it is; I know not seems. ’Tis not alone my inky cloak, good mother, Nor customary suits of solemn black, Nor windy suspiration of forc’d breath, No, nor the fruitful river in the eye, Nor the dejected haviour of the visage, Together with all forms, moods, shows of grief, That can denote me truly. These indeed seem, For they are actions that a man might play; But I have that within which passeth show; These but the trappings and the suits of woe.
passages.vernacular: 似乎,母后!唔,係咁;我唔知咩叫似乎。好母親,唔單止係我墨黑嘅斗篷,亦唔係慣常嘅莊嚴黑衣,亦唔係強迫呼吸嘅刮風嘆息,唔,亦唔係眼中豐盛嘅河流,亦唔係臉上沮喪嘅神態,連同所有悲傷嘅形式、情緒、表演,可以真正表示我。呢啲確實似乎,因為佢哋係人可以扮演嘅行為;不過我內裡有超越表演嘅東西;呢啲只係哀傷嘅裝飾同衣裳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 似乎,母后!不,是這樣;我不知什麼叫似乎。好母親,不僅是我墨黑的斗篷,也不是慣常的莊嚴黑衣,也不是強迫呼吸的刮風嘆息,不,也不是眼中豐盛的河流,也不是臉上沮喪的神態,連同所有悲傷的形式、情緒、表演,可以真正表示我。這些確實似乎,因為它們是人可以扮演的行為;不過我內裡有超越表演的東西;這些只是哀傷的裝飾和衣裳。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: ’Tis sweet and commendable in your nature, Hamlet, To give these mourning duties to your father; But you must know, your father lost a father, That father lost, lost his, and the survivor bound In filial obligation, for some term To do obsequious sorrow. But to persevere In obstinate condolement is a course Of impious stubbornness. ’Tis unmanly grief, It shows a will most incorrect to heaven, A heart unfortified, a mind impatient, An understanding simple and unschool’d; For what we know must be, and is as common As any the most vulgar thing to sense, Why should we in our peevish opposition Take it to heart? Fie, ’tis a fault to heaven, A fault against the dead, a fault to nature, To reason most absurd, whose common theme Is death of fathers, and who still hath cried, From the first corse till he that died today, ‘This must be so.’ We pray you throw to earth This unprevailing woe, and think of us As of a father; for let the world take note You are the most immediate to our throne, And with no less nobility of love Than that which dearest father bears his son Do I impart toward you. For your intent In going back to school in Wittenberg, It is most retrograde to our desire: And we beseech you bend you to remain Here in the cheer and comfort of our eye, Our chiefest courtier, cousin, and our son.
passages.vernacular: 哈姆雷特,你嘅天性甜美值得稱讚,為你爸爸做呢啲哀悼嘅職責;不過你必須知道,你爸爸失去過一個爸爸,嗰個爸爸失去過佢嘅爸爸,而生存者作為兒子有責任,喺某段時間內做恭順嘅哀傷。不過堅持固執嘅哀悼,係不敬嘅頑固。佢係唔似男人嘅悲傷,顯示對天嘅意志極不端正,一顆未設防嘅心,一個不耐煩嘅頭腦,一份單純未受教育嘅理解;因為我哋知道必然會發生、而且同感官最平凡嘅事一樣普通嘅,點解我哋要用我哋任性嘅反抗放在心上?呸,呢係對天嘅過失,對死者嘅過失,對自然嘅過失,對理性最荒謬,理性嘅普通主題就係父親嘅死,從第一具屍體到今日死去嘅人,一直喊:「必然係咁。」我哋請你將呢種徒勞嘅悲痛拋落地上,將我哋當作父親;因為讓世界注意,你係最接近我哋王位嘅人,我對你嘅愛嘅高貴,不亞於最親愛嘅父親對兒子嘅。至於你打算返威登堡讀書,呢個最違背我哋嘅願望:我哋懇求你屈就留喺度,在我哋眼前嘅歡樂同安慰之中,我哋最重要嘅臣子、堂侄同兒子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈姆雷特,你的天性甜美值得稱讚,為你父親做這些哀悼的職責;不過你必須知道,你父親失去過一個父親,那個父親失去過他的父親,而生存者作為兒子有責任,在某段時間內做恭順的哀傷。不過堅持固執的哀悼,是不敬的頑固。它是不像男人的悲傷,顯示對天的意志極不端正,一顆未設防的心,一個不耐煩的頭腦,一份單純未受教育的理解;因為我們知道必然會發生、而且與感官最平凡的事一樣普通的,為什麼我們要用我們任性的反抗放在心上?呸,這是對天的過失,對死者的過失,對自然的過失,對理性最荒謬,理性的普通主題就是父親的死,從第一具屍體到今天死去的人,一直喊:「必然是這樣。」我們請你將這種徒勞的悲痛拋在地上,將我們當作父親;因為讓世界注意,你是最接近我們王位的人,我對你的愛的高貴,不亞於最親愛的父親對兒子的。至於你打算回威登堡讀書,這最違背我們的願望:我們懇求你屈就留在這裡,在我們眼前的歡樂和安慰之中,我們最重要的臣子、堂侄和兒子。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Let not thy mother lose her prayers, Hamlet. I pray thee stay with us; go not to Wittenberg.
passages.vernacular: 唔好讓你媽媽嘅祈求落空,哈姆雷特。我求你留低同我哋一齊;唔好去威登堡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要讓你母親的祈求落空,哈姆雷特。我求你留下與我們一起;不要去威登堡。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I shall in all my best obey you, madam.
passages.vernacular: 母后,我會盡我所能服從你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 母后,我會盡我所能服從你。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Why, ’tis a loving and a fair reply. Be as ourself in Denmark. Madam, come; This gentle and unforc’d accord of Hamlet Sits smiling to my heart; in grace whereof, No jocund health that Denmark drinks today But the great cannon to the clouds shall tell, And the King’s rouse the heaven shall bruit again, Re-speaking earthly thunder. Come away.
passages.vernacular: 嗯,呢個係有愛同美好嘅回答。喺丹麥同我哋自己一樣吧。王后,來;哈姆雷特呢個溫柔而唔勉強嘅同意,喺我心中微笑;為咗紀念呢點,丹麥今日所飲嘅每一杯歡快嘅祝酒,大炮都會向雲霄報告,國王嘅痛飲,天會再次宣告,重複地上嘅雷聲。來啦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 嗯,這是有愛和美好的回答。在丹麥與我們自己一樣吧。王后,來;哈姆雷特這個溫柔而不勉強的同意,在我心中微笑;為了紀念這點,丹麥今日所飲的每一杯歡快的祝酒,大炮都會向雲霄報告,國王的痛飲,天會再次宣告,重複地上的雷聲。來吧。

passages.original: [Exeunt all but Hamlet.]
passages.vernacular: [除哈姆雷特外,眾人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [除哈姆雷特外,眾人下。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O that this too too solid flesh would melt, Thaw, and resolve itself into a dew! Or that the Everlasting had not fix’d His canon ’gainst self-slaughter. O God! O God! How weary, stale, flat, and unprofitable Seem to me all the uses of this world! Fie on’t! Oh fie! ’tis an unweeded garden That grows to seed; things rank and gross in nature Possess it merely. That it should come to this! But two months dead—nay, not so much, not two: So excellent a king; that was to this Hyperion to a satyr; so loving to my mother, That he might not beteem the winds of heaven Visit her face too roughly. Heaven and earth! Must I remember? Why, she would hang on him As if increase of appetite had grown By what it fed on; and yet, within a month— Let me not think on’t—Frailty, thy name is woman! A little month, or ere those shoes were old With which she followed my poor father’s body Like Niobe, all tears.—Why she, even she— O God! A beast that wants discourse of reason Would have mourn’d longer,—married with mine uncle, My father’s brother; but no more like my father Than I to Hercules. Within a month, Ere yet the salt of most unrighteous tears Had left the flushing in her galled eyes, She married. O most wicked speed, to post With such dexterity to incestuous sheets! It is not, nor it cannot come to good. But break, my heart, for I must hold my tongue.
passages.vernacular: 啊,願呢個太太太堅實嘅肉身融化,解凍,化成一滴露水!或者願永恆嘅主冇定下佢禁止自殺嘅律法。啊上帝!啊上帝!呢個世界所有嘅用途,對我嚟講幾疲倦、乏味、平淡、無益!呸!啊呸!佢係一個冇除草嘅花園,長滿種子;粗劣下流嘅東西完全佔有佢。竟然到咗呢個地步!死咗只有兩個月——唔,冇咁多,冇兩個月:咁優秀嘅國王;佢同呢個人相比,好似太陽神對半羊人;咁愛我媽媽,以致佢唔准天上嘅風太粗暴咁吹拂佢嘅臉。天啊地啊!我必須記得嗎?點解,佢會掛喺佢身上,好似食慾因所食而增長;然而,一個月內——唔好叫我想——脆弱,你嘅名字就係女人!短短一個月,或者佢跟隨我可憐爸爸嘅遺體嗰雙鞋仲未舊,好似尼俄伯,全部係眼淚——點解佢,甚至佢——啊上帝!一隻欠缺理性推理嘅畜生都會哀悼更久——嫁畀我叔叔,我爸爸嘅兄弟;不過同我爸爸唔相似,好似我同赫拉克勒斯一樣。一個月內,最不義嘅眼淚嘅鹽份仲未從佢紅腫嘅眼睛離開,佢就結婚咗。啊最邪惡嘅速度,咁敏捷咁趕去亂倫嘅床單!呢個唔係,亦唔可能有好結果。不過碎吧,我嘅心,因為我必須收聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,願這個太太太堅實的肉身融化,解凍,化成一滴露水!或者願永恆的主沒定下他禁止自殺的律法。啊上帝!啊上帝!這個世界所有的用途,對我來說多疲倦、乏味、平淡、無益!呸!啊呸!它是一個沒除草的花園,長滿種子;粗劣下流的東西完全佔有它。竟然到了這個地步!死了只有兩個月——不,沒這麼多,沒兩個月:這麼優秀的國王;他和這個人相比,像太陽神對半羊人;這麼愛我母親,以致他不准天上的風太粗暴地吹拂她的臉。天啊地啊!我必須記得嗎?為什麼,她會掛在他身上,好像食慾因所食而增長;然而,一個月內——不要叫我想——脆弱,你的名字就是女人!短短一個月,或者她跟隨我可憐父親的遺體那雙鞋還未舊,像尼俄伯,全部是眼淚——為什麼她,甚至她——啊上帝!一隻欠缺理性推理的畜生都會哀悼更久——嫁給我叔叔,我父親的兄弟;不過與我父親不相似,像我與赫拉克勒斯一樣。一個月內,最不義的眼淚的鹽分還未從她紅腫的眼睛離開,她就結婚了。啊最邪惡的速度,這麼敏捷地趕去亂倫的床單!這不是,也不可能有好結果。不過碎吧,我的心,因為我必須閉口。

passages.original: Enter Horatio, Marcellus and Barnardo.
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭、馬賽勒斯同巴納多上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭、馬賽勒斯和巴納多上。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Hail to your lordship!
passages.vernacular: 向殿下問好!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向殿下問好!

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I am glad to see you well: Horatio, or I do forget myself.
passages.vernacular: 見到你好,我好高興:霍拉旭,或者我忘記咗自己。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 見到你好,我很高興:霍拉旭,或者我忘記了自己。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: The same, my lord, And your poor servant ever.
passages.vernacular: 正是我,殿下,永遠係你可憐嘅僕人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是我,殿下,永遠是你可憐的僕人。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Sir, my good friend; I’ll change that name with you: And what make you from Wittenberg, Horatio?— Marcellus?
passages.vernacular: 先生,我嘅好朋友;我同你交換呢個稱呼:霍拉旭,你從威登堡來做咩?——馬賽勒斯?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,我的好朋友;我與你交換這個稱呼:霍拉旭,你從威登堡來做什麼?——馬賽勒斯?

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: My good lord.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅好殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的好殿下。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I am very glad to see you.—Good even, sir.— But what, in faith, make you from Wittenberg?
passages.vernacular: 我好高興見到你。——先生,晚安。——不過老實講,你從威登堡來做咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興見到你。——先生,晚安。——不過老實說,你從威登堡來做什麼?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: A truant disposition, good my lord.
passages.vernacular: 好殿下,一種逃學嘅性情。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好殿下,一種逃學的性情。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I would not hear your enemy say so; Nor shall you do my ear that violence, To make it truster of your own report Against yourself. I know you are no truant. But what is your affair in Elsinore? We’ll teach you to drink deep ere you depart.
passages.vernacular: 我唔想聽你嘅敵人咁講;你亦唔好用呢種暴力對我嘅耳朵,令佢更信任你自己對你自己嘅報告。我知道你唔係逃學嘅人。不過你喺艾爾西諾有咩事?我哋會教你喺離開前痛飲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不想聽你的敵人這樣說;你也不要用這種暴力對我的耳朵,使它更信任你自己對你自己的報告。我知道你不是逃學的人。不過你在艾爾西諾有什麼事?我們會教你在離開前痛飲。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: My lord, I came to see your father’s funeral.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,我係嚟睇你爸爸嘅葬禮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,我是來看你父親的葬禮。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I prithee do not mock me, fellow-student. I think it was to see my mother’s wedding.
passages.vernacular: 求你,同學,唔好取笑我。我諗你係嚟睇我媽媽嘅婚禮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 求你,同學,不要取笑我。我想你是來看我母親的婚禮。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Indeed, my lord, it follow’d hard upon.
passages.vernacular: 確實,殿下,婚禮緊隨其後。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實,殿下,婚禮緊隨其後。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Thrift, thrift, Horatio! The funeral bak’d meats Did coldly furnish forth the marriage tables. Would I had met my dearest foe in heaven Or ever I had seen that day, Horatio. My father,—methinks I see my father.
passages.vernacular: 節儉,節儉,霍拉旭!喪禮嘅烤肉,冷冷咁用來擺婚宴嘅枱。霍拉旭,我寧願喺天堂遇到我最親愛嘅敵人,都唔想見到嗰一日。我爸爸——我覺得見到我爸爸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 節儉,節儉,霍拉旭!喪禮的烤肉,冷冷地用來擺婚宴的桌。霍拉旭,我寧願在天堂遇到我最親愛的敵人,也不想見到那一天。我父親——我覺得看到我父親。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Where, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 喺邊度,殿下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在哪裡,殿下?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: In my mind’s eye, Horatio.
passages.vernacular: 喺我心靈嘅眼中,霍拉旭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在我心靈的眼中,霍拉旭。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: I saw him once; he was a goodly king.
passages.vernacular: 我見過佢一次;佢係個好國王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我見過他一次;他是個好國王。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: He was a man, take him for all in all, I shall not look upon his like again.
passages.vernacular: 佢係一個人,從各方面來講,我永遠唔會再見到似佢嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他是一個人,從各方面來說,我永遠不會再看到像他的人。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: My lord, I think I saw him yesternight.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,我想我琴晚見到佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,我想我昨晚見到他。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Saw? Who?
passages.vernacular: 見到?邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 見到?誰?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: My lord, the King your father.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,國王,你嘅爸爸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,國王,你的父親。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: The King my father!
passages.vernacular: 國王,我嘅爸爸!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 國王,我的父親!

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Season your admiration for a while With an attent ear, till I may deliver Upon the witness of these gentlemen This marvel to you.
passages.vernacular: 暫時克制你嘅驚訝,用專注嘅耳朵聽,等我憑呢幾位先生嘅證詞,向你講述呢件奇事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 暫時克制你的驚訝,用專注的耳朵聽,等我憑這幾位先生的證詞,向你講述這件奇事。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: For God’s love let me hear.
passages.vernacular: 為咗上帝嘅愛,讓我聽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了上帝的愛,讓我聽。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Two nights together had these gentlemen, Marcellus and Barnardo, on their watch In the dead waste and middle of the night, Been thus encounter’d. A figure like your father, Armed at point exactly, cap-à-pie, Appears before them, and with solemn march Goes slow and stately by them: thrice he walk’d By their oppress’d and fear-surprised eyes, Within his truncheon’s length; whilst they, distill’d Almost to jelly with the act of fear, Stand dumb, and speak not to him. This to me In dreadful secrecy impart they did, And I with them the third night kept the watch, Where, as they had deliver’d, both in time, Form of the thing, each word made true and good, The apparition comes. I knew your father; These hands are not more like.
passages.vernacular: 呢兩位先生,馬賽勒斯同巴納多,連續兩晚在死寂荒涼嘅半夜守夜時,遇到咁樣嘅情況。一個似你爸爸嘅形象,全副武裝,從頭到腳,出現喺佢哋面前,帶住莊嚴嘅步伐緩慢威嚴咁從佢哋身邊走過:三次佢走過佢哋被壓迫、被恐懼驚嚇嘅眼睛,在佢權杖嘅長度之內;而佢哋,因為恐懼嘅行為差不多被蒸餾成果凍,站住啞口,唔同佢講話。呢件事佢哋喺可怕嘅秘密中告訴我,我同佢哋第三晚守夜,在嗰度,正如佢哋所講,時間、形體、每個字都屬實,幽靈就出現。我認識你爸爸;呢雙手都唔及佢咁相似。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這兩位先生,馬賽勒斯和巴納多,連續兩晚在死寂荒涼的半夜守夜時,遇到這樣的情況。一個像你父親的形象,全副武裝,從頭到腳,出現在他們面前,帶著莊嚴的步伐緩慢威嚴地從他們身邊走過:三次他走過他們被壓迫、被恐懼驚嚇的眼睛,在他權杖的長度之內;而他們,因為恐懼的行為差不多被蒸餾成果凍,站著啞口,不跟他說話。這件事他們在可怕的祕密中告訴我,我與他們第三晚守夜,在那裡,正如他們所說,時間、形體、每個字都屬實,幽靈就出現。我認識你父親;這雙手都不及他這麼相似。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: But where was this?
passages.vernacular: 不過呢件事喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過這件事在哪裡?

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: My lord, upon the platform where we watch.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,在我哋守夜嘅平台上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,在我們守夜的平台上。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Did you not speak to it?
passages.vernacular: 你冇同佢講話嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你沒跟他說話嗎?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: My lord, I did; But answer made it none: yet once methought It lifted up it head, and did address Itself to motion, like as it would speak. But even then the morning cock crew loud, And at the sound it shrunk in haste away, And vanish’d from our sight.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,我有;不過佢冇回答:不過我覺得有一次佢抬起頭,作出動作,好似想講話。不過就喺嗰時晨雞大聲啼叫,聽到聲音佢匆忙縮走,從我哋視線消失。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,我說了;不過他沒回答:不過我覺得有一次他抬起頭,作出動作,好像想說話。不過就在那時晨雞大聲啼叫,聽到聲音他匆忙縮走,從我們視線消失。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: ’Tis very strange.
passages.vernacular: 好奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很奇怪。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: As I do live, my honour’d lord, ’tis true; And we did think it writ down in our duty To let you know of it.
passages.vernacular: 我憑我嘅生命發誓,尊貴嘅殿下,係真嘅;我哋認為通知你係我哋職責所載。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我憑我的生命發誓,尊貴的殿下,是真的;我們認為通知你是我們職責所載。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Indeed, indeed, sirs, but this troubles me. Hold you the watch tonight?
passages.vernacular: 確實,確實,各位先生,不過呢件事令我不安。你哋今晚守夜嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實,確實,各位先生,不過這件事使我不安。你們今晚守夜嗎?

passages.title: Marcellus And Barnardo 馬賽勒斯同巴納多
passages.original: We do, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 係,殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,殿下。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Arm’d, say you?
passages.vernacular: 你話佢全副武裝?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說他全副武裝?

passages.title: Both 兩人
passages.original: Arm’d, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 全副武裝,殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 全副武裝,殿下。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: From top to toe?
passages.vernacular: 從頭到腳?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從頭到腳?

passages.title: Both 兩人
passages.original: My lord, from head to foot.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,從頭到腳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,從頭到腳。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Then saw you not his face?
passages.vernacular: 咁你冇見到佢嘅臉?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那你沒看到他的臉?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: O yes, my lord, he wore his beaver up.
passages.vernacular: 啊有,殿下,佢將面甲揭起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊有,殿下,他將面甲揭起。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: What, look’d he frowningly?
passages.vernacular: 點,佢皺眉嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣,他皺眉嗎?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: A countenance more in sorrow than in anger.
passages.vernacular: 一副悲傷多過憤怒嘅面容。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一副悲傷多過憤怒的面容。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Pale, or red?
passages.vernacular: 蒼白,還係紅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 蒼白,還是紅?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Nay, very pale.
passages.vernacular: 唔,非常蒼白。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,非常蒼白。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: And fix’d his eyes upon you?
passages.vernacular: 佢將眼睛定喺你身上?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他將眼睛定在你身上?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Most constantly.
passages.vernacular: 非常堅定。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常堅定。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I would I had been there.
passages.vernacular: 我真係希望我喺嗰度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我真希望我在那裡。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: It would have much amaz’d you.
passages.vernacular: 佢會令你大吃一驚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它會使你大吃一驚。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Very like, very like. Stay’d it long?
passages.vernacular: 好可能,好可能。佢停留咗好耐嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很可能,很可能。他停留了很久嗎?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: While one with moderate haste might tell a hundred.
passages.vernacular: 大概一個人以中等速度數一百下嘅時間。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大概一個人以中等速度數一百下的時間。

passages.title: Marcellus And Barnardo 馬賽勒斯同巴納多
passages.original: Longer, longer.
passages.vernacular: 更耐,更耐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 更久,更久。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Not when I saw’t.
passages.vernacular: 我見到嗰陣唔係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看到那時不是。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: His beard was grizzled, no?
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅鬍鬚係灰白,係唔係?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的鬍鬚是灰白,是不是?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: It was, as I have seen it in his life, A sable silver’d.
passages.vernacular: 同佢生前我見過嘅一樣,黑色夾銀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 和他生前我見過的一樣,黑色夾銀。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I will watch tonight; Perchance ’twill walk again.
passages.vernacular: 我今晚會去守夜;也許佢會再出現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我今晚會去守夜;也許它會再出現。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: I warrant you it will.
passages.vernacular: 我保證佢會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我保證它會。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: If it assume my noble father’s person, I’ll speak to it, though hell itself should gape And bid me hold my peace. I pray you all, If you have hitherto conceal’d this sight, Let it be tenable in your silence still; And whatsoever else shall hap tonight, Give it an understanding, but no tongue. I will requite your loves. So, fare ye well. Upon the platform ’twixt eleven and twelve, I’ll visit you.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢扮成我高貴爸爸嘅樣子,我會同佢講話,即使地獄本身張開口,叫我閉嘴。我求你哋大家,如果你哋迄今隱瞞咗呢個景象,讓佢繼續保持在你哋嘅沉默中;今晚無論發生咩其他事,畀佢理解,但唔好畀佢舌頭。我會報答你哋嘅愛。咁,再見。十一點同十二點之間,我會喺平台探你哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果它扮成我高貴父親的樣子,我會跟它說話,即使地獄本身張開口,叫我閉嘴。我求你們大家,如果你們迄今隱瞞了這個景象,讓它繼續保持在你們的沉默中;今晚無論發生什麼其他事,給它理解,但不要給它舌頭。我會報答你們的愛。那麼,再見。十一點和十二點之間,我會在平台探你們。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Our duty to your honour.
passages.vernacular: 我哋向你嘅尊貴盡職。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們向你的尊貴盡職。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Your loves, as mine to you: farewell.
passages.vernacular: 你哋嘅愛,正如我對你哋嘅:再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們的愛,正如我對你們的:再見。

passages.original: [Exeunt Horatio, Marcellus and Barnardo.]
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭、馬賽勒斯同巴納多下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭、馬賽勒斯和巴納多下。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: My father’s spirit in arms! All is not well; I doubt some foul play: would the night were come! Till then sit still, my soul: foul deeds will rise, Though all the earth o’erwhelm them, to men’s eyes.
passages.vernacular: 我爸爸嘅靈魂全副武裝!一切唔妥;我懷疑有陰謀:願夜晚快啲來!在此之前,靜坐吧,我嘅靈魂:惡行會升起,即使整個大地淹沒佢哋,都會到人嘅眼前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我父親的靈魂全副武裝!一切不妥;我懷疑有陰謀:願夜晚快點來!在此之前,靜坐吧,我的靈魂:惡行會升起,即使整個大地淹沒它們,都會到人的眼前。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act I, Scene III — Polonius’s House 第一幕第三場:波洛涅斯家

passages.original: Enter Laertes and Ophelia.
passages.vernacular: [雷歐提斯同奧菲莉亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷歐提斯和奧菲莉亞上。]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: My necessaries are embark’d. Farewell. And, sister, as the winds give benefit And convoy is assistant, do not sleep, But let me hear from you.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅必需品已經上船。再見。姐妹,風畀方便、船有護航嘅時候,唔好瞓著,要寫信畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的必需品已經上船。再見。妹妹,風給方便、船有護航的時候,不要睡著,要寫信給我。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Do you doubt that?
passages.vernacular: 你懷疑呢點嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你懷疑這點嗎?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: For Hamlet, and the trifling of his favour, Hold it a fashion and a toy in blood; A violet in the youth of primy nature, Forward, not permanent, sweet, not lasting; The perfume and suppliance of a minute; No more.
passages.vernacular: 至於哈姆雷特,同佢對你嘅一時寵愛,當佢係一種時尚同血氣中嘅玩物;一朵喺青春盛年嘅大自然中早開嘅紫羅蘭,早熟,唔持久,甜美,唔耐;一分鐘嘅香氣同消遣,僅此而已。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於哈姆雷特,和他對你的一時寵愛,當它是一種時尚和血氣中的玩物;一朵在青春盛年的大自然中早開的紫羅蘭,早熟,不持久,甜美,不長久;一分鐘的香氣和消遣,僅此而已。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: No more but so?
passages.vernacular: 僅此而已?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 僅此而已?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Think it no more. For nature crescent does not grow alone In thews and bulk; but as this temple waxes, The inward service of the mind and soul Grows wide withal. Perhaps he loves you now, And now no soil nor cautel doth besmirch The virtue of his will; but you must fear, His greatness weigh’d, his will is not his own; For he himself is subject to his birth: He may not, as unvalu’d persons do, Carve for himself; for on his choice depends The sanctity and health of this whole state; And therefore must his choice be circumscrib’d Unto the voice and yielding of that body Whereof he is the head. Then if he says he loves you, It fits your wisdom so far to believe it As he in his particular act and place May give his saying deed; which is no further Than the main voice of Denmark goes withal. Then weigh what loss your honour may sustain If with too credent ear you list his songs, Or lose your heart, or your chaste treasure open To his unmaster’d importunity. Fear it, Ophelia, fear it, my dear sister; And keep you in the rear of your affection, Out of the shot and danger of desire. The chariest maid is prodigal enough If she unmask her beauty to the moon. Virtue itself ’scapes not calumnious strokes: The canker galls the infants of the spring Too oft before their buttons be disclos’d, And in the morn and liquid dew of youth Contagious blastments are most imminent. Be wary then, best safety lies in fear. Youth to itself rebels, though none else near.
passages.vernacular: 當佢係僅此而已。因為自然成長唔單止喺筋肉同體格上生長;隨住呢座殿宇增大,心靈同靈魂嘅內在職能也隨之擴大。也許佢而家愛你,而家冇污點或詭計玷污佢意志嘅美德;不過你必須擔心,考慮到佢嘅地位,佢嘅意志唔屬於佢自己;因為佢自己受制於佢嘅出身:佢唔可以好似無價值嘅人咁為自己挑選;因為佢嘅選擇關係到整個國家嘅神聖同健康;所以佢嘅選擇必須受限於佢作為首領嘅嗰個身體嘅聲音同同意。咁如果佢話佢愛你,你嘅智慧要求你只相信到佢憑佢特定嘅行動同地位能夠將佢嘅講話變成行動嘅程度;而嗰不超過丹麥主要聲音所同意嘅。咁就權衡一下,如果你用太輕信嘅耳朵聽佢嘅歌,或失去你嘅心,或向佢不受控制嘅糾纏打開你貞潔嘅寶藏,你嘅名譽會蒙受咩損失。要怕,奧菲莉亞,要怕,我親愛嘅妹妹;將你保持在你感情嘅後方,遠離慾望嘅射程同危險。最謹慎嘅少女,如果向月亮揭開佢嘅美貌,已經夠放縱。連美德本身都逃唔過誹謗嘅打擊:蛀蟲咬傷春天嘅嬰兒,往往在佢哋嘅花蕾綻開之前,在青春嘅早晨同清澈露水中,傳染性嘅枯萎最迫近。咁要小心,最好嘅安全在於恐懼。青春對自己反叛,即使冇其他人在附近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當它是僅此而已。因為自然成長不僅在筋肉和體格上生長;隨著這座殿宇增大,心靈和靈魂的內在職能也隨之擴大。也許他現在愛你,現在沒污點或詭計玷污他意志的美德;不過你必須擔心,考慮到他的地位,他的意志不屬於他自己;因為他自己受制於他的出身:他不可以像無價值的人那樣為自己挑選;因為他的選擇關係到整個國家的神聖和健康;所以他的選擇必須受限於他作為首領的那個身體的聲音和同意。那如果他說他愛你,你的智慧要求你只相信到他憑他特定的行動和地位能夠將他的說話變成行動的程度;而那不超過丹麥主要聲音所同意的。那就權衡一下,如果你用太輕信的耳朵聽他的歌,或失去你的心,或向他不受控制的糾纏打開你貞潔的寶藏,你的名譽會蒙受什麼損失。要怕,奧菲莉亞,要怕,我親愛的妹妹;將你保持在你感情的後方,遠離慾望的射程和危險。最謹慎的少女,如果向月亮揭開她的美貌,已經夠放縱。連美德本身都逃不過誹謗的打擊:蛀蟲咬傷春天的嬰兒,往往在它們的花蕾綻開之前,在青春的早晨和清澈露水中,傳染性的枯萎最迫近。那要小心,最好的安全在於恐懼。青春對自己反叛,即使沒其他人在附近。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: I shall th’effect of this good lesson keep As watchman to my heart. But good my brother, Do not as some ungracious pastors do, Show me the steep and thorny way to heaven; Whilst like a puff’d and reckless libertine Himself the primrose path of dalliance treads, And recks not his own rede.
passages.vernacular: 我會保持呢個好教訓嘅效果,作為我心嘅守衛。不過好哥哥,唔好似一些無恩典嘅牧師咁,向我展示通往天堂嘅陡峭荊棘路;而自己好似一個膨脹、魯莽嘅放蕩者,踏上嬉戲嘅櫻草路,唔理會自己嘅忠告。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會保持這個好教訓的效果,作為我心的守衛。不過好哥哥,不要像一些無恩典的牧師那樣,向我展示通往天堂的陡峭荊棘路;而自己像一個膨脹、魯莽的放蕩者,踏上嬉戲的櫻草路,不理會自己的忠告。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: O, fear me not. I stay too long. But here my father comes.
passages.vernacular: 啊,唔使怕我。我逗留得太耐。不過我爸爸嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,不用怕我。我逗留得太久。不過我父親來了。

passages.original: Enter Polonius.
passages.vernacular: [波洛涅斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [波洛涅斯上。]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: A double blessing is a double grace; Occasion smiles upon a second leave.
passages.vernacular: 雙重祝福係雙重恩典;機會向第二次告別微笑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雙重祝福是雙重恩典;機會向第二次告別微笑。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Yet here, Laertes? Aboard, aboard, for shame. The wind sits in the shoulder of your sail, And you are stay’d for. There, my blessing with you.
passages.vernacular: 雷歐提斯,你仲喺度?上船,上船,羞不羞。風坐在你船帆嘅肩上,人哋等緊你。嚟,我嘅祝福同你一齊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雷歐提斯,你還在這裡?上船,上船,羞不羞。風坐在你船帆的肩上,人家等著你。來,我的祝福與你一起。

passages.original: [Laying his hand on Laertes’s head.]
passages.vernacular: [將手放在雷歐提斯頭上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [將手放在雷歐提斯頭上。]

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: And these few precepts in thy memory Look thou character. Give thy thoughts no tongue, Nor any unproportion’d thought his act. Be thou familiar, but by no means vulgar. Those friends thou hast, and their adoption tried, Grapple them unto thy soul with hoops of steel; But do not dull thy palm with entertainment Of each new-hatch’d, unfledg’d comrade. Beware Of entrance to a quarrel; but being in, Bear’t that th’opposed may beware of thee. Give every man thine ear, but few thy voice: Take each man’s censure, but reserve thy judgement. Costly thy habit as thy purse can buy, But not express’d in fancy; rich, not gaudy: For the apparel oft proclaims the man; And they in France of the best rank and station Are of a most select and generous chief in that. Neither a borrower nor a lender be: For loan oft loses both itself and friend; And borrowing dulls the edge of husbandry. This above all: to thine own self be true; And it must follow, as the night the day, Thou canst not then be false to any man. Farewell: my blessing season this in thee.
passages.vernacular: 呢幾條教誨,要刻喺你記憶裡。唔好畀你嘅思想舌頭,亦唔好令任何不合比例嘅思想成為行動。要親切,但絕不可庸俗。你有嘅朋友,而且佢哋嘅結交經過考驗,就用鋼箍將佢哋緊緊扣住你嘅靈魂;不過唔好為咗招待每個新孵出、未長毛嘅夥伴而磨鈍你嘅手掌。小心唔好踏入爭吵;不過既然入咗,就要令對手要提防你。畀每個人聽你嘅耳朵,卻只畀少數人你嘅聲音:接受每個人嘅批評,卻保留你嘅判斷。你嘅衣著在你荷包能夠買到嘅範圍內昂貴,但唔好顯得花俏;華貴,唔俗艷:因為衣著往往宣告人;而喺法國,最高階級同地位嘅人,在呢方面最挑剔最慷慨。唔好做借款人,亦唔好做貸款人:因為貸款往往同時失去貸款同朋友;而借款會磨鈍勤儉嘅鋒芒。最重要嘅係:對你自己真誠;咁就必然如夜隨日,你唔可能對任何人虛假。再見:願我嘅祝福令呢啲在你身上成熟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這幾條教誨,要刻在你記憶裡。不要給你的思想舌頭,也不要使任何不合比例的思想成為行動。要親切,但絕不可庸俗。你有的朋友,而且他們的結交經過考驗,就用鋼箍將他們緊緊扣住你的靈魂;不過不要為了招待每個新孵出、未長毛的夥伴而磨鈍你的手掌。小心不要踏入爭吵;不過既然進了,就要使對手要提防你。給每個人聽你的耳朵,卻只給少數人你的聲音:接受每個人的批評,卻保留你的判斷。你的衣著在你荷包能夠買到的範圍內昂貴,但不要顯得花俏;華貴,不俗艷:因為衣著往往宣告人;而在法國,最高階級和地位的人,在這方面最挑剔最慷慨。不要做借款人,也不要做貸款人:因為貸款往往同時失去貸款和朋友;而借款會磨鈍勤儉的鋒芒。最重要的是:對你自己真誠;這就必然如夜隨日,你不可能對任何人虛假。再見:願我的祝福使這些在你身上成熟。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Most humbly do I take my leave, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我最謙卑地告辭,爸爸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我最謙卑地告辭,父親。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: The time invites you; go, your servants tend.
passages.vernacular: 時間邀請你;去吧,你嘅僕人在等。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 時間邀請你;去吧,你的僕人在等。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Farewell, Ophelia, and remember well What I have said to you.
passages.vernacular: 再見,奧菲莉亞,要牢牢記住我對你講嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見,奧菲莉亞,要牢牢記住我對你說的。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: ’Tis in my memory lock’d, And you yourself shall keep the key of it.
passages.vernacular: 佢鎖咗喺我嘅記憶裡,鑰匙由你自己保管。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它鎖在我的記憶裡,鑰匙由你自己保管。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Farewell.
passages.vernacular: 再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: What is’t, Ophelia, he hath said to you?
passages.vernacular: 奧菲莉亞,佢對你講咗啲咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奧菲莉亞,他對你說了些什麼?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: So please you, something touching the Lord Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 如果你樂意,有關哈姆雷特殿下嘅一些嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你樂意,有關哈姆雷特殿下的一些事。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Marry, well bethought: ’Tis told me he hath very oft of late Given private time to you; and you yourself Have of your audience been most free and bounteous. If it be so,—as so ’tis put on me, And that in way of caution,—I must tell you You do not understand yourself so clearly As it behoves my daughter and your honour. What is between you? Give me up the truth.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,想得好:人話我知,佢最近好經常畀私人時間你;而你自己對佢嘅接見非常自由慷慨。如果係咁——人哋咁向我提出,而且係以警告嘅方式——我必須告訴你,你並未如我女兒同你嘅名譽所應有咁清楚理解自己。你同佢之間係點?將真相畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,想得好:人告訴我,他最近很經常給私人時間你;而你自己對他的接見非常自由慷慨。如果是這樣——人家這樣向我提出,而且是以警告的方式——我必須告訴你,你並未如我女兒和你的名譽所應有地清楚理解自己。你和他之間是怎樣?將真相給我。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: He hath, my lord, of late made many tenders Of his affection to me.
passages.vernacular: 爸爸,佢最近向我表示咗好多次佢嘅感情。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 父親,他最近向我表示了很多次他的感情。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Affection! Pooh! You speak like a green girl, Unsifted in such perilous circumstance. Do you believe his tenders, as you call them?
passages.vernacular: 感情!呸!你講嘢好似一個青澀嘅女孩,未經過濾咁危險嘅環境。你相信佢嘅表示,正如你所稱嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 感情!呸!你說話像一個青澀的女孩,未經過濾這麼危險的環境。你相信他的表示,正如你所稱的?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: I do not know, my lord, what I should think.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道,爸爸,我應該點諗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道,父親,我應該怎麼想。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Marry, I’ll teach you; think yourself a baby; That you have ta’en these tenders for true pay, Which are not sterling. Tender yourself more dearly; Or,—not to crack the wind of the poor phrase, Running it thus,—you’ll tender me a fool.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我教你;當你自己係嬰兒:因為你將呢啲表示當作真實嘅貨幣,而佢哋唔係足銀。要更珍惜你自己;或者——唔好累壞呢個可憐詞語嘅氣——咁講,你會令我成為傻瓜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我教你;當你自己是嬰兒:因為你將這些表示當作真實的貨幣,而它們不是足銀。要更珍惜你自己;或者——不要累壞這個可憐詞語的氣——這樣說,你會使我成為傻瓜。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: My lord, he hath importun’d me with love In honourable fashion.
passages.vernacular: 爸爸,佢以光明正大嘅方式用愛糾纏我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 父親,他以光明正大的方式用愛糾纏我。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Ay, fashion you may call it; go to, go to.
passages.vernacular: 係,方式你可以咁叫;得啦,得啦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,方式你可以這樣叫;得了,得了。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: And hath given countenance to his speech, my lord, With almost all the holy vows of heaven.
passages.vernacular: 而且,爸爸,佢用差不多所有天上嘅神聖誓言支持佢嘅講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且,父親,他用差不多所有天上的神聖誓言支持他的說話。

passages.title: Polonius 波洛涅斯
passages.original: Ay, springes to catch woodcocks. I do know, When the blood burns, how prodigal the soul Lends the tongue vows: these blazes, daughter, Giving more light than heat, extinct in both, Even in their promise, as it is a-making, You must not take for fire. From this time Be something scanter of your maiden presence; Set your entreatments at a higher rate Than a command to parley. For Lord Hamlet, Believe so much in him that he is young; And with a larger tether may he walk Than may be given you. In few, Ophelia, Do not believe his vows; for they are brokers, Not of that dye which their investments show, But mere implorators of unholy suits, Breathing like sanctified and pious bawds, The better to beguile. This is for all: I would not, in plain terms, from this time forth Have you so slander any moment leisure As to give words or talk with the Lord Hamlet. Look to’t, I charge you; come your ways.
passages.vernacular: 係,捕山鷸嘅陷阱。我知道,當血燃燒時,靈魂幾慷慨咁借誓言畀舌頭:女兒,呢啲火焰,光多過熱,承諾嘅同時就熄滅兩者,你唔可以當佢哋係火。從此刻起,少啲出現你少女嘅身影;將你嘅會面要求定在比命令談判更高嘅價錢。至於哈姆雷特殿下,要相信佢年輕:佢可以用比畀你更長嘅繩索行走。簡單講,奧菲莉亞,唔好相信佢嘅誓言;因為佢哋係經紀,唔係佢哋所穿衣著所顯示嘅顏色,而只係不神聖請求嘅懇求者,像神聖虔誠嘅皮條客般呼吸,為咗更好咁誘騙。總之:直接講,我從此刻起,唔想你將任何一刻閒暇咁誹謗,以致同哈姆雷特殿下講話或傾談。留意,我命令你;來吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,捕山鷸的陷阱。我知道,當血燃燒時,靈魂多慷慨地借誓言給舌頭:女兒,這些火焰,光多過熱,承諾的同時就熄滅兩者,你不可以當它們是火。從此刻起,少些出現你少女的身影;將你的會面要求定在比命令談判更高的價錢。至於哈姆雷特殿下,要相信他年輕:他可以用比給你更長的繩索行走。簡單說,奧菲莉亞,不要相信他的誓言;因為它們是經紀,不是它們所穿衣著所顯示的顏色,而只是不神聖請求的懇求者,像神聖虔誠的皮條客般呼吸,為了更好地誘騙。總之:直接說,我從此刻起,不想你將任何一刻閒暇這樣誹謗,以致與哈姆雷特殿下說話或交談。留意,我命令你;來吧。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: I shall obey, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我會服從,爸爸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會服從,父親。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act I, Scene IV — The Platform 第一幕第四場:平台

passages.original: Enter Hamlet, Horatio and Marcellus.
passages.vernacular: [哈姆雷特、霍拉旭同馬賽勒斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [哈姆雷特、霍拉旭和馬賽勒斯上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: The air bites shrewdly; it is very cold.
passages.vernacular: 空氣咬得好狠;好凍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 空氣咬得很狠;很冷。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: It is a nipping and an eager air.
passages.vernacular: 係刺骨又尖銳嘅空氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是刺骨又尖銳的空氣。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: What hour now?
passages.vernacular: 而家幾點?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在幾點?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: I think it lacks of twelve.
passages.vernacular: 我諗未夠十二點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想不到十二點。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: No, it is struck.
passages.vernacular: 唔,已經敲咗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,已經敲了。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Indeed? I heard it not. It then draws near the season Wherein the spirit held his wont to walk.
passages.vernacular: 真係?我冇聽到。咁就快到鬼魂慣常出來行走嘅時節。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的?我沒聽到。那就快到鬼魂慣常出來行走的時節。

passages.original: [A flourish of trumpets, and ordnance shot off within.]
passages.vernacular: [號角齊鳴,內有炮聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [號角齊鳴,內有炮聲。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: What does this mean, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係咩意思,殿下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼意思,殿下?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: The King doth wake tonight and takes his rouse, Keeps wassail, and the swaggering upspring reels; And as he drains his draughts of Rhenish down, The kettle-drum and trumpet thus bray out The triumph of his pledge.
passages.vernacular: 國王今晚徹夜不眠,痛飲狂歡,舉杯暢飲,跳舞跳得搖搖晃晃;佢每飲乾一杯萊茵白酒,鼓同號角就咁高聲宣告佢祝酒嘅勝利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 國王今晚徹夜不眠,痛飲狂歡,舉杯暢飲,跳舞跳得搖搖晃晃;他每飲乾一杯萊茵白酒,鼓和號角就這樣高聲宣告他祝酒的勝利。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Is it a custom?
passages.vernacular: 係咪一種習俗?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是不是一種習俗?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Ay marry is’t; And to my mind, though I am native here, And to the manner born, it is a custom More honour’d in the breach than the observance. This heavy-headed revel east and west Makes us traduc’d and tax’d of other nations: They clepe us drunkards, and with swinish phrase Soil our addition; and indeed it takes From our achievements, though perform’d at height, The pith and marrow of our attribute. So oft it chances in particular men That for some vicious mole of nature in them, As in their birth, wherein they are not guilty, Since nature cannot choose his origin, By their o’ergrowth of some complexion, Oft breaking down the pales and forts of reason; Or by some habit, that too much o’erleavens The form of plausive manners;—that these men, Carrying, I say, the stamp of one defect, Being Nature’s livery or Fortune’s star,— His virtues else,—be they as pure as grace, As infinite as man may undergo, Shall in the general censure take corruption From that particular fault. The dram of evil Doth all the noble substance of a doubt To his own scandal.
passages.vernacular: 係喎;依我睇,雖然我係本地人,生於呢種風俗,呢個習俗,破壞佢比遵守佢更光榮。呢種東西南北嘅沉醉狂歡,令我哋被其他國家誹謗同指責:佢哋叫我哋醉鬼,用豬一樣嘅講法玷污我哋嘅稱號;確實,佢從我哋嘅成就(即使成就達到頂點)取走我哋稱號嘅精髓。同樣情況常常發生在個別人身上:因為佢哋身上某種大自然嘅惡痣,好似在出生時,佢哋對此無罪,因為大自然唔能夠選擇佢嘅起源,或因為某種氣質過度生長,往往衝破理性嘅柵欄同堡壘;或者因為某種習慣,過度發酵咗討好嘅禮貌形式;呢啲人,我講,帶住一個缺陷嘅印記,即大自然嘅制服或命運之星,佢哋其他嘅美德,縱使純潔如恩典,無窮如人可承受,喺普遍嘅批評中,都會從呢個特定過失染上腐敗。一滴惡,令全部高貴嘅實質都遭受懷疑,蒙上自己嘅醜聞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的;依我看,雖然我是本地人,生於這種風俗,這個習俗,破壞它比遵守它更光榮。這種東西南北的沉醉狂歡,使我們被其他國家誹謗和指責:他們叫我們醉鬼,用豬一樣的說法玷污我們的稱號;確實,它從我們的成就(即使成就達到頂點)取走我們稱號的精髓。同樣情況常常發生在個別人身上:因為他們身上某種大自然的惡痣,像在出生時,他們對此無罪,因為大自然不能夠選擇她的起源,或因為某種氣質過度生長,往往衝破理性的柵欄和堡壘;或者因為某種習慣,過度發酵了討好的禮貌形式;這些人,我說,帶著一個缺陷的印記,即大自然的制服或命運之星,他們其他的美德,縱使純潔如恩典,無窮如人可承受,在普遍的批評中,都會從這個特定過失染上腐敗。一滴惡,使全部高貴的實質都遭受懷疑,蒙上自己的醜聞。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Look, my lord, it comes!
passages.vernacular: 睇,殿下,佢嚟喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,殿下,它來了!

passages.original: Enter Ghost.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Angels and ministers of grace defend us! Be thou a spirit of health or goblin damn’d, Bring with thee airs from heaven or blasts from hell, Be thy intents wicked or charitable, Thou com’st in such a questionable shape That I will speak to thee. I’ll call thee Hamlet, King, father, royal Dane. O, answer me! Let me not burst in ignorance; but tell Why thy canoniz’d bones, hearsed in death, Have burst their cerements; why the sepulchre, Wherein we saw thee quietly inurn’d, Hath op’d his ponderous and marble jaws To cast thee up again! What may this mean, That thou, dead corse, again in complete steel, Revisit’st thus the glimpses of the moon, Making night hideous, and we fools of nature So horridly to shake our disposition With thoughts beyond the reaches of our souls? Say, why is this? Wherefore? What should we do?
passages.vernacular: 天使同恩典嘅使者保護我哋!無論你係健康嘅靈魂還係被詛咒嘅妖精,帶來天上嘅微風還係地獄嘅狂風,你嘅意圖邪惡還係慈善,你以咁可疑嘅形狀出現,我要同你講話。我叫你哈姆雷特,國王,爸爸,丹麥王室。啊,答我!唔好令我在無知中爆裂;告訴我,點解你被封聖、在死亡中入殮嘅骨頭,衝破咗佢嘅裹屍布;點解我哋見你安靜入葬嘅墳墓,張開佢沉重嘅大理石下顎,將你再吐出來!呢個係咩意思,你,死咗嘅屍體,再次披上全副鋼甲,咁樣重訪月光嘅微光,令夜晚可怕,令我哋呢啲自然嘅傻瓜,用超出我哋靈魂範圍嘅思想,咁恐怖地搖動我哋嘅性情?講,點解?為咗咩?我哋應該做咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天使和恩典的使者保護我們!無論你是健康的靈魂還是被詛咒的妖精,帶來天上的微風還是地獄的狂風,你的意圖邪惡還是慈善,你以這麼可疑的形狀出現,我要和你說話。我叫你哈姆雷特,國王,父親,丹麥王室。啊,答我!不要讓我在無知中爆裂;告訴我,為什麼你被封聖、在死亡中入殮的骨頭,衝破了它的裹屍布;為什麼我們看到你安靜入葬的墳墓,張開它沉重的大理石下顎,將你再吐出來!這是什麼意思,你,死了的屍體,再次披上全副鋼甲,這樣重訪月光的微光,使夜晚可怕,使我們這些自然的傻瓜,用超出我們靈魂範圍的思想,這麼恐怖地搖動我們的性情?說,為什麼?為了什麼?我們應該做什麼?

passages.original: [Ghost beckons Hamlet.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂向哈姆雷特招手。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂向哈姆雷特招手。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: It beckons you to go away with it, As if it some impartment did desire To you alone.
passages.vernacular: 佢招手叫你同佢走開,好似佢想單獨向你傳達啲嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它招手叫你和它走開,好像它想單獨向你傳達些什麼。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Look with what courteous action It waves you to a more removed ground. But do not go with it.
passages.vernacular: 睇佢用幾有禮嘅動作,向你揮手去更偏遠嘅地方。不過唔好同佢去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看它用多有禮的動作,向你揮手去更偏遠的地方。不過不要跟它去。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: No, by no means.
passages.vernacular: 唔好,絕對唔好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要,絕對不要。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: It will not speak; then will I follow it.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔講話;咁我跟住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它不說話;那我跟著它。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Do not, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 唔好,殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要,殿下。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Why, what should be the fear? I do not set my life at a pin’s fee; And for my soul, what can it do to that, Being a thing immortal as itself? It waves me forth again. I’ll follow it.
passages.vernacular: 點呀,有咩好驚?我唔將我嘅命當一枚針咁值錢;至於我嘅靈魂,佢可以對佢做咩,佢係同佢自己一樣不朽嘅東西?佢又向我揮手。我跟住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,有什麼好怕?我不將我的命當一枚針那麼值錢;至於我的靈魂,它可以對它做什麼,它是和它自己一樣不朽的東西?它又向我揮手。我跟著它。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: What if it tempt you toward the flood, my lord, Or to the dreadful summit of the cliff That beetles o’er his base into the sea, And there assume some other horrible form Which might deprive your sovereignty of reason, And draw you into madness? Think of it. The very place puts toys of desperation, Without more motive, into every brain That looks so many fathoms to the sea And hears it roar beneath.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,如果佢引誘你去向洪流,或者去嗰座向海中凸出、可怕嘅懸崖頂,然後在嗰度扮成另一種可怕嘅形狀,可能剝奪你嘅理性主權,將你拉入瘋狂,點算?想想啦。正正呢個地方,冇更多動機,就將絕望嘅念頭放入每個望向海幾十噚深、聽到佢在下面咆哮嘅頭腦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,如果它引誘你去向洪流,或者去那座向海中凸出、可怕的懸崖頂,然後在那裡扮成另一種可怕的形狀,可能剝奪你的理性主權,將你拉進瘋狂,怎麼辦?想想吧。正正這個地方,沒更多動機,就將絕望的念頭放進每個望向海幾十噚深、聽到它在下面咆哮的頭腦。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: It waves me still. Go on, I’ll follow thee.
passages.vernacular: 佢仍然向我揮手。行啦,我跟住你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它仍然向我揮手。走吧,我跟著你。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: You shall not go, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,你唔可以去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,你不可以去。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Hold off your hands.
passages.vernacular: 放開你哋嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放開你們的手。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Be rul’d; you shall not go.
passages.vernacular: 聽話;你唔可以去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽話;你不可以去。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: My fate cries out, And makes each petty artery in this body As hardy as the Nemean lion’s nerve.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅命運在呼喊,令呢個身體裡每條細小動脈,都似尼米亞獅子嘅筋腱咁堅韌。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的命運在呼喊,使這個身體裡每條細小動脈,都像尼米亞獅子的筋腱一樣堅韌。

passages.original: [Ghost beckons.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂招手。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂招手。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Still am I call’d. Unhand me, gentlemen.
passages.vernacular: 我仍然被呼喚。放開我,各位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我仍然被呼喚。放開我,各位。

passages.original: [Breaking free from them.]
passages.vernacular: [掙脫佢哋。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [掙脫他們。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: By heaven, I’ll make a ghost of him that lets me. I say, away!—Go on, I’ll follow thee.
passages.vernacular: 憑天發誓,誰阻我,我就將佢變成鬼。我講,走開!——行啦,我跟住你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑天發誓,誰阻我,我就將他變成鬼。我說,走開!——走吧,我跟著你。

passages.original: [Exeunt Ghost and Hamlet.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂同哈姆雷特下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂和哈姆雷特下。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: He waxes desperate with imagination.
passages.vernacular: 佢因想像而變得絕望。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他因想像而變得絕望。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Let’s follow; ’tis not fit thus to obey him.
passages.vernacular: 我哋跟佢啦;咁服從佢唔適合。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們跟他吧;這樣服從他不合適。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Have after. To what issue will this come?
passages.vernacular: 跟住去。呢件事會有咩結果?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 跟著去。這件事會有什麼結果?

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.
passages.vernacular: 丹麥國內有啲嘢腐爛咗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丹麥國內有些東西腐爛了。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Heaven will direct it.
passages.vernacular: 天會指引。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天會指引。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: Nay, let’s follow him.
passages.vernacular: 唔,我哋跟佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我們跟他。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act I, Scene V — A Remote Part of the Castle 第一幕第五場:城堡僻靜處

passages.original: Enter Ghost and Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂同哈姆雷特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂和哈姆雷特上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Whither wilt thou lead me? Speak, I’ll go no further.
passages.vernacular: 你要帶我去邊?講,我唔再行前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要帶我去哪?說,我不再往前走。

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Mark me.
passages.vernacular: 聽住我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽著我。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I will.
passages.vernacular: 我會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會。

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: My hour is almost come, When I to sulph’rous and tormenting flames Must render up myself.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅時辰差唔多到,我必須將自己交畀硫磺同折磨人嘅烈焰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的時辰差不多到,我必須將自己交給硫磺和折磨人的烈焰。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Alas, poor ghost!
passages.vernacular: 唉,可憐嘅鬼魂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 唉,可憐的鬼魂!

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Pity me not, but lend thy serious hearing To what I shall unfold.
passages.vernacular: 唔好可憐我,而係認真聽我要講出嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要可憐我,而是認真聽我要說出的。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Speak, I am bound to hear.
passages.vernacular: 講,我有責任聽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,我有責任聽。

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: So art thou to revenge, when thou shalt hear.
passages.vernacular: 你聽完之後,你亦有責任報仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽完之後,你也有責任報仇。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: What?
passages.vernacular: 咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼?

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: I am thy father’s spirit, Doom’d for a certain term to walk the night, And for the day confin’d to fast in fires, Till the foul crimes done in my days of nature Are burnt and purg’d away. But that I am forbid To tell the secrets of my prison-house, I could a tale unfold whose lightest word Would harrow up thy soul; freeze thy young blood, Make thy two eyes like stars start from their spheres, Thy knotted and combined locks to part, And each particular hair to stand on end Like quills upon the fretful porpentine. But this eternal blazon must not be To ears of flesh and blood. List, list, O, list! If thou didst ever thy dear father love—
passages.vernacular: 我係你爸爸嘅靈魂,被判在一段時間內夜間行走,日間被囚禁喺火中齋戒,直到我在世時犯嘅污穢罪行被燒盡淨化。如果唔係我被禁止講出我監獄嘅秘密,我可以講一個故事,最輕嘅一個字都會撕裂你嘅靈魂;凍結你年輕嘅血,令你兩隻眼睛好似星星咁從眼眶跳出,令你打結嘅頭髮分開,每條頭髮都豎起,好似受驚豪豬身上嘅刺。不過呢種永恆嘅宣示,唔可以講畀血肉嘅耳朵聽。聽,聽,啊,聽!如果你曾經愛過你親愛嘅爸爸——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是你父親的靈魂,被判在一段時間內夜間行走,日間被囚禁在火中齋戒,直到我在世時犯的污穢罪行被燒盡淨化。如果不是我被禁止說出我監獄的祕密,我可以說一個故事,最輕的一個字都會撕裂你的靈魂;凍結你年輕的血,使你兩隻眼睛像星星般從眼眶跳出,使你打結的頭髮分開,每條頭髮都豎起,像受驚豪豬身上的刺。不過這種永恆的宣示,不可以說給血肉的耳朵聽。聽,聽,啊,聽!如果你曾經愛過你親愛的父親——

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O God!
passages.vernacular: 啊上帝!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊上帝!

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Revenge his foul and most unnatural murder.
passages.vernacular: 為佢污穢、最違反自然嘅謀殺報仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為他污穢、最違反自然的謀殺報仇。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Murder!
passages.vernacular: 謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謀殺!

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Murder most foul, as in the best it is; But this most foul, strange, and unnatural.
passages.vernacular: 最污穢嘅謀殺,即使最好嘅謀殺都係咁;不過呢宗最污穢、奇怪、違反自然。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最污穢的謀殺,即使最好的謀殺都是這樣;不過這宗最污穢、奇怪、違反自然。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Haste me to know’t, that I, with wings as swift As meditation or the thoughts of love May sweep to my revenge.
passages.vernacular: 快啲讓我知道,好令我用同沉思或愛嘅思想一樣迅疾嘅翅膀,橫掃去報仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快點讓我知道,好使我用與沉思或愛的思想一樣迅疾的翅膀,橫掃去報仇。

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: I find thee apt; And duller shouldst thou be than the fat weed That rots itself in ease on Lethe wharf, Wouldst thou not stir in this. Now, Hamlet, hear. ’Tis given out that, sleeping in my orchard, A serpent stung me; so the whole ear of Denmark Is by a forged process of my death Rankly abus’d; but know, thou noble youth, The serpent that did sting thy father’s life Now wears his crown.
passages.vernacular: 我發現你有準備;如果你喺呢件事上唔行動,你會比喺忘川碼頭安逸腐爛嘅肥雜草更遲鈍。而家,哈姆雷特,聽著。人哋對外宣稱,我喺果園瞓著時,被一條蛇咬死;所以整個丹麥嘅耳朵,被一個偽造嘅關於我死嘅過程惡毒地欺騙;不過要知道,高貴嘅青年,咬死你爸爸生命嘅蛇,而家戴住佢嘅王冠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我發現你有準備;如果你在這件事上不行動,你會比在忘川碼頭安逸腐爛的肥雜草更遲鈍。現在,哈姆雷特,聽著。人家對外宣稱,我在果園睡著時,被一條蛇咬死;所以整個丹麥的耳朵,被一個偽造的關於我死的過程惡毒地欺騙;不過要知道,高貴的青年,咬死你父親生命的蛇,現在戴著他的王冠。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O my prophetic soul! Mine uncle!
passages.vernacular: 啊我預言般嘅靈魂!我嘅叔叔!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我預言般的靈魂!我的叔叔!

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Ay, that incestuous, that adulterate beast, With witchcraft of his wit, with traitorous gifts,— O wicked wit, and gifts, that have the power So to seduce!—won to his shameful lust The will of my most seeming-virtuous queen. O Hamlet, what a falling off was there, From me, whose love was of that dignity That it went hand in hand even with the vow I made to her in marriage; and to decline Upon a wretch whose natural gifts were poor To those of mine. But virtue, as it never will be mov’d, Though lewdness court it in a shape of heaven; So lust, though to a radiant angel link’d, Will sate itself in a celestial bed And prey on garbage. But soft! methinks I scent the morning air; Brief let me be. Sleeping within my orchard, My custom always of the afternoon, Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole With juice of cursed hebenon in a vial, And in the porches of my ears did pour The leperous distilment, whose effect Holds such an enmity with blood of man That swift as quicksilver it courses through The natural gates and alleys of the body; And with a sudden vigour it doth posset And curd, like eager droppings into milk, The thin and wholesome blood. So did it mine; And a most instant tetter bark’d about, Most lazar-like, with vile and loathsome crust All my smooth body. Thus was I, sleeping, by a brother’s hand, Of life, of crown, of queen at once dispatch’d: Cut off even in the blossoms of my sin, Unhous’led, disappointed, unanel’d; No reckoning made, but sent to my account With all my imperfections on my head. O horrible! O horrible! most horrible! If thou hast nature in thee, bear it not; Let not the royal bed of Denmark be A couch for luxury and damned incest. But howsoever thou pursu’st this act, Taint not thy mind, nor let thy soul contrive Against thy mother aught; leave her to heaven, And to those thorns that in her bosom lodge, To prick and sting her. Fare thee well at once! The glow-worm shows the matin to be near, And ’gins to pale his uneffectual fire. Adieu, adieu, adieu. Remember me.
passages.vernacular: 係,嗰個亂倫、通姦嘅畜生,用佢智巧嘅巫術、用叛逆嘅禮物——啊邪惡嘅智巧同禮物,有咁大力量誘惑!——贏得我最似有美德嘅王后嘅意志,屈從佢可恥嘅慾望。啊哈姆雷特,從我身上墮落得幾多,我嘅愛有咁嘅尊嚴,以致佢同我向佢婚姻中所發嘅誓言攜手並進;卻墮落到一個可憐人身上,佢嘅天賦同我嘅比起嚟好貧乏。不過美德永遠唔會被動搖,即使淫蕩以天上嘅形狀向佢求愛;同樣慾望,即使同光輝嘅天使結合,都會喺天堂嘅床上滿足,然後以垃圾為食。不過輕聲!我覺得聞到早晨嘅空氣;讓我簡短。我喺我嘅果園瞓著,呢係我下午一貫嘅習慣,趁我安心嘅時刻,你叔叔偷偷用一個小瓶裝住被詛咒嘅毒芹汁,倒入我耳朵嘅門廊,嗰種麻瘋般嘅蒸餾液,其效果同人嘅血液有咁嘅敵意,以致佢迅疾如水銀咁流過身體天然嘅門同巷;而且憑突然嘅力量,佢令稀薄健康嘅血液凝結,好似酸液滴入牛奶。我嘅血亦咁;一種即時嘅皮疹,好似痲瘋病人咁,帶住污穢可憎嘅硬殼,覆蓋我全身光滑嘅皮膚。就咁我喺瞓覺時,被兄弟嘅手,一下子失去生命、王冠、王后:甚至在我罪孽嘅花蕾中被割斷,冇領聖體,冇準備,冇塗油;冇清算,就被送去算賬,帶住我所有嘅缺陷在我頭上。啊可怕!啊可怕!最可怕!如果你身上有天性,就唔好忍受;唔好讓丹麥嘅王床成為縱慾同該死亂倫嘅睡榻。不過無論你點樣進行呢個行動,唔好玷污你嘅心靈,亦唔好讓你嘅靈魂圖謀對付你媽媽任何嘢;將佢留畀天,同留畀住在佢胸中嘅荊棘,去刺痛佢。立刻再見!螢火蟲顯示晨曦臨近,佢開始減淡佢無效嘅火。再見,再見,再見。記住我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,那個亂倫、通姦的畜生,用他智巧的巫術、用叛逆的禮物——啊邪惡的智巧和禮物,有這麼大力量誘惑!——贏得我最似有美德的王后的意志,屈從他可恥的慾望。啊哈姆雷特,從我身上墮落得多少,我的愛有這樣的尊嚴,以致它與我向她婚姻中所發的誓言攜手並進;卻墮落到一個可憐人身上,他的天賦和我的比起來很貧乏。不過美德永遠不會被動搖,即使淫蕩以天上的形狀向她求愛;同樣慾望,即使與光輝的天使結合,也會在天堂的床上滿足,然後以垃圾為食。不過輕聲!我覺得聞到早晨的空氣;讓我簡短。我在我的果園睡著,這是我下午一貫的習慣,趁我安心的時刻,你叔叔偷偷用一個小瓶裝著被詛咒的毒芹汁,倒入我耳朵的門廊,那種麻瘋般的蒸餾液,其效果與人的血液有這樣的敵意,以致它迅疾如水銀般流過身體天然的門和巷;而且憑突然的力量,它使稀薄健康的血液凝結,像酸液滴入牛奶。我的血也這樣;一種即時的皮疹,像痲瘋病人那樣,帶著污穢可憎的硬殼,覆蓋我全身光滑的皮膚。就這樣我在睡覺時,被兄弟的手,一下子失去生命、王冠、王后:甚至在我罪孽的花蕾中被割斷,沒領聖體,沒準備,沒塗油;沒清算,就被送去算賬,帶著我所有的缺陷在我頭上。啊可怕!啊可怕!最可怕!如果你身上有天性,就不要忍受;不要讓丹麥的王床成為縱慾和該死亂倫的睡榻。不過無論你怎樣進行這個行動,不要玷污你的心靈,也不要讓你的靈魂圖謀對付你母親任何事;將她留給天,和留給住在她胸中的荊棘,去刺痛她。立刻再見!螢火蟲顯示晨曦臨近,它開始減淡它無效的火。再見,再見,再見。記住我。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O all you host of heaven! O earth! What else? And shall I couple hell? O, fie! Hold, my heart; And you, my sinews, grow not instant old, But bear me stiffly up. Remember thee? Ay, thou poor ghost, while memory holds a seat In this distracted globe. Remember thee? Yea, from the table of my memory I’ll wipe away all trivial fond records, All saws of books, all forms, all pressures past, That youth and observation copied there; And thy commandment all alone shall live Within the book and volume of my brain, Unmix’d with baser matter. Yes, by heaven! O most pernicious woman! O villain, villain, smiling damned villain! My tables. Meet it is I set it down, That one may smile, and smile, and be a villain! At least I am sure it may be so in Denmark.
passages.vernacular: 啊所有天上嘅軍隊!啊大地!還有咩?我要連埋地獄嗎?啊,呸!撐住,我嘅心;還有你,我嘅筋腱,唔好即刻變老,而係堅定咁支撐我。記住你?係,你呢個可憐嘅鬼魂,只要記憶仍在呢個混亂嘅球體中佔一席位。記住你?係,我會從我記憶嘅記事板上抹去所有瑣碎愚蠢嘅記錄,所有書本嘅格言、所有形式、所有過去嘅印象,即年輕同觀察喺嗰度抄寫嘅;你嘅命令獨自活喺我頭腦嘅書同冊中,唔混雜較卑賤嘅東西。係,憑天發誓!啊最有害嘅女人!啊惡棍,惡棍,微笑嘅該死惡棍!我嘅記事板。適宜我記低:一個人可以微笑,微笑,卻係個惡棍!至少我肯定喺丹麥可以係咁。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊所有天上的軍隊!啊大地!還有什麼?我要連上地獄嗎?啊,呸!撐住,我的心;還有你,我的筋腱,不要立刻變老,而是堅定地支撐我。記住你?是,你這個可憐的鬼魂,只要記憶仍在這個混亂的球體中佔一席位。記住你?是,我會從我記憶的記事板上抹去所有瑣碎愚蠢的記錄,所有書本的格言、所有形式、所有過去的印象,即年輕和觀察在那裡抄寫的;你的命令獨自活在我頭腦的書和冊中,不混雜較卑賤的東西。是,憑天發誓!啊最有害的女人!啊惡棍,惡棍,微笑的該死惡棍!我的記事板。適宜我記下:一個人可以微笑,微笑,卻是個惡棍!至少我肯定在丹麥可以是這樣。

passages.original: [Writing.]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: So, uncle, there you are. Now to my word; It is ‘Adieu, adieu, remember me.’ I have sworn’t.
passages.vernacular: 好,叔叔,你喺度。而家記我嘅口號;係「再見,再見,記住我」。我已發誓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,叔叔,你在這裡。現在記我的口號;是「再見,再見,記住我」。我已發誓。

passages.title: Horatio And Marcellus 霍拉旭同馬賽勒斯
passages.original: [Within.] My lord, my lord.
passages.vernacular: [內。]殿下,殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]殿下,殿下。

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: [Within.] Lord Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: [內。]哈姆雷特殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]哈姆雷特殿下。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: [Within.] Heaven secure him.
passages.vernacular: [內。]願天保佑佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]願天保佑他。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: So be it!
passages.vernacular: 願如此!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願如此!

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: [Within.] Illo, ho, ho, my lord!
passages.vernacular: [內。]喂,嗬,嗬,殿下!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]喂,嗬,嗬,殿下!

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Hillo, ho, ho, boy! Come, bird, come.
passages.vernacular: 嗬,嗬,嗬,孩子!來,小鳥,來。來,小鳥,來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 嗬,嗬,嗬,孩子!來,小鳥,來。來,小鳥,來。

passages.original: Enter Horatio and Marcellus.
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭同馬賽勒斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭和馬賽勒斯上。]

passages.title: Marcellus 馬賽勒斯
passages.original: How is’t, my noble lord?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,尊貴嘅殿下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣,尊貴的殿下?

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: What news, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 有咩消息,殿下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼消息,殿下?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O, wonderful!
passages.vernacular: 啊,奇妙!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,奇妙!

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Good my lord, tell it.
passages.vernacular: 好殿下,講出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好殿下,說出來。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
