Makes marriage vows As false as dicers’ oaths. O such a deed As from the body of contraction plucks The very soul, and sweet religion makes A rhapsody of words. Heaven’s face doth glow, Yea this solidity and compound mass, With tristful visage, as against the doom, Is thought-sick at the act.
passages.vernacular: 咁一種行為,玷污謙遜嘅優雅同紅暈,稱美德為偽君子,從純潔愛情美麗嘅額頭取走玫瑰,並在嗰度留下一個水泡。令婚姻誓言同賭徒嘅誓言一樣虛假。啊,咁嘅行為,由婚約嘅軀體拔走靈魂,令甜美嘅宗教變成一串空話。天嘅臉龐發光,係啊,連呢個堅實嘅複合大地,都帶著憂愁嘅面容,好似末日將至,為呢個行為而思想成疾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣一種行為,玷污謙遜的優雅和紅暈,稱美德為偽君子,從純潔愛情美麗的額頭取走玫瑰,並在那裡留下一個水泡。使婚姻誓言和賭徒的誓言一樣虛假。啊,這樣的行為,由婚約的軀體拔走靈魂,使甜美的宗教變成一串空話。天的臉龐發光,是啊,連這個堅實的複合大地,都帶著憂愁的面容,像末日將至,為這個行為而思想成疾。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Ay me, what act, That roars so loud, and thunders in the index?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,咩行為,叫得咁大聲,喺序言裡就雷鳴?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,什麼行為,叫得這麼大聲,在序言裡就雷鳴?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Look here upon this picture, and on this, The counterfeit presentment of two brothers. See what a grace was seated on this brow, Hyperion’s curls, the front of Jove himself, An eye like Mars, to threaten and command, A station like the herald Mercury New lighted on a heaven-kissing hill: A combination and a form indeed, Where every god did seem to set his seal, To give the world assurance of a man. This was your husband. Look you now what follows. Here is your husband, like a mildew’d ear Blasting his wholesome brother. Have you eyes? Could you on this fair mountain leave to feed, And batten on this moor? Ha! have you eyes? You cannot call it love; for at your age The hey-day in the blood is tame, it’s humble, And waits upon the judgement: and what judgement Would step from this to this? Sense sure you have, Else could you not have motion; but sure that sense Is apoplex’d, for madness would not err Nor sense to ecstacy was ne’er so thrall’d But it reserv’d some quantity of choice To serve in such a difference. What devil was’t That thus hath cozen’d you at hoodman-blind? Eyes without feeling, feeling without sight, Ears without hands or eyes, smelling sans all, Or but a sickly part of one true sense Could not so mope. O shame! where is thy blush? Rebellious hell, If thou canst mutine in a matron’s bones, To flaming youth let virtue be as wax, And melt in her own fire. Proclaim no shame When the compulsive ardour gives the charge, Since frost itself as actively doth burn, And reason panders will.
passages.vernacular: 睇呢幅畫像,同呢幅,兩兄弟嘅仿製畫像。睇呢額頭上坐著幾咁嘅優雅:太陽神嘅捲髮,朱庇特本人嘅前額,戰神般威嚇同號令嘅眼睛,信使墨丘利般嘅姿態,剛降落喺吻天嘅山丘上:確實一個完美嘅組合同形態,每位神明都彷彿在此蓋印,向世界保證呢個係一個男人。呢位就係你嘅丈夫。而家睇接著係咩。呢位就係你嘅丈夫,好似一根發霉嘅麥穗,摧殘佢健康嘅兄弟。你有眼睛嗎?你竟能離開呢座美麗嘅山,去呢片荒野上養肥自己?哈!你有眼睛嗎?你不能稱之為愛;因為在你呢個年紀,血氣嘅旺盛已經平息,變得謙卑,聽候判斷:而咩判斷會由呢個跨到呢個?感覺你肯定有,否則你無法行動;但肯定你嘅感覺已經中風,因為瘋狂都唔會咁出錯,感覺縱使被狂亂奴役,亦從未不留下少許選擇力,去應付咁樣嘅差別。咩魔鬼,喺蒙眼遊戲裡咁欺騙你?有眼無感,有感無視,有耳無手無眼,有嗅覺但全無其他,或者只係一個真正感官嘅病弱部分,都唔會咁糊塗。啊羞恥!你嘅紅暈在哪?叛逆嘅地獄,如果你可以喺一位婦人嘅骨頭裡造反,就讓美德對燃燒嘅青春變成蠟,在自己嘅火焰中融化。當強迫嘅熱情發出衝鋒令,唔好宣稱有恥辱,因為連霜凍本身都同樣積極地燃燒,而理性替意志做皮條客。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看這幅畫像,和這幅,兩兄弟的仿製畫像。看這額頭上坐著多麼的優雅:太陽神的捲髮,朱庇特本人的前額,戰神般威嚇和號令的眼睛,信使墨丘利般的姿態,剛降落在吻天的山丘上:確實一個完美的組合和形態,每位神明都彷彿在此蓋印,向世界保證這是一個男人。這位就是你的丈夫。現在看接著是什麼。這位就是你的丈夫,像一根發霉的麥穗,摧殘他健康的兄弟。你有眼睛嗎?你竟能離開這座美麗的山,去這片荒野上養肥自己?哈!你有眼睛嗎?你不能稱之為愛;因為在你這個年紀,血氣的旺盛已經平息,變得謙卑,聽候判斷:而什麼判斷會由這個跨到這個?感覺你肯定有,否則你無法行動;但肯定你的感覺已經中風,因為瘋狂都不會這樣出錯,感覺縱使被狂亂奴役,也從未不留下少許選擇力,去應付這樣的差別。什麼魔鬼,在蒙眼遊戲裡這樣欺騙你?有眼無感,有感無視,有耳無手無眼,有嗅覺但全無其他,或者只是一個真正感官的病弱部分,都不會這樣糊塗。啊羞恥!你的紅暈在哪?叛逆的地獄,如果你可以在一位婦人的骨頭裡造反,就讓美德對燃燒的青春變成蠟,在自己的火焰中融化。當強迫的熱情發出衝鋒令,不要宣稱有恥辱,因為連霜凍本身都同樣積極地燃燒,而理性替意志做皮條客。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: O Hamlet, speak no more. Thou turn’st mine eyes into my very soul, And there I see such black and grained spots As will not leave their tinct.
passages.vernacular: 啊哈姆雷特,唔好再講喇。你將我嘅眼睛轉向我靈魂深處,在嗰度我見到咁黑咁根深蒂固嘅斑點,洗唔走佢哋嘅顏色。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊哈姆雷特,別再說了。你將我的眼睛轉向我靈魂深處,在那裡我見到這麼黑這麼根深蒂固的斑點,洗不掉它們的顏色。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Nay, but to live In the rank sweat of an enseamed bed, Stew’d in corruption, honeying and making love Over the nasty sty.
passages.vernacular: 唔,但要生活在被油膩污染嘅床鋪嘅惡臭汗水裡,浸泡喺腐敗之中,在骯髒豬圈上講甜言蜜語、做愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,但要生活在被油膩污染的床鋪的惡臭汗水裡,浸泡在腐敗之中,在骯髒豬圈上說甜言蜜語、做愛。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: O speak to me no more; These words like daggers enter in mine ears; No more, sweet Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 啊,唔好再對我講喇;呢啲講話好似匕首刺入我耳朵;唔好再講,親愛嘅哈姆雷特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,別再對我說了;這些話像匕首刺入我耳朵;別再說,親愛的哈姆雷特。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: A murderer and a villain; A slave that is not twentieth part the tithe Of your precedent lord. A vice of kings, A cutpurse of the empire and the rule, That from a shelf the precious diadem stole And put it in his pocket!
passages.vernacular: 一個兇手同惡棍;一個連你前任丈夫二十分之一嘅十分之一都不如嘅奴才。一個國王中嘅丑角,一個竊取帝國同統治權嘅扒手,從架子上偷走珍貴王冠,放入自己口袋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個兇手和惡棍;一個連你前任丈夫二十分之一的十分之一都不如的奴才。一個國王中的丑角,一個竊取帝國和統治權的扒手,從架子上偷走珍貴王冠,放入自己口袋!

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: No more.
passages.vernacular: 唔好再講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別再說。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: A king of shreds and patches!—
passages.vernacular: 一個由碎布補丁拼成嘅國王!——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個由碎布補丁拼成的國王!——

passages.original: Enter Ghost.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Save me and hover o’er me with your wings, You heavenly guards! What would your gracious figure?
passages.vernacular: 拯救我,用你嘅翅膀覆蓋我,你哋天上嘅衛士!你莊嚴嘅形象想要咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拯救我,用你們的翅膀覆蓋我,你們天上的衛士!你莊嚴的形象想要什麼?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alas, he’s mad.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,佢瘋喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,他瘋了。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Do you not come your tardy son to chide, That, laps’d in time and passion, lets go by The important acting of your dread command? O say!
passages.vernacular: 你唔係來責備你遲緩嘅兒子嗎,佢因時間同激情而失足,讓你可怕命令嘅重要執行溜走?啊講吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是來責備你遲緩的兒子嗎,他因時間和激情而失足,讓你可怕命令的重要執行溜走?啊說吧!

passages.title: Ghost 鬼魂
passages.original: Do not forget. This visitation Is but to whet thy almost blunted purpose. But look, amazement on thy mother sits. O step between her and her fighting soul. Conceit in weakest bodies strongest works. Speak to her, Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 唔好忘記。呢次到訪,只係為咗磨利你幾乎鈍咗嘅決心。不過睇,驚愕正坐在你母親身上。啊,站到佢同佢掙扎緊嘅靈魂之間。想像力在最虛弱嘅身體裡作用最強。同佢講話,哈姆雷特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要忘記。這次到訪,只是為了磨利你幾乎鈍了的決心。不過看,驚愕正坐在你母親身上。啊,站到她和她掙扎著的靈魂之間。想像力在最虛弱的身體裡作用最強。和她說話,哈姆雷特。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: How is it with you, lady?
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,女士?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎樣,女士?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alas, how is’t with you, That you do bend your eye on vacancy, And with the incorporal air do hold discourse? Forth at your eyes your spirits wildly peep, And, as the sleeping soldiers in the alarm, Your bedded hairs, like life in excrements, Start up and stand an end. O gentle son, Upon the heat and flame of thy distemper Sprinkle cool patience. Whereon do you look?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,你點樣呀,你將目光投向虛空,同無形嘅空氣交談?你嘅精神從眼睛狂野地窺視,好似警報中睡著嘅士兵,你躺臥嘅頭髮,好似排泄物中有生命,豎立起來。啊溫柔嘅兒子,請向你狂熱嘅火焰灑下涼爽嘅耐心。你望住邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,你怎樣啊,你將目光投向虛空,和無形的空氣交談?你的精神從眼睛狂野地窺視,像警報中睡著的士兵,你躺臥的頭髮,像排泄物中有生命,豎立起來。啊溫柔的兒子,請向你狂熱的火焰灑下涼爽的耐心。你望著哪裡?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: On him, on him! Look you how pale he glares, His form and cause conjoin’d, preaching to stones, Would make them capable.—Do not look upon me, Lest with this piteous action you convert My stern effects. Then what I have to do Will want true colour; tears perchance for blood.
passages.vernacular: 望住佢,望住佢!睇佢瞪眼嘅臉幾蒼白,佢嘅形象同事由結合起來,足以向石頭講教,令佢哋也能領會。——唔好望住我,恐怕你呢副可憐嘅姿態,會改變我嚴厲嘅行動。咁我要做嘅事,就欠缺真正嘅顏色;也許流嘅會係眼淚,而唔係血。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 望著他,望著他!看他瞪眼的臉多蒼白,他的形象和事由結合起來,足以向石頭說教,使它們也能領會。——別望著我,恐怕你這副可憐的姿態,會改變我嚴厲的行動。那我要做的事,就欠缺真正的顏色;也許流的會是眼淚,而不是血。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: To whom do you speak this?
passages.vernacular: 你對誰講呢啲?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你對誰說這些?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Do you see nothing there?
passages.vernacular: 你喺嗰度見唔到任何嘢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在那裡看不到任何東西嗎?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Nothing at all; yet all that is I see.
passages.vernacular: 完全冇;但凡存在嘅,我都見到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 完全沒有;但凡存在的,我都看到。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Nor did you nothing hear?
passages.vernacular: 你亦咩都冇聽到?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你也什麼都沒聽到?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: No, nothing but ourselves.
passages.vernacular: 冇,除咗我哋自己。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,除了我們自己。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Why, look you there! look how it steals away! My father, in his habit as he liv’d! Look where he goes even now out at the portal.
passages.vernacular: 咦,你睇嗰邊!睇佢點樣溜走!我父親,穿住佢生前嘅衣服!睇佢而家正從門口走出去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,你看那邊!看他怎樣溜走!我父親,穿著他生前的衣服!看他現在正從門口走出去。

passages.original: [Exit Ghost.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂下。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: This is the very coinage of your brain. This bodiless creation ecstasy Is very cunning in.
passages.vernacular: 呢個完全係你腦袋鑄造出嚟嘅。狂亂最擅長製造呢種無形嘅創造。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這完全是你腦袋鑄造出來的。狂亂最擅長製造這種無形的創造。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Ecstasy! My pulse as yours doth temperately keep time, And makes as healthful music. It is not madness That I have utter’d. Bring me to the test, And I the matter will re-word; which madness Would gambol from. Mother, for love of grace, Lay not that flattering unction to your soul That not your trespass, but my madness speaks. It will but skin and film the ulcerous place, Whilst rank corruption, mining all within, Infects unseen. Confess yourself to heaven, Repent what’s past, avoid what is to come; And do not spread the compost on the weeds, To make them ranker. Forgive me this my virtue; For in the fatness of these pursy times Virtue itself of vice must pardon beg, Yea, curb and woo for leave to do him good.
passages.vernacular: 狂亂!我嘅脈搏同你一樣節奏平穩,奏出同樣健康嘅音樂。我所講嘅並非瘋話。試我一試,我可以逐字重複呢件事;瘋狂係做不到嘅,佢會東跳西蹦。母親,睇在恩典分上,唔好畀靈魂塗上嗰劑奉承嘅膏藥,以為講話嘅係我嘅瘋狂而唔係你嘅過犯。佢只會令潰瘍處長層皮膜,而惡臭嘅腐敗在內部挖掘,無形地傳染。向上天懺悔,悔改過去,避免未來;唔好將肥料撒在雜草上,令佢哋長得更茂盛。原諒我呢番「美德」;因為在呢個肥胖氣喘嘅時代,美德本身也要向邪惡乞求原諒,係啊,要屈身懇求准許去對佢好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 狂亂!我的脈搏和你一樣節奏平穩,奏出同樣健康的音樂。我所說的並非瘋話。試我一試,我可以逐字重複這件事;瘋狂是做不到的,它會東跳西蹦。母親,看在恩典分上,別給靈魂塗上那劑奉承的膏藥,以為說話的是我的瘋狂而不是你的過犯。它只會使潰瘍處長層皮膜,而惡臭的腐敗在內部挖掘,無形地傳染。向上天懺悔,悔改過去,避免未來;不要將肥料撒在雜草上,使它們長得更茂盛。原諒我這番「美德」;因為在這個肥胖氣喘的時代,美德本身也要向邪惡乞求原諒,是啊,要屈身懇求准許去對它好。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: O Hamlet, thou hast cleft my heart in twain.
passages.vernacular: 啊哈姆雷特,你將我嘅心劈成兩半。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊哈姆雷特,你將我的心劈成兩半。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: O throw away the worser part of it, And live the purer with the other half. Good night. But go not to mine uncle’s bed. Assume a virtue, if you have it not. That monster custom, who all sense doth eat, Of habits evil, is angel yet in this, That to the use of actions fair and good He likewise gives a frock or livery That aptly is put on. Refrain tonight, And that shall lend a kind of easiness To the next abstinence. The next more easy; For use almost can change the stamp of nature, And either curb the devil, or throw him out With wondrous potency. Once more, good night, And when you are desirous to be bles’d, I’ll blessing beg of you. For this same lord [Pointing to Polonius.] I do repent; but heaven hath pleas’d it so, To punish me with this, and this with me, That I must be their scourge and minister. I will bestow him, and will answer well The death I gave him. So again, good night. I must be cruel, only to be kind: Thus bad begins, and worse remains behind. One word more, good lady.
passages.vernacular: 啊,將較差嗰半丟掉,用另一半純淨地生活。晚安。但別去我叔叔嘅床。如果你冇美德,就假裝擁有一個。嗰隻吞噬一切感覺嘅怪物「習慣」,雖然助長惡習,但在呢一點上仍係天使:佢同樣為美好善良嘅行為提供一件合身嘅外衣或制服。今晚節制,咁就會令下次嘅節制容易一些。再下次更容易;因為習慣幾乎可以改變本性嘅印記,並以驚人嘅力量制服魔鬼,或者將佢趕出去。再講一次,晚安,當你渴望受到祝福時,我會向你求祝福。至於呢位大人,[指波洛涅斯。]我確實後悔;但上天既然如此安排,用此人懲罰我,又用我懲罰此人,令我必須成為佢哋嘅鞭子同執行者。我會安置佢,並好好交代我造成嘅死亡。就咁,再次晚安。我必須殘酷,只為仁慈:壞事由此開始,更壞嘅仍在後頭。再講一句,好女士。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,將較差的那半丟掉,用另一半純淨地生活。晚安。但別去我叔叔的床。如果你沒有美德,就假裝擁有一個。那隻吞噬一切感覺的怪物「習慣」,雖然助長惡習,但在這一點上仍是天使:它同樣為美好善良的行為提供一件合身的外衣或制服。今晚節制,這就會使下次的節制容易一些。再下次更容易;因為習慣幾乎可以改變本性的印記,並以驚人的力量制服魔鬼,或者將他趕出去。再說一次,晚安,當你渴望受到祝福時,我會向你求祝福。至於這位大人,[指波洛涅斯。]我確實後悔;但上天既然如此安排,用此人懲罰我,又用我懲罰此人,使我必須成為他們的鞭子和執行者。我會安置他,並好好交代我造成的死亡。就這樣,再次晚安。我必須殘酷,只為仁慈:壞事由此開始,更壞的仍在後頭。再說一句,好女士。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: What shall I do?
passages.vernacular: 我應該做咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我應該做什麼?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Not this, by no means, that I bid you do: Let the bloat King tempt you again to bed, Pinch wanton on your cheek, call you his mouse, And let him, for a pair of reechy kisses, Or paddling in your neck with his damn’d fingers, Make you to ravel all this matter out, That I essentially am not in madness, But mad in craft. ’Twere good you let him know, For who that’s but a queen, fair, sober, wise, Would from a paddock, from a bat, a gib, Such dear concernings hide? Who would do so? No, in despite of sense and secrecy, Unpeg the basket on the house’s top, Let the birds fly, and like the famous ape, To try conclusions, in the basket creep And break your own neck down.
passages.vernacular: 絕對唔好做我要你做嘅呢樣:讓嗰個臃腫嘅國王再引你上床,在你臉頰上放蕩地捏一下,叫你做佢嘅小老鼠,讓佢用一對惡臭嘅吻,或者用佢該死嘅手指在你頸上玩弄,令你將整件事和盤托出,話我其實並非真瘋,只係裝瘋。你讓佢知道也好,因為有哪個只係王后、美麗、清醒、聰明嘅女人,會對一隻癩蛤蟆、一隻蝙蝠、一隻公貓,隱瞞咁重要嘅事?誰會咁做?唔,不顧理智同保密,打開屋頂上嘅籃子,讓鳥飛出去,好似嗰隻著名嘅猴子,為咗試驗結果,爬入籃子,跌斷自己頸項。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 絕對不要做我要你做的這樣:讓那個臃腫的國王再引你上床,在你臉頰上放蕩地捏一下,叫你做他的小老鼠,讓他用一對惡臭的吻,或者用他該死的手指在你頸上玩弄,使你將整件事和盤托出,說我其實並非真瘋,只是裝瘋。你讓他知道也好,因為有哪個只是王后、美麗、清醒、聰明的女人,會對一隻癩蛤蟆、一隻蝙蝠、一隻公貓,隱瞞這麼重要的事?誰會這樣做?不,不顧理智和保密,打開屋頂上的籃子,讓鳥飛出去,像那隻著名的猴子,為了試驗結果,爬入籃子,跌斷自己頸項。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Be thou assur’d, if words be made of breath, And breath of life, I have no life to breathe What thou hast said to me.
passages.vernacular: 你放心,如果講話由氣息造成,而氣息由生命造成,我冇生命去呼出你對我所講嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你放心,如果說話由氣息造成,而氣息由生命造成,我沒生命去呼出你對我所說的。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I must to England, you know that?
passages.vernacular: 我必須去英格蘭,你知道嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須去英格蘭,你知道嗎?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alack, I had forgot. ’Tis so concluded on.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我忘記喇。已經咁決定。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我忘記了。已經這樣決定。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: There’s letters seal’d: and my two schoolfellows, Whom I will trust as I will adders fang’d,— They bear the mandate, they must sweep my way And marshal me to knavery. Let it work; For ’tis the sport to have the enginer Hoist with his own petard, and ’t shall go hard But I will delve one yard below their mines And blow them at the moon. O, ’tis most sweet, When in one line two crafts directly meet. This man shall set me packing. I’ll lug the guts into the neighbour room. Mother, good night. Indeed, this counsellor Is now most still, most secret, and most grave, Who was in life a foolish prating knave. Come, sir, to draw toward an end with you. Good night, mother.
passages.vernacular: 有密封嘅信件:而我兩個同學——我會像信任長牙毒蛇般信任佢哋——佢哋帶著命令,佢哋要為我掃路,並領我走向奸計。隨佢去吧;因為最有趣就係讓工兵被自己嘅炸藥炸上天,我一定要比佢哋嘅地道挖深一碼,將佢哋炸上月亮。啊,最甜美嘅就係,兩種詭計在同一條線上直接相遇。呢個人迫我收拾行李。我要將呢具內臟拖入隔壁房間。母親,晚安。的確,呢位顧問而家最安靜、最隱秘、最莊重,佢生前卻係個愚蠢多嘴嘅惡棍。來,先生,我要同你收尾喇。晚安,母親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有密封的信件:而我兩個同學——我會像信任長牙毒蛇般信任他們——他們帶著命令,他們要為我掃路,並領我走向奸計。隨它去吧;因為最有趣就是讓工兵被自己的炸藥炸上天,我一定要比他們的地道挖深一碼,將他們炸上月亮。啊,最甜美的就是,兩種詭計在同一條線上直接相遇。這個人迫使我收拾行李。我要將這具內臟拖入隔壁房間。母親,晚安。的確,這位顧問現在最安靜、最隱祕、最莊重,他生前卻是個愚蠢多嘴的惡棍。來,先生,我要和你收尾了。晚安,母親。

passages.original: [Exit Hamlet dragging out Polonius.]
passages.vernacular: [哈姆雷特拖著波洛涅斯下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [哈姆雷特拖著波洛涅斯下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene I — A Room in the Castle 第四幕第一場:城堡一室

passages.original: Enter King, Queen, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.
passages.vernacular: [國王、王后、羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [國王、王后、羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: There’s matter in these sighs. These profound heaves You must translate; ’tis fit we understand them. Where is your son?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲歎息背後有緣由。呢啲深沉嘅喘息,你必須翻譯出來;我哋應該明白佢哋。你兒子在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些歎息背後有緣由。這些深沉的喘息,你必須翻譯出來;我們應該明白它們。你兒子在哪?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Bestow this place on us a little while.
passages.vernacular: 請將此地讓畀我哋一陣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請將此地讓給我們一陣。

passages.original: [To Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, who go out.]
passages.vernacular: [對羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩,二人退出。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩,二人退出。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Ah, my good lord, what have I seen tonight!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我嘅好陛下,我今晚見到咗啲咩!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我的好陛下,我今晚見到了什麼!

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: What, Gertrude? How does Hamlet?
passages.vernacular: 咩事,葛楚德?哈姆雷特點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事,葛楚德?哈姆雷特怎樣?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Mad as the sea and wind, when both contend Which is the mightier. In his lawless fit Behind the arras hearing something stir, Whips out his rapier, cries ‘A rat, a rat!’ And in this brainish apprehension kills The unseen good old man.
passages.vernacular: 瘋得似海同風,當兩者爭論誰更強大。在佢無法無天嘅發作中,聽到掛毯後面有動靜,拔出佢嘅劍,大叫「老鼠,老鼠!」就在呢個狂亂嘅幻覺中,殺死咗嗰位睇不見嘅好老人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 瘋得像海和風,當兩者爭論誰更強大。在他無法無天的發作中,聽到掛毯後面有動靜,拔出他的劍,大叫「老鼠,老鼠!」就在這個狂亂的幻覺中,殺死了那位看不見的好老人。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: O heavy deed! It had been so with us, had we been there. His liberty is full of threats to all; To you yourself, to us, to everyone. Alas, how shall this bloody deed be answer’d? It will be laid to us, whose providence Should have kept short, restrain’d, and out of haunt This mad young man. But so much was our love We would not understand what was most fit, But like the owner of a foul disease, To keep it from divulging, let it feed Even on the pith of life. Where is he gone?
passages.vernacular: 啊沉重嘅罪行!如果我哋當時在場,亦會同樣遭殃。佢嘅自由對所有人都充滿威脅;對你自己、對我哋、對每一個人。哎呀,呢宗血案點樣交代?會歸咎於我哋,我哋嘅遠見本應將呢個瘋狂青年嚴加睇管、約束,不讓佢出入。但我哋太愛佢,不肯明白乜嘢最恰當,而係像患上惡疾嘅人,為免病情張揚,任由佢吞噬生命嘅精髓。佢去咗邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊沉重的罪行!如果我們當時在場,也會同樣遭殃。他的自由對所有人都充滿威脅;對你自己、對我們、對每一個人。哎呀,這宗血案怎樣交代?會歸咎於我們,我們的遠見本應將這個瘋狂青年嚴加看管、約束,不讓他出入。但我們太愛他,不肯明白什麼最恰當,而是像患上惡疾的人,為免病情張揚,任由它吞噬生命的精髓。他去了哪?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: To draw apart the body he hath kill’d, O’er whom his very madness, like some ore Among a mineral of metals base, Shows itself pure. He weeps for what is done.
passages.vernacular: 去將佢殺死嘅屍體拉開,在屍體旁邊,佢嘅瘋狂就好似賤金屬礦石中嘅一塊礦,顯得純淨。佢為所做嘅事哭泣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去將他殺死的屍體拉開,在屍體旁邊,他的瘋狂就像賤金屬礦石中的一塊礦,顯得純淨。他為所做的事哭泣。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: O Gertrude, come away! The sun no sooner shall the mountains touch But we will ship him hence, and this vile deed We must with all our majesty and skill Both countenance and excuse.—Ho, Guildenstern!
passages.vernacular: 啊葛楚德,我哋走!太陽一觸及山頭,我哋就會送佢上船離開,而呢宗惡行,我哋必須用所有威嚴同技巧,既支持亦開脫。——喂,吉爾登斯特恩!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊葛楚德,我們走!太陽一觸及山頭,我們就會送他上船離開,而這宗惡行,我們必須用所有威嚴和技巧,既支持也開脫。——喂,吉爾登斯特恩!

passages.original: Re-enter Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.
passages.vernacular: [羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩再上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩再上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Friends both, go join you with some further aid: Hamlet in madness hath Polonius slain, And from his mother’s closet hath he dragg’d him. Go seek him out, speak fair, and bring the body Into the chapel. I pray you haste in this.
passages.vernacular: 兩位朋友,去多找些人手幫忙:哈姆雷特在瘋狂中殺死波洛涅斯,並從佢母親內室將佢拖出。去搵佢,好言相勸,把屍體帶入禮拜堂。請你哋盡快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 兩位朋友,去多找些人手幫忙:哈姆雷特在瘋狂中殺死波洛涅斯,並從他母親內室將他拖出。去找他,好言相勸,把屍體帶進禮拜堂。請你們盡快。

passages.original: [Exeunt Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.]
passages.vernacular: [羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩下。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Come, Gertrude, we’ll call up our wisest friends, And let them know both what we mean to do And what’s untimely done, so haply slander, Whose whisper o’er the world’s diameter, As level as the cannon to his blank, Transports his poison’d shot, may miss our name, And hit the woundless air. O, come away! My soul is full of discord and dismay.
passages.vernacular: 來,葛楚德,我哋召集最有智慧嘅朋友,讓佢哋知道我哋打算做咩,以及發生咗咩不合時宜嘅事,咁樣或許誹謗——佢嘅耳語橫過世界直徑,如炮彈對準靶心一樣筆直,射出佢嘅毒彈——可能錯過我哋嘅名字,擊中無傷嘅空氣。啊,走吧!我嘅靈魂充滿不和同驚惶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,葛楚德,我們召集最有智慧的朋友,讓他們知道我們打算做什麼,以及發生了什麼不合時宜的事,這樣或許誹謗——它的耳語橫過世界直徑,如炮彈對準靶心一樣筆直,射出它的毒彈——可能錯過我們的名字,擊中無傷的空氣。啊,走吧!我的靈魂充滿不和與驚惶。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene II — Another Room 第四幕第二場:城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: [哈姆雷特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [哈姆雷特上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Safely stowed.
passages.vernacular: 安置妥當。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安置妥當。

passages.title: Rosencrantz And Guildenstern 羅森格蘭茲同吉爾登斯吞
passages.original: [Within.] Hamlet! Lord Hamlet!
passages.vernacular: [內。]哈姆雷特!哈姆雷特殿下!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]哈姆雷特!哈姆雷特殿下!

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: What noise? Who calls on Hamlet? O, here they come.
passages.vernacular: 咩聲音?誰叫哈姆雷特?啊,佢哋嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼聲音?誰叫哈姆雷特?啊,他們來了。

passages.original: Enter Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.
passages.vernacular: [羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩上。]

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: What have you done, my lord, with the dead body?
passages.vernacular: 殿下,你把屍體點樣處理喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,你把屍體怎樣處理了?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Compounded it with dust, whereto ’tis kin.
passages.vernacular: 把佢跟塵土混合,因為佢本屬同類。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把它跟塵土混合,因為它本屬同類。

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Tell us where ’tis, that we may take it thence, And bear it to the chapel.
passages.vernacular: 告訴我哋佢在哪,我哋好從嗰度搬走,抬去禮拜堂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴我們它在哪,我們好從那裡搬走,抬去禮拜堂。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Do not believe it.
passages.vernacular: 唔好相信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要相信。

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Believe what?
passages.vernacular: 相信咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信什麼?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: That I can keep your counsel, and not mine own. Besides, to be demanded of a sponge—what replication should be made by the son of a king?
passages.vernacular: 相信我能替你保守秘密,卻不替自己保守。再講,被一塊海綿盤問——國王之子應該如何回答?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我能替你保守祕密,卻不替自己保守。再說,被一塊海綿盤問——國王之子應該如何回答?

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Take you me for a sponge, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 殿下,你當我係塊海綿?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,你當我是塊海綿?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Ay, sir; that soaks up the King’s countenance, his rewards, his authorities. But such officers do the King best service in the end: he keeps them, like an ape, in the corner of his jaw; first mouthed, to be last swallowed: when he needs what you have gleaned, it is but squeezing you, and, sponge, you shall be dry again.
passages.vernacular: 係,先生;吸收國王嘅恩寵、賞賜同權力。不過呢類官員最終對國王嘅效力最大:佢像猴子咁把佢哋藏喺腮邊;最先含入口,最後吞下:當佢需要你搜刮到嘅,只需擠你一下,海綿,你就會再乾涸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,先生;吸收國王的恩寵、賞賜和權力。不過這類官員最終對國王的效力最大:他像猴子那樣把他們藏在腮邊;最先含入口,最後吞下:當他需要你搜刮到的,只需擠你一下,海綿,你就會再乾涸。

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: I understand you not, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,我唔明白你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,我不明白你。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I am glad of it. A knavish speech sleeps in a foolish ear.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興。奸猾嘅講話在愚蠢嘅耳朵裡睡著。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興。奸猾的話在愚蠢的耳朵裡睡著。

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: My lord, you must tell us where the body is and go with us to the King.
passages.vernacular: 殿下,你必須告訴我哋屍體在哪,並跟我哋去見國王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,你必須告訴我們屍體在哪,並跟我們去見國王。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: The body is with the King, but the King is not with the body. The King is a thing—
passages.vernacular: 屍體與國王同在,但國王並不與屍體同在。國王係一件東西——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 屍體與國王同在,但國王並不與屍體同在。國王是一件東西——

passages.title: Guildenstern 吉爾登斯吞
passages.original: A thing, my lord!
passages.vernacular: 一件東西,殿下!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一件東西,殿下!

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Of nothing. Bring me to him. Hide fox, and all after.
passages.vernacular: 一件虛無嘅東西。帶我去見佢。狐狸躲起來,大家追過去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一件虛無的東西。帶我去見他。狐狸躲起來,大家追過去。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene III — Another Room 第四幕第三場:城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter King, attended.
passages.vernacular: [國王帶侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [國王帶侍從上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: I have sent to seek him and to find the body. How dangerous is it that this man goes loose! Yet must not we put the strong law on him: He’s lov’d of the distracted multitude, Who like not in their judgement, but their eyes; And where ’tis so, th’offender’s scourge is weigh’d, But never the offence. To bear all smooth and even, This sudden sending him away must seem Deliberate pause. Diseases desperate grown By desperate appliance are reliev’d, Or not at all.
passages.vernacular: 我已派人去搵佢,並尋找屍體。呢個人在外逍遙,幾咁危險!但我哋唔可以對佢施以嚴厲律法:佢受混亂嘅群眾所愛,佢哋唔憑判斷,只憑眼睛喜好;在呢種情況下,只會權衡犯人所受嘅鞭笞,卻從不權衡罪行。為使一切平順,呢次突然送佢離開,必須顯得係經過深思熟慮嘅暫停。惡化到絕望嘅疾病,要靠絕望嘅療法解救,否則無救。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已派人去找他,並尋找屍體。這個人在外逍遙,多麼危險!但我們不可以對他施以嚴厲律法:他受混亂的群眾所愛,他們不憑判斷,只憑眼睛喜好;在這種情況下,只會權衡犯人所受的鞭笞,卻從不權衡罪行。為使一切平順,這次突然送他離開,必須顯得是經過深思熟慮的暫停。惡化到絕望的疾病,要靠絕望的療法解救,否則無救。

passages.original: Enter Rosencrantz.
passages.vernacular: [羅森克蘭茲上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅森克蘭茲上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: How now? What hath befall’n?
passages.vernacular: 點樣?發生咗咩事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣?發生了什麼事?

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Where the dead body is bestow’d, my lord, We cannot get from him.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,屍體放咗在哪,我哋從佢口中問唔出。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,屍體放在哪,我們從他口中問不出。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: But where is he?
passages.vernacular: 佢在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在哪?

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Without, my lord, guarded, to know your pleasure.
passages.vernacular: 在外面,陛下,有人睇守,等候您嘅旨意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在外面,陛下,有人看守,等候您的旨意。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Bring him before us.
passages.vernacular: 帶佢到我哋面前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 帶他到我們面前。

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Ho, Guildenstern! Bring in my lord.
passages.vernacular: 喂,吉爾登斯特恩!把殿下帶入來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂,吉爾登斯特恩!把殿下帶進來。

passages.original: Enter Hamlet and Guildenstern.
passages.vernacular: [哈姆雷特同吉爾登斯特恩上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [哈姆雷特和吉爾登斯特恩上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Now, Hamlet, where’s Polonius?
passages.vernacular: 哈姆雷特,波洛涅斯在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈姆雷特,波洛涅斯在哪?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: At supper.
passages.vernacular: 在吃晚餐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在吃晚餐。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: At supper? Where?
passages.vernacular: 在吃晚餐?在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在吃晚餐?在哪?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Not where he eats, but where he is eaten. A certain convocation of politic worms are e’en at him. Your worm is your only emperor for diet. We fat all creatures else to fat us, and we fat ourselves for maggots. Your fat king and your lean beggar is but variable service,—two dishes, but to one table. That’s the end.
passages.vernacular: 唔係佢食嘢嘅地方,而係佢被食嘅地方。一群精明嘅蟲正開會食緊佢。論飲食,蟲才係唯一嘅皇帝。我哋把所有其他生物養肥來養肥自己,又把自己養肥來餵蛆蟲。肥胖嘅國王同瘦削嘅乞丐,不過係不同菜式——兩道菜,同一張桌。就係咁完結。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是他吃東西的地方,而是他被吃的地方。一群精明的蟲正開會吃著他。論飲食,蟲才是唯一的皇帝。我們把所有其他生物養肥來養肥自己,又把自己養肥來餵蛆蟲。肥胖的國王和瘦削的乞丐,不過是不同菜式——兩道菜,同一張桌。就是這樣完結。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Alas, alas!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,哎呀!

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: A man may fish with the worm that hath eat of a king, and eat of the fish that hath fed of that worm.
passages.vernacular: 一個人可以用吃過國王嘅蟲去釣魚,再吃吃過嗰條蟲嘅魚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個人可以用吃過國王的蟲去釣魚,再吃吃過那條蟲的魚。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: What dost thou mean by this?
passages.vernacular: 你呢話係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這話是什麼意思?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Nothing but to show you how a king may go a progress through the guts of a beggar.
passages.vernacular: 冇乜嘢,只係向你展示一位國王如何巡遊穿過乞丐嘅腸子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒什麼,只是向你展示一位國王如何巡遊穿過乞丐的腸子。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Where is Polonius?
passages.vernacular: 波洛涅斯在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 波洛涅斯在哪?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: In heaven. Send thither to see. If your messenger find him not there, seek him i’ th’other place yourself. But indeed, if you find him not within this month, you shall nose him as you go up the stairs into the lobby.
passages.vernacular: 在天堂。派人去嗰邊睇睇。如果你嘅使者在嗰度找不到佢,你自己去另一個地方找。不過講真嘅,如果呢個月內你找不到佢,上樓梯去門廊時你就會聞到佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在天堂。派人去那邊看看。如果你的使者在那裡找不到他,你自己去另一個地方找。不過說真的,如果這個月內你找不到他,上樓梯去門廊時你就會聞到他。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: [To some Attendants.] Go seek him there.
passages.vernacular: [對幾個侍從。]去嗰度找佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對幾個侍從。]去那裡找他。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: He will stay till you come.
passages.vernacular: 佢會留在嗰度等你來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會留在那裡等你來。

passages.original: [Exeunt Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [侍從哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [侍從們下。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Hamlet, this deed, for thine especial safety,— Which we do tender, as we dearly grieve For that which thou hast done,—must send thee hence With fiery quickness. Therefore prepare thyself; The bark is ready, and the wind at help, Th’associates tend, and everything is bent For England.
passages.vernacular: 哈姆雷特,為咗你嘅特別安全——我哋珍惜你嘅安全,正如我哋深深為你所做之事悲痛——必須火速送你離開。所以準備好;船已備妥,風勢有利,同伴等候,一切都傾向英格蘭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈姆雷特,為了你的特別安全——我們珍惜你的安全,正如我們深深為你所做之事悲痛——必須火速送你離開。所以準備好;船已備妥,風勢有利,同伴等候,一切都傾向英格蘭。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: For England?
passages.vernacular: 去英格蘭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去英格蘭?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Ay, Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 係,哈姆雷特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,哈姆雷特。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Good.
passages.vernacular: 好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: So is it, if thou knew’st our purposes.
passages.vernacular: 如果你知道我哋嘅意圖,你就會覺得好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你知道我們的意圖,你就會覺得好。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I see a cherub that sees them. But, come; for England! Farewell, dear mother.
passages.vernacular: 我睇到一個知道佢哋嘅小天使。好,來,去英格蘭!再見,親愛嘅母親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看到一個知道它們的小天使。好,來,去英格蘭!再見,親愛的母親。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Thy loving father, Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 你慈愛嘅父親,哈姆雷特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你慈愛的父親,哈姆雷特。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: My mother. Father and mother is man and wife; man and wife is one flesh; and so, my mother. Come, for England.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅母親。父親同母親係夫妻;夫妻係一體;所以,我嘅母親。來,去英格蘭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的母親。父親和母親是夫妻;夫妻是一體;所以,我的母親。來,去英格蘭。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Follow him at foot. Tempt him with speed aboard; Delay it not; I’ll have him hence tonight. Away, for everything is seal’d and done That else leans on th’affair. Pray you make haste.
passages.vernacular: 緊跟著佢。誘佢火速上船;唔好拖延;今晚我就要佢離開。快去,因為其他與此事相關嘅一切都已封印妥當。請你哋盡快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 緊跟著他。誘他火速上船;不要拖延;今晚我就要他離開。快去,因為其他與此事相關的一切都已封印妥當。請你們盡快。

passages.original: [Exeunt Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.]
passages.vernacular: [羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩下。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: And England, if my love thou hold’st at aught,— As my great power thereof may give thee sense, Since yet thy cicatrice looks raw and red After the Danish sword, and thy free awe Pays homage to us,—thou mayst not coldly set Our sovereign process, which imports at full, By letters conjuring to that effect, The present death of Hamlet. Do it, England; For like the hectic in my blood he rages, And thou must cure me. Till I know ’tis done, Howe’er my haps, my joys were ne’er begun.
passages.vernacular: 英格蘭,如果你重視我嘅友好——我嘅強大力量足以令你有所體會,因為你嘅傷疤仍然紅腫,剛被丹麥之劍所傷,而你自願嘅敬畏向我哋稱臣——你就不可冷淡地對待我哋嘅君主令,佢透過信件懇切要求你,立即處死哈姆雷特。照做,英格蘭;因為佢好似我血液中嘅熱病般肆虐,而你必須醫好我。直到我知道事情辦妥,不論我嘅際遇如何,我嘅歡樂都從未開始。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 英格蘭,如果你重視我的友好——我的強大力量足以使你有所體會,因為你的傷疤仍然紅腫,剛被丹麥之劍所傷,而你自願的敬畏向我們稱臣——你就不可冷淡地對待我們的君主令,它透過信件懇切要求你,立即處死哈姆雷特。照做,英格蘭;因為他像我血液中的熱病般肆虐,而你必須醫好我。直到我知道事情辦妥,不論我的際遇如何,我的歡樂都從未開始。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene IV — A Plain in Denmark 第四幕第四場:丹麥原野

passages.original: Enter Fortinbras and Forces marching.
passages.vernacular: [福丁布拉斯率軍行進上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [福丁布拉斯率軍行進上。]

passages.title: Fortinbras 福丁布拉斯
passages.original: Go, Captain, from me greet the Danish king. Tell him that by his license, Fortinbras Craves the conveyance of a promis’d march Over his kingdom. You know the rendezvous. If that his Majesty would aught with us, We shall express our duty in his eye; And let him know so.
passages.vernacular: 隊長,你去代我向丹麥國王問安。告訴佢,憑佢嘅許可,福丁布拉斯請求按承諾借道穿過佢嘅王國。你知道會合地點。如果陛下有事找我哋,我哋會當面表達敬意;告訴佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 隊長,你去代我向丹麥國王問安。告訴他,憑他的許可,福丁布拉斯請求按承諾借道穿過他的王國。你知道會合地點。如果陛下有事找我們,我們會當面表達敬意;告訴他。

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: I will do’t, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我會照辦,殿下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會照辦,殿下。

passages.title: Fortinbras 福丁布拉斯
passages.original: Go softly on.
passages.vernacular: 慢慢前進。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 慢慢前進。

passages.original: [Exeunt all but the Captain.]
passages.vernacular: [除隊長外,眾人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [除隊長外,眾人下。]

passages.original: Enter Hamlet, Rosencrantz, Guildenstern &c.
passages.vernacular: [哈姆雷特、羅森克蘭茲、吉爾登斯特恩等上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [哈姆雷特、羅森克蘭茲、吉爾登斯特恩等上。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Good sir, whose powers are these?
passages.vernacular: 好先生,呢啲係誰嘅軍隊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生,這是誰的軍隊?

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: They are of Norway, sir.
passages.vernacular: 挪威嘅,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 挪威的,先生。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: How purpos’d, sir, I pray you?
passages.vernacular: 請問,目的為何,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請問,目的為何,先生?

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: Against some part of Poland.
passages.vernacular: 攻打波蘭某處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 攻打波蘭某處。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Who commands them, sir?
passages.vernacular: 誰統帥佢哋,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰統帥他們,先生?

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: The nephew to old Norway, Fortinbras.
passages.vernacular: 老挪威王嘅姪子,福丁布拉斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 老挪威王的姪子,福丁布拉斯。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Goes it against the main of Poland, sir, Or for some frontier?
passages.vernacular: 係攻打波蘭本土,先生,還係為某處邊境?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是攻打波蘭本土,先生,還是為某處邊境?

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: Truly to speak, and with no addition, We go to gain a little patch of ground That hath in it no profit but the name. To pay five ducats, five, I would not farm it; Nor will it yield to Norway or the Pole A ranker rate, should it be sold in fee.
passages.vernacular: 講真話,毫無誇大:我哋去奪取一小塊土地,除咗名字之外,毫無利益可言。要我付五個杜卡特,五個,我都不願租種;即使永久出售,無論對挪威還係波蘭,都賣不到更高價格。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真話,毫無誇大:我們去奪取一小塊土地,除了名字之外,毫無利益可言。要我付五個杜卡特,五個,我都不願租種;即使永久出售,無論對挪威還是波蘭,都賣不到更高價格。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Why, then the Polack never will defend it.
passages.vernacular: 咁波蘭人永遠唔會防守佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那波蘭人永遠不會防守它。

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: Yes, it is already garrison’d.
passages.vernacular: 會,已經駐軍喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 會,已經駐軍了。

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: Two thousand souls and twenty thousand ducats Will not debate the question of this straw! This is th’imposthume of much wealth and peace, That inward breaks, and shows no cause without Why the man dies. I humbly thank you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 兩千條人命同兩萬個杜卡特,都解決不了呢根稻草嘅爭議!呢個係財富同和平過多所生嘅膿瘡,向內破裂,卻不從外表顯示嗰人為何死亡。多謝你,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 兩千條人命和兩萬個杜卡特,都解決不了這根稻草的爭議!這是財富和和平過多所生的膿瘡,向內破裂,卻不從外表顯示那人為何死亡。多謝你,先生。

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: God b’ wi’ you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 願上帝與你同在,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上帝與你同在,先生。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Rosencrantz 羅森格蘭茲
passages.original: Will’t please you go, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 殿下,請走吧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殿下,請走吧?

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: I’ll be with you straight. Go a little before.
passages.vernacular: 我即刻跟上。你哋先行一小段。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我立刻跟上。你們先行一小段。

passages.original: [Exeunt all but Hamlet.]
passages.vernacular: [除哈姆雷特外,眾人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [除哈姆雷特外,眾人下。]

passages.title: Hamlet 哈姆雷特
passages.original: How all occasions do inform against me, And spur my dull revenge. What is a man If his chief good and market of his time Be but to sleep and feed? A beast, no more. Sure he that made us with such large discourse, Looking before and after, gave us not That capability and godlike reason To fust in us unus’d. Now whether it be Bestial oblivion, or some craven scruple Of thinking too precisely on th’event,— A thought which, quarter’d, hath but one part wisdom And ever three parts coward,—I do not know Why yet I live to say this thing’s to do, Sith I have cause, and will, and strength, and means To do’t. Examples gross as earth exhort me, Witness this army of such mass and charge, Led by a delicate and tender prince, Whose spirit, with divine ambition puff’d, Makes mouths at the invisible event, Exposing what is mortal and unsure To all that fortune, death, and danger dare, Even for an eggshell. Rightly to be great Is not to stir without great argument, But greatly to find quarrel in a straw When honour’s at the stake. How stand I then, That have a father kill’d, a mother stain’d, Excitements of my reason and my blood, And let all sleep, while to my shame I see The imminent death of twenty thousand men That, for a fantasy and trick of fame, Go to their graves like beds, fight for a plot Whereon the numbers cannot try the cause, Which is not tomb enough and continent To hide the slain? O, from this time forth, My thoughts be bloody or be nothing worth.
passages.vernacular: 所有際遇如何都在告發我,刺激我遲鈍嘅復仇。如果一個人一生最大嘅好處同價值只係睡覺同進食,佢算咩人?只係一頭野獸,如此而已。肯定創造我哋、賦予我哋咁廣闊推理能力、能瞻前顧後嘅嗰位,唔會把呢種能力同神一般嘅理性賜畀我哋,只為了在我哋身上閒置發霉。而家,究竟係獸性嘅遺忘,抑或過分精確思量後果嘅怯懦顧慮——一種思想,若分成四份,只有一份智慧,永遠有三份怯懦——我唔知道點解我仍然活著講「呢事要做」,既然我有理由、意志、力量同方法去做。明顯如大地嘅例子在勸勉我,睇呢支規模龐大、耗費巨大嘅軍隊,由一位嬌貴細緻嘅王子帶領,佢嘅精神被神聖嘅野心鼓脹,向無形嘅後果扮鬼臉,將凡人與不確定嘅一切暴露於命運、死亡同危險之下,僅僅為咗一個蛋殼。真正偉大,並非冇重大理由就不動,而係當榮譽受到威脅時,連一根稻草也能大爭。咁我處於乜嘢境地?我父親被殺,母親被玷污,呢啲都係激勵我理性同血氣嘅動力,卻任由一切沉睡,同時我羞恥地見到兩萬人即將死亡,佢哋為咗一個幻想同虛名之計,視墳墓如床鋪,為咗一塊連人數都不足以裝下爭論、連墳墓都不夠容納死者嘅土地而戰?啊,從此刻起,我嘅思想要麼血腥,要麼一文不值。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所有際遇如何都在告發我,刺激我遲鈍的復仇。如果一個人一生最大的好處和價值只是睡覺和進食,他算什麼人?只是一頭野獸,如此而已。肯定創造我們、賦予我們這麼廣闊推理能力、能瞻前顧後的那位,不會把這種能力和神一般的理性賜給我們,只為了在我們身上閒置發霉。現在,究竟是獸性的遺忘,抑或過分精確思量後果的怯懦顧慮——一種思想,若分成四份,只有一份智慧,永遠有三份怯懦——我不知道為什麼我仍然活著說「這事要做」,既然我有理由、意志、力量和方法去做。明顯如大地的例子在勸勉我,看這支規模龐大、耗費巨大的軍隊,由一位嬌貴細緻的王子帶領,他的精神被神聖的野心鼓脹,向無形的後果扮鬼臉,將凡人與不確定的一切暴露於命運、死亡和危險之下,僅僅為了一個蛋殼。真正偉大,並非沒有重大理由就不動,而是當榮譽受到威脅時,連一根稻草也能大爭。那我處於什麼境地?我父親被殺,母親被玷污,這些都是激勵我理性和血氣的動力,卻任由一切沉睡,同時我羞恥地見到兩萬人即將死亡,他們為了一個幻想和虛名之計,視墳墓如床鋪,為了一塊連人數都不足以裝下爭論、連墳墓都不夠容納死者的土地而戰?啊,從此刻起,我的思想要麼血腥,要麼一文不值。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene V — Elsinore 第四幕第五場:艾爾西諾

passages.original: Enter Queen, Horatio and a Gentleman.
passages.vernacular: [王后、霍拉旭同一位紳士上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [王后、霍拉旭和一位紳士上。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: I will not speak with her.
passages.vernacular: 我唔想同佢講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不想和她說話。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: She is importunate, indeed distract. Her mood will needs be pitied.
passages.vernacular: 佢糾纏不休,確實神志錯亂。佢嘅狀態令人不得不同情。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她糾纏不休,確實神志錯亂。她的狀態令人不得不同情。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: What would she have?
passages.vernacular: 佢想要咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她想要什麼?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: She speaks much of her father; says she hears There’s tricks i’ th’ world, and hems, and beats her heart, Spurns enviously at straws, speaks things in doubt, That carry but half sense. Her speech is nothing, Yet the unshaped use of it doth move The hearers to collection; they aim at it, And botch the words up fit to their own thoughts, Which, as her winks, and nods, and gestures yield them, Indeed would make one think there might be thought, Though nothing sure, yet much unhappily. ’Twere good she were spoken with, for she may strew Dangerous conjectures in ill-breeding minds.
passages.vernacular: 佢常常提起父親;話聽到世間有詭計,又咳嗽,捶打自己嘅心,憤恨地踢開稻草,講些可疑嘅話,只有一半意思。佢嘅話毫無意義,但佢嗰無形嘅用法卻促使聽者去推敲;佢哋揣測,並拼湊嗰啲話以配合自己嘅想法,加上佢嘅眨眼、點頭同手勢,確實令人覺得其中可能有深意,雖然不確定,卻極為不幸。最好同佢談一談,因為佢可能在不良心思嘅人心中散播危險嘅猜測。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她常常提起父親;說聽到世間有詭計,又咳嗽,捶打自己的心,憤恨地踢開稻草,說些可疑的話,只有一半意思。她的話毫無意義,但她那無形的用法卻促使聽者去推敲;他們揣測,並拼湊那些話以配合自己的想法,加上她的眨眼、點頭和手勢,確實使人覺得其中可能有深意,雖然不確定,卻極為不幸。最好和她談一談,因為她可能在不良心思的人心中散播危險的猜測。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Let her come in.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢入來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓她進來。

passages.original: [Exit Gentleman.]
passages.vernacular: [紳士下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [紳士下。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: To my sick soul, as sin’s true nature is, Each toy seems prologue to some great amiss. So full of artless jealousy is guilt, It spills itself in fearing to be spilt.
passages.vernacular: 對我呢個病態嘅靈魂來講,正如罪惡嘅本性,每一件小玩意都似乎係某場大災禍嘅序幕。罪疚充滿拙劣嘅猜疑,因恐懼被溢出而自行溢出。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對我這個病態的靈魂來說,正如罪惡的本性,每一件小玩意都似乎是某場大災禍的序幕。罪疚充滿拙劣的猜疑,因恐懼被溢出而自行溢出。

passages.original: Enter Ophelia.
passages.vernacular: [奧菲莉亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧菲莉亞上。]

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Where is the beauteous Majesty of Denmark?
passages.vernacular: 丹麥嗰位美麗嘅陛下在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丹麥那位美麗的陛下在哪?

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: How now, Ophelia?
passages.vernacular: 點呀,奧菲莉亞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,奧菲莉亞?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: [Sings.] How should I your true love know From another one? By his cockle hat and staff And his sandal shoon.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]我該如何分辨你嘅真愛,與別人有何不同?憑佢嘅扇貝帽、手杖同涼鞋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]我該如何分辨你的真愛,與別人有何不同?憑他的扇貝帽、手杖和涼鞋。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alas, sweet lady, what imports this song?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,好女士,呢首歌係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,好女士,這首歌是什麼意思?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Say you? Nay, pray you mark. [Sings.] He is dead and gone, lady, He is dead and gone, At his head a grass green turf, At his heels a stone.
passages.vernacular: 你話咩?唔,請你留意。[唱。]佢死喇,走喇,女士,佢死喇,走喇,佢頭邊一塊草皮,佢腳邊一塊石。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說什麼?不,請你留意。[唱。]他死了,走了,女士,他死了,走了,他頭邊一塊草皮,他腳邊一塊石。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Nay, but Ophelia—
passages.vernacular: 唔,但奧菲莉亞——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,但奧菲莉亞——

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Pray you mark. [Sings.] White his shroud as the mountain snow.
passages.vernacular: 請你留意。[唱。]佢嘅裹屍布白如山上雪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你留意。[唱。]他的裹屍布白如山上雪。

passages.original: Enter King.
passages.vernacular: [國王上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [國王上。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alas, look here, my lord!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,你睇,陛下!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,你看,陛下!

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: [Sings.] Larded all with sweet flowers; Which bewept to the grave did not go With true-love showers.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]遍佈甜美花朵;佢被哭著送入墳墓時,並無真愛之雨相伴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]遍佈甜美花朵;他被哭著送入墳墓時,並無真愛之雨相伴。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: How do you, pretty lady?
passages.vernacular: 你好嗎,漂亮嘅小姐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你好嗎,漂亮的小姐?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Well, God dild you! They say the owl was a baker’s daughter. Lord, we know what we are, but know not what we may be. God be at your table!
passages.vernacular: 好,上帝報答你!人話貓頭鷹曾係麵包師嘅女兒。主啊,我哋知道自己係乜嘢,卻不知道我哋可能變成乜嘢。願上帝同你一齊用餐!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,上帝報答你!人說貓頭鷹曾是麵包師的女兒。主啊,我們知道自己是什麼,卻不知道我們可能變成什麼。願上帝與你一起用餐!

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Conceit upon her father.
passages.vernacular: 佢念念不忘父親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她念念不忘父親。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Pray you, let’s have no words of this; but when they ask you what it means, say you this: [Sings.] Tomorrow is Saint Valentine’s day, All in the morning betime, And I a maid at your window, To be your Valentine.
passages.vernacular: 請你,我哋別談呢個;但當人問你呢個係乜嘢意思,你就咁樣講:[唱。]明日係聖瓦倫丁日,一大清早,我係個少女在你窗前,要做你嘅情人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,我們別談這個;但當人問你這是什麼意思,你就這樣說:[唱。]明日是聖瓦倫丁日,一大清早,我是個少女在你窗前,要做你的情人。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Then up he rose and donn’d his clothes, And dupp’d the chamber door, Let in the maid, that out a maid Never departed more.
passages.vernacular: 於是佢起身穿衣,拉開閨房門閂,放進少女,少女入去後,再冇一個以少女之身出來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 於是他起身穿衣,拉開閨房門閂,放進少女,少女進去後,再沒一個以少女之身出來。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Pretty Ophelia!
passages.vernacular: 可愛嘅奧菲莉亞!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可愛的奧菲莉亞!

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Indeed la, without an oath, I’ll make an end on’t. [Sings.] By Gis and by Saint Charity, Alack, and fie for shame! Young men will do’t if they come to’t; By Cock, they are to blame.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,不用發誓,我會唱完呢首。[唱。]憑耶穌同聖慈善,哎呀,真羞恥!年輕男人到了時候就會做;憑上帝,佢哋該受責備。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,不用發誓,我會唱完這首。[唱。]憑耶穌和聖慈善,哎呀,真羞恥!年輕男人到了時候就會做;憑上帝,他們該受責備。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: Quoth she, before you tumbled me, You promis’d me to wed. So would I ha’ done, by yonder sun, An thou hadst not come to my bed.
passages.vernacular: 佢講,在你同我翻滾之前,你答應過娶我。憑嗰邊嘅太陽,如果你冇上我嘅床,我本來會照做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她說,在你和我翻滾之前,你答應過娶我。憑那邊的太陽,如果你沒上我的床,我本來會照做。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: How long hath she been thus?
passages.vernacular: 佢呢樣多久喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她這樣多久了?

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: I hope all will be well. We must be patient. But I cannot choose but weep, to think they would lay him i’ th’ cold ground. My brother shall know of it. And so I thank you for your good counsel. Come, my coach! Good night, ladies; good night, sweet ladies; good night, good night.
passages.vernacular: 我希望一切都會好。我哋必須耐心。但我不禁哭泣,想到佢哋會把佢放入冰冷嘅地下。我哥哥會知道。所以多謝你嘅良言。來,我嘅馬車!晚安,各位女士;晚安,可愛嘅女士哋;晚安,晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望一切都會好。我們必須耐心。但我不禁哭泣,想到他們會把他放入冰冷的地下。我哥哥會知道。所以多謝你的良言。來,我的馬車!晚安,各位女士;晚安,可愛的女士們;晚安,晚安。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Follow her close; give her good watch, I pray you.
passages.vernacular: 緊緊跟著佢;請好好睇住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 緊緊跟著她;請好好看住她。

passages.original: [Exit Horatio.]
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭下。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: O, this is the poison of deep grief; it springs All from her father’s death. O Gertrude, Gertrude, When sorrows come, they come not single spies, But in battalions. First, her father slain; Next, your son gone; and he most violent author Of his own just remove; the people muddied, Thick, and unwholesome in their thoughts and whispers For good Polonius’ death; and we have done but greenly In hugger-mugger to inter him. Poor Ophelia Divided from herself and her fair judgement, Without the which we are pictures or mere beasts. Last, and as much containing as all these, Her brother is in secret come from France, Feeds on his wonder, keeps himself in clouds, And wants not buzzers to infect his ear With pestilent speeches of his father’s death, Wherein necessity, of matter beggar’d, Will nothing stick our person to arraign In ear and ear. O my dear Gertrude, this, Like to a murdering piece, in many places Gives me superfluous death.
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢個係深重悲傷嘅毒;全由佢父親之死而來。啊葛楚德,葛楚德,悲傷來臨時,唔係單個偵察兵,而係成營成營地來。先係佢父親被殺;其次,你兒子離開;而且佢自己係造成自己被逐嘅最暴烈肇事者;民眾被攪渾,因善良波洛涅斯之死,思想同流言都變得稠密不健康;而我哋草草秘密安葬佢,做得太不成熟。可憐嘅奧菲莉亞,與自己同美好嘅判斷力分離,失去判斷,我哋不過係畫像或純粹野獸。最後,份量等同以上所有:佢哥哥秘密從法國返來,沉浸於驚愕,將自己包裹於疑雲之中,且不缺搬弄是非者用有毒嘅言論感染佢耳朵,講佢父親死因;嗰啲人因事實匱乏,必然不吝在耳邊傳言中指控我本人。啊我親愛嘅葛楚德,呢件事,好似一門散彈炮,在多處畀我多餘嘅死亡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這是深重悲傷的毒;全由她父親之死而來。啊葛楚德,葛楚德,悲傷來臨時,不是單個偵察兵,而是成營成營地來。先是她父親被殺;其次,你兒子離開;而且他自己是造成自己被逐的最暴烈肇事者;民眾被攪渾,因善良波洛涅斯之死,思想和流言都變得稠密不健康;而我們草草祕密安葬他,做得太不成熟。可憐的奧菲莉亞,與自己和美好的判斷力分離,失去判斷,我們不過是畫像或純粹野獸。最後,份量等同以上所有:她哥哥祕密從法國回來,沉浸於驚愕,將自己包裹於疑雲之中,且不缺搬弄是非者用有毒的言論感染他耳朵,說他父親死因;那些人因事實匱乏,必然不吝在耳邊傳言中指控我本人。啊我親愛的葛楚德,這件事,像一門散彈炮,在多處給我多餘的死亡。

passages.original: [A noise within.]
passages.vernacular: [內有喧嘩聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有喧嘩聲。]

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Alack, what noise is this?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,係乜嘢聲音?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,是什麼聲音?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Where are my Switzers? Let them guard the door.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅瑞士衛兵在哪?讓佢哋守門。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的瑞士衛兵在哪?讓他們守門。

passages.original: Enter a Gentleman.
passages.vernacular: [一位紳士上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一位紳士上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: What is the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Save yourself, my lord. The ocean, overpeering of his list, Eats not the flats with more impetuous haste Than young Laertes, in a riotous head, O’erbears your offices. The rabble call him lord, And, as the world were now but to begin, Antiquity forgot, custom not known, The ratifiers and props of every word, They cry ‘Choose we! Laertes shall be king!’ Caps, hands, and tongues applaud it to the clouds, ‘Laertes shall be king, Laertes king.’
passages.vernacular: 陛下,快保護自己。海洋漫過堤岸,吞噬灘塗,也冇年輕嘅雷歐提斯率領暴動之軍壓倒你嘅官員時咁急迫。暴民稱佢為主,就好像世界剛要開始,古老被遺忘,習俗不為人知,呢啲本係每句話嘅批准者同支柱,佢哋大喊「選我哋!雷歐提斯當國王!」帽子、手同舌頭將之歡呼直上雲霄,「雷歐提斯當國王,雷歐提斯王!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,快保護自己。海洋漫過堤岸,吞噬灘塗,也沒有年輕的雷歐提斯率領暴動之軍壓倒你的官員時那麼急迫。暴民稱他為主,就好像世界剛要開始,古老被遺忘,習俗不為人知,這些本是每句話的批准者和支柱,他們大喊「選我們!雷歐提斯當國王!」帽子、手和舌頭將之歡呼直上雲霄,「雷歐提斯當國王,雷歐提斯王!」

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: How cheerfully on the false trail they cry. O, this is counter, you false Danish dogs.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋沿著錯誤足跡叫得多麼歡暢。啊,呢個係逆向追蹤,你哋呢班虛假嘅丹麥獵犬。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們沿著錯誤足跡叫得多麼歡暢。啊,這是逆向追蹤,你們這班虛假的丹麥獵犬。

passages.original: [A noise within.]
passages.vernacular: [內有喧嘩聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有喧嘩聲。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: The doors are broke.
passages.vernacular: 門被撞破喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 門被撞破了。

passages.original: Enter Laertes, armed; Danes following.
passages.vernacular: [雷歐提斯全副武裝上;丹麥人隨後。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷歐提斯全副武裝上;丹麥人隨後。]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Where is this king?—Sirs, stand you all without.
passages.vernacular: 呢個國王在哪?——各位,你哋全部站在外面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個國王在哪?——各位,你們全部站在外面。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Danes. No, let’s come in.
passages.vernacular: 丹麥人。不,我哋入去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丹麥人。不,我們進去。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: I pray you, give me leave.
passages.vernacular: 請你哋,讓我獨自處理。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你們,讓我獨自處理。

passages.title: Danes 丹麥人
passages.original: We will, we will.
passages.vernacular: 好,好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,好。

passages.original: [They retire without the door.]
passages.vernacular: [佢哋退到門外。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [他們退到門外。]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: I thank you. Keep the door. O thou vile king, Give me my father.
passages.vernacular: 多謝你哋。守住門。啊,你呢卑劣嘅國王,還我父親來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 多謝你們。守住門。啊,你這卑劣的國王,還我父親來。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: Calmly, good Laertes.
passages.vernacular: 冷靜,好雷歐提斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 冷靜,好雷歐提斯。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: That drop of blood that’s calm proclaims me bastard; Cries cuckold to my father, brands the harlot Even here between the chaste unsmirched brow Of my true mother.
passages.vernacular: 嗰滴冷靜嘅血宣告我係私生子;叫我父親做綠帽夫,在我真正母親純潔無瑕嘅額頭上烙上娼婦印記。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那滴冷靜的血宣告我是私生子;叫我父親做綠帽夫,在我真正母親純潔無瑕的額頭上烙上娼婦印記。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: What is the cause, Laertes, That thy rebellion looks so giant-like?— Let him go, Gertrude. Do not fear our person. There’s such divinity doth hedge a king, That treason can but peep to what it would, Acts little of his will.—Tell me, Laertes, Why thou art thus incens’d.—Let him go, Gertrude:— Speak, man.
passages.vernacular: 雷歐提斯,係乜嘢原因,令你嘅叛亂睇起來如此巨人般龐大?——放開佢,葛楚德。唔好為我哋嘅安危擔憂。君王身邊有一種神聖,如同籬笆圍護,叛逆只能窺視其所欲,難以付諸大部分意願。——告訴我,雷歐提斯,你為何如此憤怒?——放開佢,葛楚德:——講吧,人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雷歐提斯,是什麼原因,使你的叛亂看起來如此巨人般龐大?——放開他,葛楚德。不要為我們的安危擔憂。君王身邊有一種神聖,如同籬笆圍護,叛逆只能窺視其所欲,難以付諸大部分意願。——告訴我,雷歐提斯,你為何如此憤怒?——放開他,葛楚德:——說吧,人。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Where is my father?
passages.vernacular: 我父親在哪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我父親在哪?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Dead.
passages.vernacular: 死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 死了。

passages.title: Queen 王后葛楚德
passages.original: But not by him.
passages.vernacular: 但唔係被佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但不是被他。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Let him demand his fill.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢盡情發問。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他盡情發問。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: How came he dead? I’ll not be juggled with. To hell, allegiance! Vows, to the blackest devil! Conscience and grace, to the profoundest pit! I dare damnation. To this point I stand, That both the worlds, I give to negligence, Let come what comes; only I’ll be reveng’d Most throughly for my father.
passages.vernacular: 佢點樣死嘅?我唔好被玩弄。效忠去死吧!誓言,去畀最黑嘅魔鬼!良心同恩典,去最深嘅深淵!我不怕下地獄。我嘅立場係:兩個世界(今生同來世),我都置之不理,來乜嘢就來乜嘢;我只要為父親徹底報仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他怎樣死的?我不要被玩弄。效忠去死吧!誓言,去給最黑的魔鬼!良心和恩典,去最深的深淵!我不怕下地獄。我的立場是:兩個世界(今生和來世),我都置之不理,來什麼就來什麼;我只要為父親徹底報仇。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Who shall stay you?
passages.vernacular: 誰能阻止你?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰能阻止你?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: My will, not all the world. And for my means, I’ll husband them so well, They shall go far with little.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅意志,而唔係整個世界。至於我嘅手段,我會節省運用,使其以少勝多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的意志,而不是整個世界。至於我的手段,我會節省運用,使其以少勝多。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Good Laertes, If you desire to know the certainty Of your dear father’s death, is’t writ in your revenge That, sweepstake, you will draw both friend and foe, Winner and loser?
passages.vernacular: 好雷歐提斯,如果你想知道你親愛父親之死嘅真相,你嘅復仇難道寫明要像撈總彩一樣,通吃朋友同敵人,贏家同輸家?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好雷歐提斯,如果你想知道你親愛父親之死的真相,你的復仇難道寫明要像撈總彩一樣,通吃朋友和敵人,贏家和輸家?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: None but his enemies.
passages.vernacular: 只有佢嘅敵人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只有他的敵人。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Will you know them then?
passages.vernacular: 咁你想認識佢哋嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那你想認識他們嗎?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: To his good friends thus wide I’ll ope my arms; And, like the kind life-rendering pelican, Repast them with my blood.
passages.vernacular: 對佢嘅好朋友,我會咁樣張開雙臂;像慈愛、獻出生命嘅鵜鶘,用我嘅血餵養佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對他的好朋友,我會這樣張開雙臂;像慈愛、獻出生命的鵜鶘,用我的血餵養他們。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Why, now you speak Like a good child and a true gentleman. That I am guiltless of your father’s death, And am most sensibly in grief for it, It shall as level to your judgement ’pear As day does to your eye.
passages.vernacular: 咦,而家你講話像個好孩子同真正嘅紳士。我對你父親之死無罪,並且深切感到悲痛,呢點會像白晝對你眼睛一樣,同樣清晰地呈而家你判斷面前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,現在你說話像個好孩子和真正的紳士。我對你父親之死無罪,並且深切感到悲痛,這點會像白晝對你眼睛一樣,同樣清晰地呈現在你判斷面前。

passages.title: Danes 丹麥人
passages.original: [Within.] Let her come in.
passages.vernacular: [內。]讓佢入來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]讓她進來。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: How now! What noise is that?
passages.vernacular: 點樣!嗰係乜嘢聲音?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了!那是什麼聲音?

passages.original: Re-enter Ophelia, fantastically dressed with straws and flowers.
passages.vernacular: [奧菲莉亞再上,奇裝異服,戴滿稻草同花朵。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧菲莉亞再上,奇裝異服,戴滿稻草和花朵。]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: O heat, dry up my brains. Tears seven times salt, Burn out the sense and virtue of mine eye. By heaven, thy madness shall be paid by weight, Till our scale turn the beam. O rose of May! Dear maid, kind sister, sweet Ophelia! O heavens, is’t possible a young maid’s wits Should be as mortal as an old man’s life? Nature is fine in love, and where ’tis fine, It sends some precious instance of itself After the thing it loves.
passages.vernacular: 啊熱氣,烤乾我嘅腦。七倍鹹嘅眼淚,燒盡我眼睛嘅感覺同功用。憑天發誓,你嘅瘋狂會按重量討回,直到我哋呢邊嘅秤盤壓過秤桿。啊五月嘅玫瑰!親愛嘅少女,好妹妹,可愛嘅奧菲莉亞!啊老天,一個年輕少女嘅神志,竟然也會像老人嘅生命一樣會死?天性在愛中最為精緻,而精緻到極致時,就會把自己某件珍貴之物送去跟隨所愛之人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊熱氣,烤乾我的腦。七倍鹹的眼淚,燒盡我眼睛的感覺和功用。憑天發誓,你的瘋狂會按重量討回,直到我們這邊的秤盤壓過秤桿。啊五月的玫瑰!親愛的少女,好妹妹,可愛的奧菲莉亞!啊老天,一個年輕少女的神志,竟然也會像老人的生命一樣會死?天性在愛中最為精緻,而精緻到極致時,就會把自己某件珍貴之物送去跟隨所愛之人。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: [Sings.] They bore him barefac’d on the bier, Hey non nonny, nonny, hey nonny And on his grave rain’d many a tear.— Fare you well, my dove!
passages.vernacular: [唱。]佢哋把佢裸露著臉抬上靈床,嘿,嫩嫩你,嫩嫩,嘿嫩嫩,佢嘅墳上落了許多淚。——再見,我嘅鴿子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]他們把他裸露著臉抬上靈床,嘿,嫩嫩你,嫩嫩,嘿嫩嫩,他的墳上落了許多淚。——再見,我的鴿子!

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Hadst thou thy wits, and didst persuade revenge, It could not move thus.
passages.vernacular: 即使你神志清醒,勸我復仇,也不能咁樣令我動容。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 即使你神志清醒,勸我復仇,也不能這樣使我動容。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: You must sing ‘Down a-down, and you call him a-down-a.’ O, how the wheel becomes it! It is the false steward that stole his master’s daughter.
passages.vernacular: 你必須唱「落呀落,你叫佢落呀落」。啊,呢「紡輪」多麼合襯!就係嗰個偷了主人女兒嘅假管家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須唱「落呀落,你叫他落呀落」。啊,這「紡輪」多麼合襯!就是那個偷了主人女兒的假管家。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: This nothing’s more than matter.
passages.vernacular: 呢啲「無意義」比有意義更有意思。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些「無意義」比有意義更有意思。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: There’s rosemary, that’s for remembrance; pray love, remember. And there is pansies, that’s for thoughts.
passages.vernacular: 呢度有迷迭香,用來紀念;親愛嘅,請記住。還有三色堇,代表思念。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡有迷迭香,用來紀念;親愛的,請記住。還有三色堇,代表思念。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: A document in madness, thoughts and remembrance fitted.
passages.vernacular: 瘋狂中嘅教誨,思念同紀念配得剛好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 瘋狂中的教誨,思念和紀念配得剛好。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: There’s fennel for you, and columbines. There’s rue for you; and here’s some for me. We may call it herb of grace o’ Sundays. O you must wear your rue with a difference. There’s a daisy. I would give you some violets, but they wither’d all when my father died. They say he made a good end. [Sings.] For bonny sweet Robin is all my joy.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係畀你嘅茴香同耬斗菜。呢個係畀你嘅芸香;呢度有些係畀我嘅。星期日我哋可以叫佢「恩典之草」。啊你必須用不同方式戴你嘅芸香。呢度有朵雛菊。我本想畀你一些紫羅蘭,但我父親死時,佢哋全部枯萎喇。人話佢善終。[唱。]因為可愛甜美嘅羅賓係我全部嘅喜悅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是給你的茴香和耬斗菜。這是給你的芸香;這裡有些是給我的。星期日我們可以叫它「恩典之草」。啊你必須用不同方式戴你的芸香。這裡有朵雛菊。我本想給你一些紫羅蘭,但我父親死時,它們全部枯萎了。人說他善終。[唱。]因為可愛甜美的羅賓是我全部的喜悅。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Thought and affliction, passion, hell itself She turns to favour and to prettiness.
passages.vernacular: 思想與苦難、激情、地獄本身,佢都化成優雅同美麗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 思想與苦難、激情、地獄本身,她都化成優雅和美麗。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: [Sings.] And will he not come again? And will he not come again? No, no, he is dead, Go to thy death-bed, He never will come again.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]佢不再回來嗎?佢不再回來嗎?不,不,佢死喇,到你臨終之床去吧,佢永遠唔會再回來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]他不再回來嗎?他不再回來嗎?不,不,他死了,到你臨終之床去吧,他永遠不會再回來。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: His beard was as white as snow, All flaxen was his poll. He is gone, he is gone, And we cast away moan. God ha’ mercy on his soul.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅鬍鬚白如雪,頭髮全係亞麻色。佢走喇,佢走喇,我哋白費呻吟。願上帝憐憫佢嘅靈魂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的鬍鬚白如雪,頭髮全是亞麻色。他走了,他走了,我們白費呻吟。願上帝憐憫他的靈魂。

passages.title: Ophelia 奧菲莉亞
passages.original: And of all Christian souls, I pray God. God b’ wi’ ye.
passages.vernacular: 還有所有基督徒嘅靈魂,我向上帝祈求。願上帝與你哋同在。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有所有基督徒的靈魂,我向上帝祈求。願上帝與你們同在。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Do you see this, O God?
passages.vernacular: 上帝啊,你見到呢個嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上帝啊,你看到這個嗎?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Laertes, I must commune with your grief, Or you deny me right. Go but apart, Make choice of whom your wisest friends you will, And they shall hear and judge ’twixt you and me. If by direct or by collateral hand They find us touch’d, we will our kingdom give, Our crown, our life, and all that we call ours To you in satisfaction; but if not, Be you content to lend your patience to us, And we shall jointly labour with your soul To give it due content.
passages.vernacular: 雷歐提斯,我必須與你嘅悲傷相通,否則你就是否認我嘅權利。只需退到一旁,挑選你最有智慧嘅朋友,讓佢哋聽取並在你我之間裁決。如果佢哋發現我哋直接或間接地牽涉其中,我哋會把王國、王冠、性命以及我哋稱為我哋自己嘅一切,都作為補償畀你;但如果唔係,請你耐心聽從我哋,我哋會與你嘅靈魂共同努力,畀佢應得嘅安慰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雷歐提斯,我必須與你的悲傷相通,否則你就是否認我的權利。只需退到一旁,挑選你最有智慧的朋友,讓他們聽取並在你我之間裁決。如果他們發現我們直接或間接地牽涉其中,我們會把王國、王冠、性命以及我們稱為我們自己的一切,都作為補償給你;但如果不是,請你耐心聽從我們,我們會與你的靈魂共同努力,給它應得的安慰。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Let this be so; His means of death, his obscure burial,— No trophy, sword, nor hatchment o’er his bones, No noble rite, nor formal ostentation,— Cry to be heard, as ’twere from heaven to earth, That I must call’t in question.
passages.vernacular: 就咁樣吧;佢嘅死因、佢草草嘅葬禮——骨骸上冇戰利品、劍或紋章,冇高貴儀式,亦冇正式排場——彷彿從天向地呼喊,要我追究此事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就這樣吧;他的死因、他草草的葬禮——骨骸上沒戰利品、劍或紋章,沒高貴儀式,也沒正式排場——彷彿從天向地呼喊,要我追究此事。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: So you shall. And where th’offence is let the great axe fall. I pray you go with me.
passages.vernacular: 你會嘅。罪行所在之處,讓大斧落下。請你同我來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會的。罪行所在之處,讓大斧落下。請你和我來。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene VI — Another Room 第四幕第六場:城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter Horatio and a Servant.
passages.vernacular: [霍拉旭同一位僕人上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [霍拉旭和一位僕人上。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: What are they that would speak with me?
passages.vernacular: 想見我嘅係咩人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想見我的是什麼人?

passages.title: Servant 僕人
passages.original: Sailors, sir. They say they have letters for you.
passages.vernacular: 水手,先生。佢哋話有信畀你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 水手,先生。他們說有信給你。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Let them come in.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢哋入來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他們進來。

passages.original: [Exit Servant.]
passages.vernacular: [僕人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [僕人下。]

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: I do not know from what part of the world I should be greeted, if not from Lord Hamlet.
passages.vernacular: 除咗哈姆雷特殿下,我唔知世上還有邊個地方會有人問候我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 除了哈姆雷特殿下,我不知世上還有哪個地方會有人問候我。

passages.original: Enter Sailors.
passages.vernacular: [水手哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [水手們上。]

passages.title: First Sailor 第一水手
passages.original: God bless you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 願上帝保佑你,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上帝保佑你,先生。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Let him bless thee too.
passages.vernacular: 也願佢保佑你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也願他保佑你。

passages.title: First Sailor 第一水手
passages.original: He shall, sir, and’t please him. There’s a letter for you, sir. It comes from th’ambassador that was bound for England; if your name be Horatio, as I am let to know it is.
passages.vernacular: 佢會嘅,先生,只要佢願意。先生,呢度有你嘅信。來自嗰位前往英格蘭嘅大使;如果你叫霍拉旭,我被告知你係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會的,先生,只要他願意。先生,這裡有你的信。來自那位前往英格蘭的大使;如果你叫霍拉旭,我被告知你是。

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: [Reads.] ‘Horatio, when thou shalt have overlooked this, give these fellows some means to the King. They have letters for him. Ere we were two days old at sea, a pirate of very warlike appointment gave us chase. Finding ourselves too slow of sail, we put on a compelled valour, and in the grapple I boarded them. On the instant they got clear of our ship, so I alone became their prisoner. They have dealt with me like thieves of mercy. But they knew what they did; I am to do a good turn for them. Let the King have the letters I have sent, and repair thou to me with as much haste as thou wouldst fly death. I have words to speak in thine ear will make thee dumb; yet are they much too light for the bore of the matter. These good fellows will bring thee where I am. Rosencrantz and Guildenstern hold their course for England: of them I have much to tell thee. Farewell. He that thou knowest thine, HAMLET.’
passages.vernacular: [讀。]「霍拉旭,你睇完呢封信後,畀呢啲人安排門路去見國王。佢哋有信畀佢。我哋出海未夠兩日,一艘武裝精良嘅海盜船就追趕我哋。發現我哋航速太慢,被迫鼓起勇氣,在接舷戰中我登上佢哋嘅船。佢哋立刻脫離我哋嘅船,結果只有我一人成咗佢哋嘅囚犯。佢哋對我就像有慈悲心嘅盜賊。但佢哋知道自己在做咩;我要為佢哋做件好事。讓國王收到我寄出嘅信,然後你要用逃命般嘅速度趕到我呢度。我有啲話要喺你耳邊講,會令你啞口無言;但呢啲話比起事情嘅口徑,仍然太輕。呢班好人會帶你到我所在之處。羅森克蘭茲同吉爾登斯特恩繼續駛向英格蘭:關於佢哋,我有好多話要告訴你。再見。你所知嘅屬於你嘅人,哈姆雷特。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: [讀。]「霍拉旭,你看完這封信後,給這些人安排門路去見國王。他們有信給他。我們出海未滿兩日,一艘武裝精良的海盜船就追趕我們。發現我們航速太慢,被迫鼓起勇氣,在接舷戰中我登上他們的船。他們立刻脫離我們的船,結果只有我一人成了他們的囚犯。他們對我就像有慈悲心的盜賊。但他們知道自己在做什麼;我要為他們做件好事。讓國王收到我寄出的信,然後你要用逃命般的速度趕到我這裡。我有些話要在你耳邊說,會使你啞口無言;但這些話比起事情的口徑,仍然太輕。這班好人會帶你到我所在之處。羅森克蘭茲和吉爾登斯特恩繼續駛向英格蘭:關於他們,我有很多話要告訴你。再見。你所知的屬於你的人,哈姆雷特。」

passages.title: Horatio 霍拉旭
passages.original: Come, I will give you way for these your letters, And do’t the speedier, that you may direct me To him from whom you brought them.
passages.vernacular: 來,我替你哋呢啲信開路,並加快速度,好讓你哋帶我去見交信畀你哋嗰位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,我替你們這些信開路,並加快速度,好讓你們帶我去見交信給你們的那位。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene VII — Another Room 第四幕第七場:城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter King and Laertes.
passages.vernacular: [國王同雷歐提斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [國王和雷歐提斯上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Now must your conscience my acquittance seal, And you must put me in your heart for friend, Sith you have heard, and with a knowing ear, That he which hath your noble father slain Pursu’d my life.
passages.vernacular: 而家你嘅良心必須蓋印證明我無罪,你必須視我為朋友放入心中,因為你已經聽到,而且係懂事嘅耳朵聽到,殺死你高貴父親嘅人,曾圖謀我嘅性命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在你的良心必須蓋印證明我無罪,你必須視我為朋友放入心中,因為你已經聽到,而且是懂事的耳朵聽到,殺死你高貴父親的人,曾圖謀我的性命。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: It well appears. But tell me Why you proceeded not against these feats, So crimeful and so capital in nature, As by your safety, wisdom, all things else, You mainly were stirr’d up.
passages.vernacular: 十分明顯。但告訴我,為何你不對呢啲行徑採取行動,佢哋性質如此罪惡、如此該處死,按你嘅安全、智慧同其他一切考慮,你本該被大力激起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 十分明顯。但告訴我,為何你不對這些行徑採取行動,它們性質如此罪惡、如此該處死,按你的安全、智慧和其他一切考慮,你本該被大力激起。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: O, for two special reasons, Which may to you, perhaps, seem much unsinew’d, But yet to me they are strong. The Queen his mother Lives almost by his looks; and for myself,— My virtue or my plague, be it either which,— She’s so conjunctive to my life and soul, That, as the star moves not but in his sphere, I could not but by her. The other motive, Why to a public count I might not go, Is the great love the general gender bear him, Who, dipping all his faults in their affection, Would like the spring that turneth wood to stone, Convert his gyves to graces; so that my arrows, Too slightly timber’d for so loud a wind, Would have reverted to my bow again, And not where I had aim’d them.
passages.vernacular: 啊,有兩個特別理由,也許在你睇來很軟弱無力,但對我來講卻很強大。佢母親王后幾乎靠著佢嘅神色而活;至於我自己——不管係我嘅美德抑或瘟疫——佢同我嘅生命同靈魂緊密相連,好似星辰只能在自己嘅軌道運行,我也只能依佢而行。另一個動機,令我不能公開審判佢,係民眾對佢嘅深愛:佢哋把佢所有過失都浸喺佢哋嘅愛裡,就像泉水能把木頭變成石頭,把佢嘅鐐銬變成裝飾;所以我嘅箭,木杆太輕,抵不住咁大嘅風,會反彈回我嘅弓,而唔會射向我瞄準嘅目標。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,有兩個特別理由,也許在你看來很軟弱無力,但對我來說卻很強大。他母親王后幾乎靠著他的神色而活;至於我自己——不管是我的美德抑或瘟疫——她和我的生命和靈魂緊密相連,像星辰只能在自己的軌道運行,我也只能依她而行。另一個動機,使我不能公開審判他,是民眾對他的深愛:他們把他所有過失都浸在他們的愛裡,就像泉水能把木頭變成石頭,把他的鐐銬變成裝飾;所以我的箭,木杆太輕,抵不住這麼大的風,會反彈回我的弓,而不會射向我瞄準的目標。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: And so have I a noble father lost, A sister driven into desperate terms, Whose worth, if praises may go back again, Stood challenger on mount of all the age For her perfections. But my revenge will come.
passages.vernacular: 於是我便失去了高貴嘅父親,妹妹被逼入絕望境地,佢嘅價值——如果讚美可以追溯過去——曾經站喺整個時代嘅山頂挑戰,只因佢嘅完美。但我嘅復仇會來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 於是我便失去了高貴的父親,妹妹被逼入絕望境地,她的價值——如果讚美可以追溯過去——曾經站在整個時代的山頂挑戰,只因她的完美。但我的復仇會來。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Break not your sleeps for that. You must not think That we are made of stuff so flat and dull That we can let our beard be shook with danger, And think it pastime. You shortly shall hear more. I lov’d your father, and we love ourself, And that, I hope, will teach you to imagine—
passages.vernacular: 唔好為此失眠。你唔好以為我哋係由如此平庸遲鈍嘅材料造成,以致能讓鬍子被危險搖撼還當作消遣。你好快就會聽到更多。我愛過你父親,我哋也愛我哋自己,我希望呢會令你想像到——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要為此失眠。你不要以為我們是由如此平庸遲鈍的材料造成,以致能讓鬍子被危險搖撼還當作消遣。你很快就會聽到更多。我愛過你父親,我們也愛我們自己,我希望這會使你想像到——

passages.original: Enter a Messenger.
passages.vernacular: [一位信使上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一位信使上。]

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: How now? What news?
passages.vernacular: 點樣?有咩消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣?有什麼消息?

passages.title: Messenger 信使
passages.original: Letters, my lord, from Hamlet. This to your Majesty; this to the Queen.
passages.vernacular: 信,陛下,來自哈姆雷特。呢封畀陛下;呢封畀王后。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 信,陛下,來自哈姆雷特。這封給陛下;這封給王后。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: From Hamlet! Who brought them?
passages.vernacular: 來自哈姆雷特!邊個帶來嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來自哈姆雷特!誰帶來的?

passages.title: Messenger 信使
passages.original: Sailors, my lord, they say; I saw them not. They were given me by Claudio. He receiv’d them Of him that brought them.
passages.vernacular: 水手,陛下,據講係;我冇見到佢哋。係克勞迪奧交畀我嘅。佢從送信嘅人手中接過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 水手,陛下,據說是;我沒見到他們。是克勞迪奧交給我的。他從送信的人手中接過。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Laertes, you shall hear them. Leave us.
passages.vernacular: 雷歐提斯,你會聽到。你退下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雷歐提斯,你會聽到。你退下。

passages.original: [Exit Messenger.]
passages.vernacular: [信使下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [信使下。]

passages.original: [Reads.] ‘High and mighty, you shall know I am set naked on your kingdom. Tomorrow shall I beg leave to see your kingly eyes. When I shall, first asking your pardon thereunto, recount the occasions of my sudden and more strange return. HAMLET.’
passages.vernacular: [讀。]「尊貴強大嘅陛下,請知悉我赤身被拋在你嘅王國。明日我將請求覲見尊顏。屆時,先求陛下恕罪,再陳述我突然而更離奇返國嘅緣由。哈姆雷特。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: [讀。]「尊貴強大的陛下,請知悉我赤身被拋在你的王國。明日我將請求覲見尊顏。屆時,先求陛下恕罪,再陳述我突然而更離奇返國的緣由。哈姆雷特。」

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: What should this mean? Are all the rest come back? Or is it some abuse, and no such thing?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係咩意思?其餘嘅人都返嚟咗嗎?還係某種欺騙,根本冇呢回事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼意思?其餘的人都回來了嗎?還是某種欺騙,根本沒這回事?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Know you the hand?
passages.vernacular: 你認得呢筆跡嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你認得這筆跡嗎?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: ’Tis Hamlet’s character. ‘Naked!’ And in a postscript here he says ‘alone.’ Can you advise me?
passages.vernacular: 係哈姆雷特嘅字跡。「赤身!」而在附言裡佢話「獨自」。你能畀我建議嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是哈姆雷特的字跡。「赤身!」而在附言裡他說「獨自」。你能給我建議嗎?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: I am lost in it, my lord. But let him come, It warms the very sickness in my heart That I shall live and tell him to his teeth, ‘Thus diest thou.’
passages.vernacular: 我對此茫然不知所措,陛下。不過讓佢來吧,呢使我心中嘅病痛也暖和起來,因為我將活著當面對佢講:「你就係咁死嘅。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對此茫然不知所措,陛下。不過讓他來吧,這使我心中的病痛也暖和起來,因為我將活著當面對他說:「你就是這樣死的。」

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: If it be so, Laertes,— As how should it be so? How otherwise?— Will you be rul’d by me?
passages.vernacular: 如果係咁,雷歐提斯——點可能係咁?又點可能唔係?——你肯聽我安排嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是這樣,雷歐提斯——怎麼可能是這樣?又怎麼可能不是?——你肯聽我安排嗎?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Ay, my lord; So you will not o’errule me to a peace.
passages.vernacular: 肯,陛下;只要你不強迫我講和。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯,陛下;只要你不強迫我講和。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: To thine own peace. If he be now return’d, As checking at his voyage, and that he means No more to undertake it, I will work him To an exploit, now ripe in my device, Under the which he shall not choose but fall; And for his death no wind shall breathe, But even his mother shall uncharge the practice And call it accident.
passages.vernacular: 為了你自己嘅平靜。如果佢而家已返嚟,正如在航程中退縮,不打算再去,我會引佢進行一項我心中已成熟嘅計謀,在此佢非跌倒不可;而對於佢嘅死,冇一絲風聲會洩漏,連佢母親也會免除呢個陰謀嘅罪名,稱之為意外。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了你自己的平靜。如果他現在已回來,正如在航程中退縮,不打算再去,我會引他進行一項我心中已成熟的計謀,在此他非跌倒不可;而對於他的死,沒一絲風聲會洩漏,連他母親也會免除這個陰謀的罪名,稱之為意外。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: My lord, I will be rul’d; The rather if you could devise it so That I might be the organ.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我會聽從;尤其係若你能安排,讓我成為執行工具。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我會聽從;尤其是若你能安排,讓我成為執行工具。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: It falls right. You have been talk’d of since your travel much, And that in Hamlet’s hearing, for a quality Wherein they say you shine. Your sum of parts Did not together pluck such envy from him As did that one, and that, in my regard, Of the unworthiest siege.
passages.vernacular: 正合適。自你遊歷之後,你常被談起,而且係在哈姆雷特耳邊,因為你有一種才能,據講光芒四射。你所有才能加起來,都不及嗰一項令佢如此嫉妒,而嗰一項,依我睇,係最不值一提嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正合適。自你遊歷之後,你常被談起,而且是在哈姆雷特耳邊,因為你有一種才能,據說光芒四射。你所有才能加起來,都不及那一項使他如此嫉妒,而那一項,依我看,是最不值一提的。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: What part is that, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 係哪一項,陛下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是哪一項,陛下?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: A very riband in the cap of youth, Yet needful too, for youth no less becomes The light and careless livery that it wears Than settled age his sables and his weeds, Importing health and graveness. Two months since Here was a gentleman of Normandy,— I’ve seen myself, and serv’d against, the French, And they can well on horseback, but this gallant Had witchcraft in’t. He grew unto his seat, And to such wondrous doing brought his horse, As had he been incorps’d and demi-natur’d With the brave beast. So far he topp’d my thought That I in forgery of shapes and tricks, Come short of what he did.
passages.vernacular: 青年帽子上嘅一條緞帶,但也必不可少,因為年輕人穿輕鬆隨意嘅服飾,正如年長者穿黑袍和喪服,顯示健康與莊重,同樣相稱。兩個月前,呢度有位諾曼底紳士——我自己見過,也曾與法國人交戰,佢哋騎術精湛,但呢位英俊少年卻彷彿有魔法。佢彷彿長在馬鞍上,把馬操控得出神入化,彷彿與呢匹駿馬合為一體、半化為同類。佢遠超我嘅想像,以致我在構想姿勢與花招時,也比不上佢所做嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 青年帽子上的一條緞帶,但也必不可少,因為年輕人穿輕鬆隨意的服飾,正如年長者穿黑袍和喪服,顯示健康與莊重,同樣相稱。兩個月前,這裡有位諾曼底紳士——我自己見過,也曾與法國人交戰,他們騎術精湛,但這位英俊少年卻彷彿有魔法。他彷彿長在馬鞍上,把馬操控得出神入化,彷彿與這匹駿馬合為一體、半化為同類。他遠超我的想像,以致我在構想姿勢與花招時,也比不上他所做的。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: A Norman was’t?
passages.vernacular: 係諾曼人嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是諾曼人嗎?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: A Norman.
passages.vernacular: 諾曼人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 諾曼人。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Upon my life, Lamord.
passages.vernacular: 我以性命擔保,係拉莫德。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我以性命擔保,是拉莫德。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: The very same.
passages.vernacular: 正係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是他。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: I know him well. He is the brooch indeed And gem of all the nation.
passages.vernacular: 我認識佢。佢確實係全國嘅胸針同寶石。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認識他。他確實是全國的胸針和寶石。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: He made confession of you, And gave you such a masterly report For art and exercise in your defence, And for your rapier most especially, That he cried out ’twould be a sight indeed If one could match you. The scrimers of their nation He swore had neither motion, guard, nor eye, If you oppos’d them. Sir, this report of his Did Hamlet so envenom with his envy That he could nothing do but wish and beg Your sudden coming o’er to play with him. Now, out of this,—
passages.vernacular: 佢對你作了坦白,並對你嘅防身技藝同武藝,尤其係你嘅細劍,作出大師般嘅報告,以致佢大叫,若有人能與你匹敵,將係一場奇觀。佢發誓,如果你與佢哋對陣,佢哋國家嘅劍客既無步法、無防守,亦無眼力。先生,佢呢番報告令哈姆雷特嫉妒得充滿毒意,以致佢乜嘢都不做,只係希望並懇求你盡快回來與佢比試。而家,由此出發——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他對你作了坦白,並對你的防身技藝和武藝,尤其是你的細劍,作出大師般的報告,以致他大叫,若有人能與你匹敵,將是一場奇觀。他發誓,如果你與他們對陣,他們國家的劍客既無步法、無防守,也無眼力。先生,他這番報告使哈姆雷特嫉妒得充滿毒意,以致他什麼都不做,只是希望並懇求你盡快回來與他比試。現在,由此出發——

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: What out of this, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 由此出發點樣,陛下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 由此出發怎樣,陛下?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Laertes, was your father dear to you? Or are you like the painting of a sorrow, A face without a heart?
passages.vernacular: 雷歐提斯,你父親對你親愛嗎?還係你如同悲傷嘅畫像,一張冇心嘅臉?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雷歐提斯,你父親對你親愛嗎?還是你如同悲傷的畫像,一張沒有心的臉?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: Why ask you this?
passages.vernacular: 你為何問呢個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為何問這個?

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: Not that I think you did not love your father, But that I know love is begun by time, And that I see, in passages of proof, Time qualifies the spark and fire of it. There lives within the very flame of love A kind of wick or snuff that will abate it; And nothing is at a like goodness still, For goodness, growing to a pleurisy, Dies in his own too much. That we would do, We should do when we would; for this ‘would’ changes, And hath abatements and delays as many As there are tongues, are hands, are accidents; And then this ‘should’ is like a spendthrift sigh That hurts by easing. But to the quick o’ th’ulcer: Hamlet comes back: what would you undertake To show yourself your father’s son in deed, More than in words?
passages.vernacular: 唔係我認為你不愛父親,而係我知道愛始於時間,並且我從經驗中睇到,時間會削弱愛嘅火花與火焰。愛嘅火焰之中,存在一種燈芯或燭花,會使佢減弱;冇嘢永遠保持同樣嘅善,因為善發展成胸膜炎,就會死於自身嘅過盛。我哋想做嘅,應該想做時就做;因為呢個「想」會改變,有幾多舌頭、手、意外,就有幾多減退與拖延;於是呢個「應該」就像揮霍嘅歎息,舒緩之時反而傷身。講到膿瘡嘅要害:哈姆雷特回來喇:你打算做咩來行動上證明自己係你父親嘅兒子,而不僅係口頭上?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是我認為你不愛父親,而是我知道愛始於時間,並且我從經驗中看到,時間會削弱愛的火花與火焰。愛的火焰之中,存在一種燈芯或燭花,會使它減弱;沒有東西永遠保持同樣的善,因為善發展成胸膜炎,就會死於自身的過盛。我們想做的,應該想做時就做;因為這個「想」會改變,有多少舌頭、手、意外,就有多少減退與拖延;於是這個「應該」就像揮霍的歎息,舒緩之時反而傷身。說到膿瘡的要害:哈姆雷特回來了:你打算做什麼來行動上證明自己是你父親的兒子,而不僅是口頭上?

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: To cut his throat i’ th’ church.
passages.vernacular: 在教堂裡割斷佢嘅喉嚨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在教堂裡割斷他的喉嚨。

passages.title: King 國王克勞狄斯
passages.original: No place, indeed, should murder sanctuarize; Revenge should have no bounds. But good Laertes, Will you do this, keep close within your chamber. Hamlet return’d shall know you are come home: We’ll put on those shall praise your excellence, And set a double varnish on the fame The Frenchman gave you, bring you in fine together And wager on your heads. He, being remiss, Most generous, and free from all contriving, Will not peruse the foils; so that with ease, Or with a little shuffling, you may choose A sword unbated, and in a pass of practice, Requite him for your father.
passages.vernacular: 確實,冇任何地方應為謀殺提供庇護;復仇不應有界限。但好雷歐提斯,你願意咁樣做嗎:緊閉在你房間內。哈姆雷特回來後會知道你已回家:我哋會安排人稱讚你嘅卓越,畀法國人畀你嘅名聲再加一層光彩,最終把你哋兩人湊到一起,對你哋下賭注。佢為人疏忽、極其寬厚、毫無機心,唔會細查嗰啲鈍劍;所以你可以輕易,或稍微調換,挑選一把未鈍嘅劍,在一次練習嘅招式中,為你父親報仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實,沒任何地方應為謀殺提供庇護;復仇不應有界限。但好雷歐提斯,你願意這樣做嗎:緊閉在你房間內。哈姆雷特回來後會知道你已回家:我們會安排人稱讚你的卓越,給法國人給你的名聲再加一層光彩,最終把你們兩人湊到一起,對你們下賭注。他為人疏忽、極其寬厚、毫無機心,不會細查那些鈍劍;所以你可以輕易,或稍微調換,挑選一把未鈍的劍,在一次練習的招式中,為你父親報仇。

passages.title: Laertes 雷歐提斯
passages.original: I will do’t. And for that purpose I’ll anoint my sword.
